khyod kyi de la dpang po su zhig yod/ de nas byang chub sems dpa'i phyag g.yas pa bsod nams brgya phrag du mas bskyed pa sa la reg par mdzad de/ nga'i dpang po ni sa 'di yin no/ /de nas sa'i lha mo sa brtol te byung nas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ji skad bka' stsal pa de bzhin no zhes smras pa dang*/ bdud sdig can bag 'khums shing sems khong du chud nas song ngo*/ /de nas sdig can gyis bskul te bdud nyid kyi bu mo sred ma dang*/ dga' byed ma dang*/ dga' spyod ma rnams mngags te/ de rnams lha'i bu mo'i mchog yin la/ bud med kyi g.yo sgyu rnams ston par brtsams pa na/ de dag rgan mor 'gyur bar byin gyis brlabs/ phyis ston pa la mos pa bskyed pas grol lo/ /de nas bdud sdig can gyis bdud kyi rigs kyi 'byung po thams cad sbran te/ bdud kyi dpung chen po gdong dang gzugs sna tshogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa dpa' zhing gtum la mi bsrun pa bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug sngon du bdas shing*/ sdig can rang nyid mda' gzhu rna ba'i bar du bkang ste 'ongs nas byang chub sems dpa'i mtha' bskor te 'dug go /de nas byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas 'byung po rnams kyis mtshon cha 'phangs pa dag ni utpal dang padma la sogs par gyur/ ri 'phangs pa ni me tog gi khang brtsegs su gyur/ rlung gdug pa dang rdo char phab pa ni gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis bsgribs/ phyag dar dang mi gtsang ba'i char phab pa yang dri zhim po'i rdzas rnams su gyur te bdud kyi gnod pa thams cad brdugs/ de nas bdud kyi dpung de rnams phyogs de nas gyes so/ /bsam gtan gyi tsher ma sgra yin pas/ bdud kyi mthus byang chub kyi shing shel las grub pas song zhing*/ rlung gis bskyod pas sgra 'byin pa na/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis lo ma re re nas bzung ste sgra med par byas

so/ /'on kyang bdud de dag da dung gnas pa la gtsang ma'i lha dag gis bdud de dag khor yug gi pha rol tu bskrad na/ de dag gis rgyang ring po nas 'jigs su rung ba'i sgra chen po phyung ngo*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnod kyis dogs nas/ lha rnams kyis dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi bar du shing ka tam pa'i nags 'thug pos bskor bar sprul lo/ /de nas thams cad mi snang bar song ngo*/ /nyer lnga pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes pa ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' nam gyi thun dang po'i skabs de nyid du mnyam par bzhag ste rab kyi mtha'i bsam gtan la brten nas rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang lha'i rna ba bsgrubs so/ /gung thun la gzhan gyi sems shes pa dang*/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang lha'i spyan bsgrubs shing*/ de nas thun tha ma la zag zad kyi mngon shes bsgrubs/ bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes te mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas thams cad mkhyen pa de bzhin gshegs par gyur to/ /de nas bdud kyi rigs kyi lha rnams kyis grong khyer ser skyar byang chub sems dpa' grongs so zhes bsgrags pas thams cad mya ngan du gyur pa la/ dkar po'i lha rnams kyis shākya thub pa ni ma nongs te/ da ni bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes so zhes bsgrags pas thams cad dga' ba skyes so/ /de ltar sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nub mo bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa'i ye shes kyang brnyes/ zla ba la yang sgra gcan zhugs/ grags 'dzin ma'i sras sgra gcan 'dzin yang btsas shing*/ bdud rtsi zas kyi bu kun dga' bo yang btsas so/ /de'i tshe sa chen po ni rab tu g.yos/ phyogs thams cad ni 'od gyi snang bas khyab par gyur/ 'jig rten gyi khams phan tshun gyi bar na/ mun pa mun nag tu gyur pa thams cad kyang snang bas khyab par gyur to/ /grong khyer ser skyar yang sbyin gtong gi khang pa brtsigs shing*/

sbyin pa dag sbyin/ bsod nams dag byas/ dga' ston rgya chen po yang bsgrubs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs te skyil krung gcig gis zhag bdun 'das par mdzad do/ /nyer drug pa nags khrod du dal bar bzhugs pa ni/ de nas bdun phrag gnyis pa la bab pa na tshangs ris kyi lha gnyis shig 'ongs nas/ gcig gis/ ded dpon g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba po/ /sdig pa mi mnga' bzhengs shig 'jig rten gzigs/ /rin chen chos ni 'tshal bar 'gyur mchis kyi/ /bde gshegs chos kyi mchog 'di bshad du gsol/ /cig shos kyis kyang de dang rjes su mthun par bstod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sngar gyi ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ zhi ba'i bde ba la ched du brjod pa mdzad nas rnam par grol ba'i dga' bde sku nyams su bstar zhing zhag bdun phrag gnyis par yang skyil krung ma zhig par bzhugs so/ /de nas zhag bdun phrag gsum pa la bab pa na/ tshong dpon ga gon dang bzang po zhes bya ba gnyis shing rta lnga brgya tsam dang lhan cig rdo rje'i gdan dang nye ba'i lam nas 'gro ba las/ tshong dpon de dag nyid kyi grogs po shi nas lhar skyes pa dag gis de gnyis la lung bstan zhing bskul nas/ tshong dpon de gnyis bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du song ste/ sbrang rtsi dang lde gu dag 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol zhes zhus so/ /de nas dgongs pas sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyang lhung bzed kyi lhung bzed kyi snod du bsod snyoms bzhes kyi/ mu stegs byed bzhin du snyim pa dang slong phor du ma yin no/ /de'i tshe 'j-ig rten skyong ba bzhi pos de rig nas rdo las byas pa'i lhung bzed mi ma yin gyis bcos pa gsal zhing gtsang ba dri ma med pa re re thogs nas ston pa la phul

lo/ /de'i tshe gcig kho na las bzhes na gsum mi dga' bar 'gyur la/ gnyis las ni gnyis dang*/ gsum las ni gcig mi dga' bar mkhyen nas bzhi char bzhes te de rnams lhung bzed gcig tu 'gyur bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas lhung bzed der tshong dpon ga gon dang bzang pos bsod snyoms phul ba dag bzhes te/ de gnyis skyabs su 'gro ba la bkod/ sbyin pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i chos bstan to/ /de nas chu klung nai rāñdza na'i 'gram du gshegs te zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzad do/ /sbrang rtsi dag lde gu ni rlung nang slong bas/ de'i rjes su de bzhin gshegs pa cung zad sku snyung bar gyur ba na/ bdud sdig can 'ongs te mya ngan las 'da' bar gsol ba btab pa na/ ngas 'khor rnam pa bzhi ma bsten zhing tshangs par spyod pa'i lam skye bo rnams la ma bstan gyi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da'o zhes gsungs pas/ bdud yid mi bde bas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de'i 'og tu lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis shing dzambu'i tshal nas sman gyi mchog a ru ra blangs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la phul zhing gsol bas de ma thag bsnyun zhi zhing*/ shin tu bzod la lhag par 'tsho bar gyur to/ /de nas bdun phrag bzhi pa la bab pa na/ glo bur du sprin chags te yul ngan byung ba na/ klu'i rgyal po btang bzung gi gnas su gshegs te rlung la sogs pas sku la mi gnod pa'i phyir klu de rnams rang gi lus kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la dkris shing gdengs ka byas te 'dug go /de nas yul ngan sangs pa na lha'i lus su bsgyur zhing gus pas btud nas bsnyun gsol bar byed pa la dben pa'i dga' bde las brtsams te chos ston par mdzad do/ /de nas bdun phrag lnga pa la bab pa na/ byang chub snying por gshegs te rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi don la dgongs bzhin du zhag bdun skyil krung gcig gis 'da' bar mdzad nas ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/

ched du brjod pa'ang mdzad do/ /de nas bdun phrag drug pa'i dus la bab pa na/ bdag gis rtogs pa'i chos zab mo 'di ni gzhan gyis khong du chud par dka' ste/ gal te bdag gis gzhan la bstan par gyur kyang des mi rtogs pas bdag nyid dub pa tsam du zad kyi/ de bas na bdag gcig pu dgon par gnas par bya'o snyam du dgongs te thugs las chung ngur bzhugs so/ /nyer bdun pa tshangs pa chen pos gsol ba btab ste wā rā na sīr gshegs pa ni/ de nas mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas de shes te/ 'jig rten 'di ni ma rungs par 'gyur ro snyam nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs drung du song ste/ gsol pa/ ma ga dhār ni sngon chad chos byung ba/ /dag pa ma lags dri mar bcas par rtogs/ /bdud rtsi chos kyi sgo ni phye mdzod la/ /dri ma med pas rtogs pa bshad par mdzod/ /ces pa la/ ngas tshogs chen pos rtogs pa 'di gzhan rnams kyis rtogs par mi 'gyur zhes/ dang por zhal gyis ma bzhes so/ /yang tshangs pas/ 'jig rten na mchog dang 'bring dang dman pa dag yod pas rab 'bring dag gis chos thos na rtogs par 'gyur la/ ma thos na nyams par 'gyur ba lags pas nges par chos gsung bar zhus pa na/ ston pa nyid kyis ye shes kyi gzigs pas kyang de ltar dgongs te/ bka' stsal pa/ bdud rtsi'i sgo mo dag ni dbye bar bya/ /nyan par su 'dod som nyi sol cig dang*/ / tshangs pa mi rnams la ni gya nom chos/ /klan ka mi stsal mdo tsam bshad par bya/ /zhes zhal gyis bzhes pas tshangs pa dga' ba skyes mi snang bar song ngo*/ /gang gi tshe zhag bdun phrag bdun pa la bab pa na/ ring 'phur dang lhag spyod la dgongs pa'i tshe/ lha rnams kyis kyang gsol te/ ring 'phur 'das nas ni zhag bdun/ lhag spyod 'das nas ni zhag gcig lon par dgongs te/ kye ma de gnyis ni shin tu stes ma 'grig ste/ de dag gis nga'i chos thos na bdud rtsi thob par 'gyur ba zhig

da ni gzhan la ston dgos na/ lnga sde rnams nga sngon dka' ba spyod pa na gus pa dang bcas pa yin pas/ de rnams la bstan par bya'o dgongs te byang chub kyi shing drung nas bzhengs te rim pas ljongs rgyu zhing kā shī'i yul du gshegs so/ /lam du kun tu 'tsho ba pa nyer 'gro dang mjal te/ gau ta ma khyed kyi dbang po ni dwangs/ bzhin gyi mdog ni yongs su dgapags pa'i mdog ni rab tu gsal na/ khyod kyi ston pa ni gang*/ bka' stsal pa/ nga dang 'dra ba yong med kyi/ /nga la slob dpon 'ga' med do/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas nga gcig pu/ /yang dag byang chub dam pa thob/ /ces sogs so/ /nyer brgyad pa chos 'khor thog ma bskor ba ni/ de nas wā rā ṇa sir byon te/ de'i tshe drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags na lnga sde dag 'khod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byon pa rgyang ring po nas mthong ste phan tshun du khrims su bcas pa/ gau ta ma bya ba mang po mang pos 'tsho ba de 'ong gi /de la smra bar mi bya/ phyag mi bya/ ldang bar mi bya/ stan bstab par mi bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das khad nye bar byon pa na gzi brjid ma bzod de/ thams cad langs shing phyag phul nas/ gcig gis ni gdan bshoms/ gcig gis ni bsus te na bza' blangs/ kha cig gis ni zhabs bkrus/ shes ldan gau ta ma byon pa legs so/ /gdan bshams pa la bzhugs shig ces zer ro/ /der de bzhin gshegs pa la tshe dang ldan pa zhes sam gdung nas mi smos par gdams so/ /de nas de rnams kyis 'di skad ces/ khyed sngon dka' ba spyod pa na khyad par cung zad kyang ma thob na/ da ni khyed mi brtan zhing bya ba mang la mang du za ba sogs kyis lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes zhus so/ /bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis nga'i dbang po gsal ba sogs sngon las gzhan du gyur ba ma mthong ngam/ ngas ni bdud rtsi thob bo/ dge slong dag rab tu byung bas mtha' 'di gnyis la brten par mi bya ste/

'dod pa bsod nyams kyi mtha' dang*/ ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' 'o/ /dbu ma'i lam la brten dgos te/ de'ang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad do/ /zhes so/ /de'i tshe dge slong lnga las snga dro gnyis la gdams ngag 'bogs shing gsum bsod snyoms la 'jug ste/ bsod snyoms des ston pa dang bcas pa'i drug char 'tsho bar byed la/ phyi dro ni gsum chos nyan zhing gnyis bsod snyoms la bzhugs nas/ bsod snyoms des dge slong lnga po dag 'tsho bar byed de/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni rang bzhin gyis phyi dro mi gsol lo/ /de nas de dag gi skabs su dang por bden pa bzhi dang ldan pa bzlas pa lan gsum ste bcu gnyis su bskor bas kun shes kaunṭi n+ya dang*/ lha brgyad khris bden pa mthong ngo*/ /de'i rjes su kaunṭi n+ya la/ kaunṭi n+ya khyod kyis chos kun shes sam/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kun shes so zhes yang yang dri smed mdzad pas kun shes kaunṭi n+ya zhes grags so/ /de'i tshe sa lha'i gnod sbyin nas brtsams te lha'i gnas mthar thug par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas lha rgyas lha min 'gribs/ skye bo thams cad bde'o zhes rab tu dga' bas ched du brjod pa'i dbyangs kyis khyab par byas so/ /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pas lnga sde rnams la rnam grangs gzhan gyi sgo nas bden pa bzhi dang 'brel ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis pa bskor bas kun shes kyis dgra bcom pa thob la/ rta thul dang*/ rlangs pa dang*/ ming chen dang*/ bzang ldan rnams kyis kyang bden pa mthong*/ de'i tshe dgra bcom pa gnyis te bcom ldan 'das dang kun shes so/ /de nas yang bdag med pa las brtsams te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas dge slong lhag ma bzhis kyang dgra bcom pa thob ste/ de'i tshe dgra bcom pa drug go /nyer dgu pa nye ba'i lnga sde sogs grol ba ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das wā rā ṇa sīr 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi 'gram du bzhugs pa na/

wā rā ṇa sī'i rigs gyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa zhes bya ba yod la/ rol mo thogs pa'i bud med mang po dang lhan cig tu rtse bar byed pa las/ nam phyed na gnyid sad de bud med kyi 'khor la bltas pa na thams cad gnyid kyis myos te/ gos dang bral zhing skra grol ba sogs 'dug tshul sna tshogs pa mthong bas dur khrod kyi 'du shes skyes nas bdag ni gtses so/ /bdag ni nyams so/ /zhes skad chen po phyung nas song ba na mi ma yin rnams kyis sgo phye zhing*/ skad kyang skye bos mi thos par byas so/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das bzhugs khang gi phyi rol bla gab med pa na grags pa sgug pa'i phyir zhabs 'chag cing bzhugs so/ /des kyang chu'i pha kha nas mthong ste/ dge sbyong chen po bdag ni gtses so/ /bdag ni nyams so/ / zhes skad phyung ngo*/ /bka' stsal pa/ gzhon nu tshur shog gnas 'di ni khyod la 'tshe ba med pa yin/ nyams pa med pa yin no/ /de nas grags pas rin po che'i lham chu 'gram du phud de bor nas chu la brgal te ston pa'i spyan sngar 'ongs te zhabs la phyag byas/ de nas nang du gshegs nas chos bstan pas/ grags pa stan de la 'khod bzhin du bden pa mthong zhing*/ skyabs su 'gro ba blangs so/ /de nas khyim du bran mo zhig gis grags pa song bar shes nas jo bo la sbran pas/ khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo nyid sgron me thogs pa'i mi dang lhan cig tu 'tshol zhing song*/ rta pa dag kyang grags pa 'tshol ba'i phyir bkye'o/ /de nas chu 'gram du nor bu'i lham mthong bas dogs pa dang bcas bzhin du chu brgal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ngo*/ /de'i tshe rigs kyi gtso bos grags pa mi mthong bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ bcom ldan 'das gzhon nu grags pa gzigs sam zhes zhus pas/ bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de'i phyir sdod cig /stan 'di la 'khod bzhin du grags pa mthong bar 'gyur ba'i gnas yod

do/ /de nas rigs kyi gtso bo dga' ste phyogs gcig tu 'dug go /yang de bzhin gshegs pas chos bstan pa na/ rigs kyi gtso bo yang bden pa mthong zhing*/ grags pa stan de la 'khod bzhin brgyan dang bcas bzhin par dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /de'i tshe dgra bcom pa bdun no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul bsdus pas rigs kyi gtso bos grags pa mthong ba na/ des smras pa/ grags pa tshur shog khyim du dong ngo*/ /de nas ston pas grags pa dgra bcom pa thob pas khyim du gnas pa'i skabs med par khyim bdag la brda sprod par mdzad pas/ de yang dad cing nangs par khyim du spyan 'dren pa'i zhu ba byas te phyir ldog go /de nas nam langs shing gdugs tshod kyi dus la bab pa na/ bcom ldan 'das dang grags pa lhan cig rigs kyi gtso bo'i khyim du byon zhing*/ gdugs tshod gsol zin pa'i 'og tu chos bstan pas/ grags pa'i ma dang chung mas kyang bden pa mthong ngo*/ /de ltar grags pa rab tu byung ba'i gtam thos nas de'i nu bor gyur pa dri med dang gang bo dang ba lang bdag dang lag bzang rnams kyang rab tu byung*/ de dag gis dben par rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas ring por ma thogs par dgra bcom pa thob ste/ 'jig rten du dgra bcom pa bcu gcig go /de nas rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu rnams lo gzhon zhing bde bar gnas pa yang dad pas rab tu byung ngo zhes gtam thos nas wā rā ṇa sī'i grong gi gtso bo gtso bo rnams kyi khye'u lnga bcu'ang bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rab tu byung zhing*/ dben par bsgoms pas yun ring ma lon par dgra bcom pa thob ste/ de'i tshe dgra bcom pa drug cu rtsa gcig go /sum cu pa ma ga dhār 'byon ba'i lam bar gyi gtam ni/ bar der bdud sdig can bram ze'i gzugs su sprul nas dkrugs ma byas pa'ang ma tshugs so/ /de nas dge slong rnams kyang ston pa'i bkas so sor rgyu zhing 'gro ba'i don byed la/

bcom ldan 'das nyid kā shi wā rā ṇa sī'i ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs nas/ lteng rgyas kyi grong khyer sde can brgyud de ras bal gyi nags tshang tshing na shing drung zhig na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe bzang sde'i tshogs drug cu zhes bya ba rnams rol mo shes pa'i bud med mang po dag dam bca' ba blangs te/ grong khyer gyi phyi rol skyed mos tshal rnams su bza' bca' sna tshogs dang*/ rol mo sna tshogs kyis rtse bar byed pa na/ bud med gcig dam bcas pa dral te bros so/ /de nas de dag bud med de 'tshol du song ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa shing drung du bzhugs pa mthong ste drung du 'ongs nas/ bcom ldan 'das bud med gcig gzigs sam/ bka' stsal pa/ de khyed rnams kyi cir 'ong*/ de nas rgyas par gsol bas/ ci khyed rnams bud med de 'tshol ba gang yin pa dang*/ rang nyid 'tshol ba gang 'dam/ gsol pa/ bdag nyid 'tshol ba 'dam lags so/ /de nas de rnams la bcom ldan 'das kyis chos bstan pas bden pa mthong zhing*/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba tsam blangs pas dge slong du gyur to/ /skabs 'di'i lung las/ dge bsnyen du bzung ngu gsol zhes pa yod kyang skyabs 'gro tsam gyi bsnyen rdzogs yin pas de ni de rnams kyi tshig brjod tshul tsam yin no/ /sngon ser skya'i gzhi na bram ze lha zhes bya ba longs spyod dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs su byon pa zhig yod pa la/ de phyis gnyen dang nor dang 'byor pa thams cad zad nas skabs der sde can gyi grong du 'ongs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das der gshegs par rig gnas bram ze dang chung ma gnyis gros byas te/ deng bcom ldan 'das la bsod snyoms zhig 'bul dgos te/ bdag cag la nyi ma gcig gi kha zas kyang med na ji ltar bgyi/ bram zes smras pa/ khyod nyid gta' mar bcug ste karsha pa na lnga skyin par blang ngo*/ /zhes gros mthun nas de bzhin du byas shing*/

khyim bdag gcig las gos gsar pa dang*/ rgyan g.yar nas bram ze'i chung ma la bskon te/ khyim du bcom ldan 'das spyan drangs nas gdugs tshod gsol lo/ /de nas chung mas rgyan phud de bzhag pa na rkun mas khyer te/ bram zes bsams pa/ bdag gis rgyan de lta bu 'byor pa nam yang min gyi/ bdag nags su song ste 'chi ba las gzhan thabs med do snyam 'brog dgon pa zhig tu song ba las/ mi zhig gis dong brkos te song ba mthong nas/ bram zes der song bas sngar gyi rgyan rnyed de khyim du 'ongs so/ /chung ma yang yid mi bde ba bzhin du khyim gyi phyag dar byas pas sa 'og nas gser gyi bum pa gser gyis gang ba rnyed de/ de lta bu byung ba de'ang sangs rgyas la bsod snyoms phul ba'i phan yon du shes nas dad pas chos nyan pas bram ze lha chung ma dang bcas pas bden pa mthong*/ de nas phyogs der grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang*/ dga' stobs mas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa la gdugs tshod gsol/ ston pas kyang chos bstan pas de gnyis kyis kyang bden pa mthong ngo*/ /de skabs bzang sde'i tshogs drug cus kyang dgra bcom pa thob ste/ dgra bcom pa brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gcig go /so gcig pa ral pa can stong btul ba ni/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ yul ma ga dhā 'dir dge sbyong dag bram ze gcig dbang du gyur bas skye bo'i tshogs mang po'i tshogs chung ngus dbang du 'gyur ba su yod dgongs na/ lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can de lta bu yin par dgongs so/ /de la 'od srung de ni lo brgya nyi shu lon pa/ srid rtse'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa/ skye bo rnams kyis dgra bcom par bkur zhing*/ rang nyid kyang dgra bcom par rlom pa zhig go

/'od srung de'ang 'khor ral pa can lnga brgya dang bcas pa yin la/ de'i slob mar gyur ba spun zla ni chu klung 'od srung dang ga ya 'od srung spun dag ste/ de gnyis kyang slob ma ral pa can nyis brgya lnga bcu re dang bcas pa yin no/ /de dag kyang chu klung nairāñdza na'i 'gram du dka' thub spyod pa ste/ chu mgo na ni lteng rgyas 'od srung gnas la smad kyi phyogs na ni gzhan gnyis so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas 'od srung kyi bsti gnas su gshegs pa na/ des kyang gdan bshams shing bsus te byon pa legs so zhes gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa la bzhugs nas 'od srung la dga' ba dang mgu bar gyur pa'i gtam mdzad do/ /bka' stsal pa/ khyod la mi bde ba med na/ nga me khang 'dir zhag gcig tu 'dug go /gsol ba/ bdag la mi bde ba ma mchis kyang*/ de na klu gdug pa zhig gnas pas mtho 'tsham pas 'gyur du mi 'ong ngam/ de nas bcom ldan 'das me khang du byon nas bzhugs pa na/ mtshan mo'i dus su klu khros pas du ba btul/ ston pas rdzu 'phrul gyis de bas kyang che ba'i du ba btul/ klus me sbar ro/ /bcom ldan 'das me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs pas khang pa thams cad me rab tu 'bar bar gyur to/ /'od srung rgyu skar la lta bas mthong ste/ kye ma gau ta ma mdzes pa de klu gdug pas thal bar ma byas grang snyam mo/ /de nas klu de thul nas nangs bar lhung bzed kyi nang du bcug ste bsnams nas 'od srung kyis sar byon pa na/ lhung bzed du bsnams te byon pa de ci/ bka' stsal pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang mi ldan pa su yang gnas su m-i ster ba'i klu de/ ngas btul te khyer 'ongs so/ /des bsams pa/ dge sbyong chen po 'di ni mthu che zhing rdzu 'phrul che'o snyam mo/ /de lta mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam pas bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes su slob par 'dod pa ni med do/ /de nas bzung ste bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gi bsti gnas nags tshang tshing du bzhugs so//

'od srung gi slob ma bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya po re re yang me thab gsum gsum bzung ste me la spyod pa las/ me mi 'bar bar byin gyis brlabs pas thabs gang gis kyang sbor ma thub bo/ /de rnams kyis 'od srung la sbran pas/ 'od srung gis ston pa la zhus pa na/ bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung me sbar bar 'dod dam/ gsol pa/ dge sbyong chen po spar du gsol/ de nas me rang 'bar ro/ /'od srung gis bsams pa/ dge sbyong chen po 'di ni mthu che zhing rdzu 'phrul che ste/ bdag kyang dgra bcom pa'o snyam/ de nas bram ze lnga brgya me la spyad zin pa na/ me bsad par 'dod na yang bsad ma thub bo/ /de nas de rnams kyis 'od srung la smras*/ des ston pa la zhus pas/ me zhi bar 'dod dam/ des kyang 'tshal lo zhus pas/ me rang zhi'o/ /de nas 'od srung rang nyid kyis kyang me sbar ma nus pa dang*/ me shi bar ma nus pa la'ang de dang 'dra'o/ /yang me khang thams cad mes sreg par mthong ste/ skye bo'i tshogs mang po dang bcas pas me gsod par ma nus pa la'ang de dang 'dra'o/ /de nas mtshan mo zhig ston pa'i drung du rgyal po chen po bzhi chos nyan pa na/ 'od srung rgyu skar la lta bas rgyang nas bltas na/ me'i phung po chen po lta bu bzhi mthong ngo*/ /yang snga dro 'od srung gi gnas su byon pa na/ de na re/ dge sbyong chen po yang zhugs la spyod dam/ bka' stsal pa ma yin te/ rgyal po chen po bzhi nga la chos nyan to/ /yang de dang 'dra ba las snga ma las ches lhag pa'i me chen po 'bar bar mthong ste/ brgya byin chos nyan du 'ongs pa'o/ /yang de dang 'dra ba las ches shin tu che ba'i me dpung mthong ste/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas chos nyan du 'ongs pa'o/ /'dir me la spyod pa zhes bya ba ni sbyin sreg byed pa'i don yin no/ /de nas 'od srung gi drung du ma ga dhā'i skye bo phal mo che 'ongs nas zhag bdun du mchod sbyin gyi rnyed pa chen po 'byung ba yod pas/

'od srung gyis bsams pa/ dge sbyong chen po 'di gzhan du byon na ci ma rung snyam du sems pa na/ de mkhyen te gzhan zhig tu gshegs so/ /zhag bdun song nas skye bo rnams kyang gyes/ 'od srung bza' bca' dang yo byad kyi tshogs mang po dang bcas par gyur pa na/ da ni dge sbyong chen po 'dir byon te yo byad 'di rnams la longs spyad na ci ma rung snyam pa na/ de ma thag tu der byon no/ /ci'i phyir zhag bdun gzhan du gshegs/ de'i tshe khyod nyid 'di ltar sems pas so/ /gsol ba/ deng ci'i phyir byon/ bka' stsal pa/ deng 'di ltar sems pas so/ dge sbyong chen po de de bzhin te/ 'di dag la longs spyad du gsol/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gi bsti gnas nags tshang tshing na bzhugs so/ /'od srung gis gdugs tshod la 'byon par zhus te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ched du 'od srungs rang nyid kyis lag bstar ba'i g.yos byas so/ /de nas spyan 'dren par phyin pa na/ 'od srung khyod nyid song zhig nga phyis 'ong ngo*/ /de nas ston pas rdzu 'phrul gyis shing dzambu tri sha'i 'bras bu'i snye ma blangs te lhung bzed bkang nas 'od srung gis bshams pa'i stan la bzhugs so/ /gsol pa/ lhung bzed na ci mchis/ ngas da lta dzambu'i snye ma blangs pa de/ 'dod na ci bde bar spyod cig ces 'od srung la stsal to/ /de bzhin du nangs bar nas kyang dzambu'i tshal dang nye ba'i gnas nas skyu ru ra chen po'i snye ma dang*/ byang sgra mi snyan nas ma rmos pa'i 'bras sā lu'ang bsnams nas de la stsal te gzhan snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /yang 'od srung gis gdugs tshod phul ba bsnams te mtha' gcig tu zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzad do/ /der chu zhig dgos par byung ba lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi lag pas drus te bkod ma'i chu chen po byung zhing babs par gyur la/ de la chu'i bya ba yang mdzad do/ /'od srung bsti gnas su 'chag pas mthong stai/

sngon med pa'i bkod ma'i chu 'di ci zhes zhus pas de'i tshul gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das yang dag 'jog las bzhengs te/ rdzing bu lag pas brkos pa zhes bya ba sngar gyi bkod ma de las byung ba'i rdzing bu la sku khrus mdzad cing*/ de'i 'gram na shing a rdzu na drang por skyes pa zhig yod pa la rdzing nas bzhengs par bzhed pa'i tshe/ a rdzu na'i yal ga rang dud cing byung ba la phyag gis 'jus shing bzhengs so/ /de nas 'od srung 'chag pas ardzu na'i yal ga sngon ma dud pa las dud par mthong nas/ de'i rgyu zhus pas/ sngar gyi lo rgyus gsungs te/ shing 'di ni lag pas bzung ba'i ardzu na zhes bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyags dar khrod kyi sha na'i ras dag phyag tu son pa na de bkru bar bzhed de/ bkru ba'i snod med pa la brgya byin gyi bkas gnod sbyin dag gis ri brag cig nas rdo leb che la ring ba zhig blangs te phul ba'i steng du sha na'i ras rnams legs par bkrus so/ /yang de 'grem pa'i gzhi dgos par byung nas/ brgya byin gyi bkas rdo leb che la ring ba gzhan zhig kyang blangs te de la sha na'i gos legs par bkram mo/ /'od srung 'chag pa na de dag mthong ste/ sngon med pa'i rdo leb 'di dag ji ltar yin zhes gsol ba na/ sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams rgyas par gsungs te/ rdo leb 'di dag ni gnod sbyin gyis blangs pa zhes bya'o/ /de dag la sogs pa cho 'phrul lnga brgya'i bar du bstan pa'i tha ma ni/ dus gzhan zhig na char chen po babs te chu klung nai rāñdza na cher 'khrungs te/ mi gang lhag pa'i dpangs tsam gsar du rgyas so/ /de ltar nub gcig la chu gsar du zub pa na/ nangs par snga bar chu'i steng sa bud kyis gang ba bla gab med pa la zhabs kyis 'chag par mdzad do/ /'od srung gis bsams pa/ dge sbyong chen po la chus gnod par ma gyur tam snyam ste/ shing gcig pa'i gru la zhugs te btsal ba na bcom ldan 'das de ltar mdzad pa mthong ste/

dge sbyong chen po grur 'jug gam/ 'od srung 'jug go /de nas gru'i nang du phebs shing ji ltar gru la zhugs pa de bzhin du chu'i steng nas kyang gshegs/ chus gos pa med cing chu la 'jug cing gshegs pa dang*/ gru chu'i gting du 'gro zhing steng du 'phar ba la sogs de lta bu'i cho 'phrul bstan to/ /de ltar cho 'phrul de thams cad la dge sbyong chen po 'di ni mthu che zhing rdzu 'phrul che la ya mtshan che mod kyi/ bdag kyang dgra bcom pa ni yin no snyam ste rjes su slob par 'dod pa med do/ /de nas chu'i 'gram skams sar phebs te bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung khyod ni dgra bcom pa ma yin/ dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa'ang ma yin/ dgra bcom pa'i lam yang mi shes so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung 'di snyam du/ gau ta ma 'dis ni bdag gi sems mkhyen te/ bdag 'di'i slob mar bgyi'o snyam nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ bka' stsal pa/ re zhig khyod kyis 'khor la ltos shig khyod lta bu'i mi grags pa dang ldan pa ni 'khor la lta ba legs pa yin no/ /de nas 'od srung rang gi bsti gnas su song ste 'khor rnams la smras pa/ kho bo ni dge sbyong chen po'i drung du tshangs par spyod na shes ldan dag ci lta bu byed/ de dag gis smras pa/ bdag cag gis cung zad cig 'tshal ba de mkhan po la brten pa lags na/ bdag cag kyang de'i rjes su rab tu 'jug go /de nas bram ze'i khye'u ral pa can rnams kyis g.yang gzhi dang 'khar ba dang ril pa spyi blugs dag chu klung nai rāñdza na la dor te ston pa'i spyan sngar 'ongs pa na/ thams cad tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do/ /de dag gi yo byad rnams chus khyer ba chu klung 'od srung dang*/ ga ya 'od srung gyis mthong ste/

bdag cag gi tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la 'jigs pa byung bar ma gyur grang snyam nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral ba can 'tshol du song ba las/ des rab tu byung ste bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos nyan pa mthong ste de gnyis kyis smras pa/ 'od srung 'di mchog yin la de mchog ma yin nam/ lteng rgyas 'od srung gyis smras pa/ de de bzhin no/ /de gnyis kyis bsams pa/ dgra bcom par bkur ba 'di yang lan gnyis kyi bar du dge sbyong chen po'i spyan sngar rab tu byung bar khas blangs na/ bdag cag kyang rab tu byung ngo snyam ste/ bcom ldan 'das la rab tu 'byung bar zhus pas 'khor la rig par bya dgos pa sogs nas de gnyis 'khor nyis brgya lnga bcu re dang bcas pa tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i bar snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ral pa can stong rab tu byung ba dag bcas pa'i tshogs de lteng rgyas su ji tsam bzhed par bzhugs nas/ ga ya'i ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te/ ga ya mgo'i mchod rten gyi ri la bzhugs nas cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul ba du ma'ang mdzad de/ de'i don rtogs pa'i phyir du cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum gyi chos kyi rnam grangs gsungs pas ral pa can stong gis dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /so gnyis pa gzugs can snying bos bsu ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas mi ring ba nyid na rgyal po gzugs can snying po gnas lnga la smon par byed do/ /de'ang sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang*/ de blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba dang*/ des chos gsung pa dang*/ chos de'ang bdag gis rtogs pa dang*/ de las bslab pa yang dag len pa la smon pa'o/ /de'i tshe gzugs can snying po'i 'khor zho shas 'tsho ba ste nang gi las kyi bya ba spyod pa'i mi 'ga' zhig ljongs lta zhing song bas/ ga ya'i ri la bcom ldan 'das nyid dgra bcom pa stong dang thabs cig bzhugs shing cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa ston pa'i gzi byin mthong nas/

des blor ma chud cing log par sems pas rgyal po'i drung na song nas gnas ma yin pa'i dogs pas bzung ste phra ma smra bar byed na de rgyal pos bzlog go /de nas rgyal po gnas lnga la lhag par rtse gcig tu smon zhing sems par gyur la/ yang zho shas 'tsho ba gzhan 'ga' zhig gis mthong zhing thos nas/ gzhon nu don grub de mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos ston gyi/ de la lhas bkur ste mdzod cig ces bskul ba rgyal po'i yid du ches 'thad par gyur te/ rgyal pos nang mi zhig la spyan 'dren par bka' bsgos nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sku'i drung du btang zhing*/ des rgyal po'i ming gis zhabs la phyag btsal zhing*/ gnod pa chung ngam nyam nga ba nyung ngam 'tsho'am/ spyod pa yang ngam/ stobs dang bde ba dang sku nyams dang ldan nam/ reg par spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang lhan cig ji srid 'tsho'i bar du yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur bgyid na/ grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs su gsol zhes gzugs can snying po'i mchid rnams gsol ba dang*/ ston pas kyang cang mi gsung bar gnang ngo*/ /de nas nangs pa sangs rgyas dgra bcom stong dang lhan cig ga ya dang rgyal po'i khab kyi bar mchod rten legs par rab gnas kyi drung shing tang brang gi tshal du byon te bzhugs so/ /de rgyal pos thos nas rang nyid shing rtar zhugs te 'khor mang pos bskor nas/ bcom ldan 'das la blta zhing bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir pho brang nas phyir byung ba na/ der shing rta'i 'khor lo sa la bying ngo*/ /bdag gis ma legs pa zhig byas sam snyam dogs pa la/ lha rnams kyis smras pa/ khyod kyi las skyon can ma yin mod/ las mthun mang po btson ra na 'dug gi de rnams thongs shig der rgyal pos btson rnams btang ngo*/ /yang 'ongs pa na/ rgyal po'i dbu rgyan sgo'i ya them la thogs so/ /yang sngar bzhin dogs pa skyes te bsdad pa na/

lha rnams kyis las mthun mang po yul gzhan du las kyi mtha' byed du bcug 'dug gi de rnams spron zhigargyal pos kyang de thams cad bkug ste mthar gyis rgyal po nyid shing rta khri nyis stong dang*/ rta pa khri brgyad stong dang*/ bram ze dang*/ khyim bdag brgya stong du ma dang lhan cig song ste/ bzhon pa las babs nas tang brang gi tshal gyi kun dga' ra bar zhugs so/ /rgyal po'i mtshan ma lnga po dbu rgyan dang*/ gdugs dang ral gri dang*/ rin po ches brgyan pa'i lham dang nor bu'i yu ba can gyi rnga yab rnams phud cing bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phyin te phyag btsal nas/ btsun pa/ bdag ni ma ga dhā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po lags so zhes gsol pas/ rgyal po chen po de de bzhin te/ stan la 'dug cing*/ rgyal po yang phyogs gcig tu 'khod/ bram ze dang khyim bdag la la phyag 'tshal/ la la dga' ba'i gtam gsol/ 'ga' zhig rgyang ring po nas lta zhing 'khod do/ /de'i dus na bram ze dang khyim bdag mang po zhig gis lteng rgyas 'od srung kyang 'khor de na 'dug pa mthong ste/ ci dge sbyong chen po 'od srung gi drung du tshangs par spyod dam/ 'od srung dge sbyong chen po'i drung du tshangs par spyod pa yin snyam the tshom du gyur pa las/ ston pas de mkhyen te/ don de'i dbang du byas nas 'od srung dang zhu len 'ga' re mdzad nas/ bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung 'khor rnams skyo ba skyed cig

/de nas 'od srung stan gyi steng du mi snang bar gyur te/ phyogs bzhi'i nam mkha' la 'phags nas spyod lam rnam bzhi byed pa dang*/ 'od 'byin pa dang*/ ya ma zung gi cho 'phrul dag bstan nas ston pa'i spyan sngar lus btud de/ bcom ldan 'das ni bdag gi ston pa lags so/ /bdag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos lags so/ /zhes lan gsum gsol zhing bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang mthun 'gyur mdzad/ lteng rgyas 'od srung gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag byas te stan la 'khod pa na/ skye bo thams cad the tshom dang bral zhing dad pa stobs su gyur pa na bdag med kyi don las brtsams te chos gsungs pas rgyal po gzugs can snying po dang lha brgyad khri dang bram ze dang khyim bdag sogs skye bo 'bum phrag du mas dus de nyid du bden pa mthong ngo*/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu 'byon par zhus pa la yang cang mi gsung bar gnang ngo*/ /de nas rgyal po la sogs pa de rnams rang gnas su song zhing*/ ji tsam na dus la bab par mkhyen nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa ljongs rgyu zhing*/ rgyal po'i khab kyi shing drung dang nye bar byon pa rgyal pos gdugs tshod la spyan 'dren par snyam mnan nas/ de'i nangs par rgyal po rang nyid kyis lag bdar te bsod snyoms rgya cher phul nas/ gser gyi bya ma bum blangs nas chu sbrengs shing*/ 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan ta ka gnas pa sngar skyed mos tshal yin pa ston pa bzhugs pa'i gnas gtsug lag khang du byas te phul/ der bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa grong khyer rgyal po'i khab dang nye ba 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan ta ka'i kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te chos ston to/ /so gsum pa mchog zung gcig bstan pa ni/ de'i tshe kun tu rgyu nyer rgyal zhes bya ba shā ri'i bu dang*/ pang nas skyes zhes bya ba maud gal gyi bu ste kun tu rgyu gnyis po de 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas nas grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu phyin pa na/

grong khyer ca co nyung zhing rgyu 'grul nyung ste chem mer 'dug pa mthong ngo*/ /de gnyis kyis bsams pa/ e ma rgyal po gzhan gyi dmag tshogs kyis 'jigs pa'am/ yang na dge sbyong dang bram ze dbang che bar grags pa dag gnas pa las byung ngo snyam nas/ nub mo rgyu skar la bltas pas 'jigs pa ni med par shes so/ /nangs par dpral ris gsum byas te spyod yul du song ba na/ sngar de gnyis la skye bo 'bum phrag du ma phyi bzhin du 'brang ba las de nyin gcig kyang 'brang ba med do/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis kun tu rgyu gnyis po 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen zhing*/ de'ang spyod lam gyis 'dul ba yin pas/ 'phags pa rta thul la bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyis kun tu rgyu gnyis po la soms shigades kyang snga dro'i dus su spyod lam mchog gis bsod snyoms la zhugs pa'i tshe/ kun tu rgyu gnyis kyis kyang thag ring po nas mthong ste ngo mtshar skyes so/ /grong khyer nas phyir 'ong ba'i tshe dri bar bya'o snyam nas grong khyer du bya ba rnams mgyogs par byas te/ nyer rgyal sngon la grong khyer gyi phyir phyung ste lam thams cad 'dus 'dus pa'i mdo zhig tu bsgug cing 'dug go /ji zhig na 'phags pa rta thul yang grong khyer gyi phyir byung ba na/ nyer rgyal gyis smras pa/ khyod kyi ston pa ni gang yin/ gang gi phyir rab tu byung*/ su'i chos la dga'/ rta thul gyis smras pa/ kho bo'i ston pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das so/ /de'i phyir rab tu byung zhing de'i chos la dga'o/ /nyer rgyal gyis smras pa/ dge slong de'i phyir chos ston cig rta thul gyis smras pa/ chos rnams gang dag rgyu las byung ba dang*/ /de yi rgyu dang de 'gog gang yin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis bka' stsal te/ /de skad gsung ba'i tshul can dge sbyong che/ /de'i tshe nyer rgyal gyis bden pa mthong ste rta thul la thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/

skyob pa rnams kyi chos 'di yin/ /bskal mang bye ba khrag khrig tu/ /sngon chad ma mthong ma thos pa/ /'chi med mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /go 'phang 'di la rjes su rtogs/ /bcom ldan 'das de da ltar gang du bzhugs/ rta thul gyis smras pa/ 'od ma'i tshal 'di nyid na'o/ /de nas nyer rgyal yang pang na skyes kyi sar song nas bdud rtsi thob par brda sprad de/ sngar gyi tshigs bcad de brjod pas/ pang na skyes kyis kyang bden pa mthong zhing ched du brjod pa'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas kun tu rgyu gnyis kyis 'khor rnams la rig par byas te/ de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi rjes su rab tu 'jug par khas blangs nas/ kun tu rgyu gnyis po bram ze'i khye'u nyis brgya lnga bcu re dang bcas te 'od ma'i tshal du zhugs pa na/ 'phags pa rta thul shing drung na bzhugs pa mthong ste/ dang por bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur bya'am/ 'on te chos thos pa la bya snyam pa las/ chos thos pa la thog mar bya dgos par shes nas dang por rta thul gyi zhabs la phyag byas so/ /ston pas bka' stsal pa/ rgan nam yang na bzhon yang rung*/ /gang las chos ni rnam shes pa/ /de la thog mar phyag bya ste/ /bram ze gtsang mas me bzhin no/ /de nas de gnyis bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya phrag du mas bskor ba'i drung du 'ong ba na/ sku'i drung du ma phyin gong ston pas rgyang ring po nas gzigs tsam nas de gnyis kyi ched du brjod pa du ma mdzad de/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i mchog dang*/ shes rab can gyi mchog tu snga nyid nas lung bstan to/ /de'i tshe dge slong dgra bcom pa gcig gis ched du brjod de/ ston pa dgongs yul mtha' yas pa/ /skye rgu'i dbang po khyod mthar byon/ /bcom ldan srid pa mthar mdzad pas/ /grogs po nyer rgyal pang na skyes/ /de ltar 'ongs pa gzigs gyur nas/ /'od ma'i tshal du ma phyin par/ /tshogs mchog dbus su de gnyis ni/ /'di gnyis nga yi nyan thos kyi/

/mchog zung 'gyur zhes nges bstan te/ /gcig ni rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i mchog /gcig shos shes rab ldan pa yi/ /mchog tu 'gyur bar lung bstan mdzad/ /ces so/ /de nas nyer rgyal dang pang nas skyes pa la sogs pa bram ze'i rigs kyi kun tu rgyu lnga brgya dag bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag byas te rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol ba btab pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la dge slong dag tshur shog tshangs par spyad pa spyod cigaces bka' stsal pa'i mjug kho nar skra dang kha spu bregs nas zhag bdun lon pa tsam du gyur/ lag na ni lhung bzed dang bya ma bum thogs/ lus la ni chos gos rnam pa gsum g.yogs/ spyod lam ni bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pa ltar shin tu dul ba gyur te/ de'i tshe lha rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pas tshur shog bka' stsal pas/ /de dag mgo bregs lus la snam sbyar gyon/ /mod la dbang po rab zhi gnas gyur te/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pas lus zung bkab par gyur/ /zhes ched du brjod par byed do de'i tshe dge slong mang po bsod snyoms la zhugs pa na skye bo ma dad pa dag 'di skad ces/ sangs rgyas ma ga dhā dag gi /grong mchog rgyal po'i khab gshegs pas/ /yang dag rgyal bas kun khrid na/ /phyi nas ci zhig bkri bar bya/ /zhes zer ba na/ dge slong rnams kyis lan smra bar ma nus so/ /nangs par/ 'di na dpa' chen bde gshegs dang*/ /dam pa'i chos kyis bkri mdzad de/ /thams cad chos kyis bkri ba la/ /mkhas pa su zhig mi bzod byed/ /ces smros shig ces bka' stsal pa ltar byas pas spobs pa lan med do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu bsnyen par rdzogs nas zhag bco lnga lon pa na bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i drung du bsil yab g.yob cing 'dug go /de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyis kun tu rgyu sen rings la chos bstan pas sen rings kyis bden pa mthong zhing*/

shā ri'i bus dgra bcom pa len pa las sems rnam par grol ba thob bo/ /de nas ring po ma lon pa kho nar maud gal gyi bu la sogs pa kun tu rgyu lnga brgya yang dgra bcom pa nyid kyi 'bras bu mngon du byas te/ de yan chad nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po grangs nges pa dang bcas pa yin te/ dge slong dgra bcom pa stong drug brgya nyi shu'o/ /bden pa mthong nas dgra bcom pa ma thob kyi bar la cung zad re thogs pa'i skabs ma gtogs/ gzhan dgra bcom pa kho na'i 'khor yin pas so so skye bo'i dge 'dun med do/ /der dus cung zad gcig la thog ma'i dgra bcom pa brgya nyi shu dang*/ mchog zung gcig gi 'khor nyis brgya lnga bcu ni yul tha dad pa so sor ljongs rgyu zhing chos ston pa'i phyir gshegs la/ ral pa can stong rab tu byung ba dang*/ mchog zung gcig gi 'khor nyis brgya lnga bcu ni ston pa'i zhabs 'bring du chos nyan pa'i phyir 'dug pas na/ der stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun zhes grags so/ /de nas ni gang zag de dag tu ma nges mod/ phyis kyang ston pa'i sku drung du nyan thos kyi dge slong dgra bcom pa nyis brgya lnga bcu tsam tshogs pa nyid shas che bar grags so/ /gang gi tshe mchog zung gcig dgra bcom pa thob pa nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun nyin re bzhin phyogs thams cad du 'phel bar gyur pas grangs nges pa'i tshad gzung bar dka' ba nyid de/ de phyin chad nas dgra bcom pa dang*/ 'phags pa slob pa dang*/ so so skye bo yang rung ste ma nges pa sna tshogs pa'o/ /so bzhi pa klu e la'i 'dab btul ba ni/ yang bcom ldan 'das yul kā shi'i ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te/ drang srong smra ba ri dwags kyi nags su bzhugs shing chos ston to/ /lnga sde la sogs pa nags tshal dang 'brog dgon par gnas pa rnams sdig sbrul dang gcan gzan dang nyi lhags dang char pa la sogs pas mi bde bar gyur te/

de'i tshe khyim bdag bzang ldan nam dge legs zhes bya bas gtsug lag khang byas te phul lo/ /de'i gong du e la'i 'dab ces bya ba'i klu zhig gis lcang lo can du phyin nas 'di skad du/ rgyal po bdag po gang zhig ni/ /chags na rdul dang ldan pa yin/ /rdul med na ni rdul bral 'gyur/ /gang gis 'dir ni chags zhes brjod/ /ces sogs tshigs bcad gnyis sngaun gyi sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad yin te/ de lta bu rtsig logs la bris nas yod pa las/ gnod sbyin gser 'od zhes bya bas bklags shing blo la bzung nas yi ger bris nas klu'i rgyal po e la'i 'dab la gtad de/ 'di ni sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyi gsung yin na don sus kyang ma shes te/ gser 'bum dang lhan cig 'di khyer la 'di'i don shes na gser 'di sbyin no zhes grong khyer dang pho brang kun tu skor shigagal te smra ba yod na gser 'bum byin zhig med na ni grong khyer ma yin no zhes sgrogs la gzhan du song zhig ces byas so/ /de nas klu e la'i 'dab kyis bram ze'i gzugs su sprul nas/ de gnyis thogs te grong khyer mang po zhig bskor kyang lan 'debs pa med pas grong khyer ma yin par bsgrags shing smad nas mthar wā rā na sīr song ngo*/ /der yang lan smra ba ma rnyed nas smod par brtsams pa la mi rnams na re/ dgon pa ba rnams la dris shog zer ro/ /drang srong nyon mongs med kyi slob ma mi byin der 'ongs pa dang 'phrad nas zhag bdun nas lan 'debs par khas blangs te/ mi byin dang lnga sde 'dris shes su yod pas lnga sde rnams la dris pa na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus shig zer ro/ /mi byin gyis sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ba sngar ma thos pa las/ der thos nas dga' ba skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du song nas zhabs la phyag byas te 'dug pa la/ ston pas chos bstan pas de nyid du bden pa mthong*/

rab tu 'byung bar zhus pa la/ khyod kyis klu bram ze'i gzugs su sprul pa la dam bcas pa'i don 'di gyis la/ phyis rab tu byung zhig de nas mi byin gyis ston pa la tshigs bcad de'i don dri ba zhus shing*/ ston pas kyang don rgyas par gsungs/ de nas mi byin gyis kyang klu bram ze'i gzugs kyi thad du song nas rgyas par brjod pas/ klu e la'i 'dab des kyang sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon par shes nas/ rang nyid 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i cha byad du sprul nas ston pa'i spyan sngar song ba na/ 'khor so so skye bo rnams kyis mthong nas de la yid g.yengs shing smon par byed pa na/ ston pas bka' drag po phab ste/ khyod rang gi cha lugs kyis shog cig ces bka' stsal pa na/ bdag cag klu rnams la dgra mchis so zhes zhus pas/ gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon lag na rdo rje la klu e la'i 'dab la gzhan gyis gnod pa srungs shig par bka' bsgos te/ de'i tshe klu'i rgyal po de rang gzugs sbrul gyi rnam pa 'jug ma ni grong khyer rdo 'jog nas 'ong yang mgo bo wā rā na sīr sleb pa'i lus shin du ring ba/ mgo bo bdun pa mgo bo re re la yang shing e la'i sdong po bdun bdun skyes pa/ 'bu sbrang brgya phrag du mas gtsos pa zhig byung ngo*/ /der 'khor so so skye bo rnams skrag pa la sngar khyed rnams gang la smon par byed pa'i gnas 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i gzugs can de ni 'di yin no zhes bstan pas/ de rnams 'jigs shing skyo bas 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur la/ de nas klu de skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gnas la bkod cing*/ ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas byams pas lung ston par dbugs phyung bas klu de yang mi snang bar song ngo*/ /de nas mi byin yang tshur shog gis bsnyen bar rdzogs te/ de ni 'phags pa kā tya ya na chen po yin

no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de la yod pa dang med pa'i mtha' gnyis la mi brten pa'i tshul gyis chos bstan pas kā tya ya nas dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /de nas mi ring ba'i dus gzhan zhig na/ ston pa 'khor dang bcas pa yul ma ga dhār bzhugs so/ /so lnga pa 'phags rgyal 'dul bar mngags pa ni/ de'i tshe nub phyogs kyi yul mā la ba'i grong khyer 'phags rgyal na rgyal po gtum po rab snang rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong ba na/ yul der yams nad chen po byung ste/ sngags mkhan rnams yams nad zhi ba'i thabs la brtson par byed kyang re zhig ma zhi'o/ /de'i tshe gdul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ 'phags pa kā tya ya na 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa la rgyal po rab snang la sogs pa 'phags rgyal gyi skye bo rnams 'dul bar bka' stsal te/ de rnams 'phags te byon pa na/ bar lam gyi yul grong khyer ka n+ya ku pa dza na/ sngon 'phags pa kā tya ya na dang mdza' bshes su gyur pa'i bram ze zhig la bu mo gzugs bzang ba ming skra can zhes bya ba zhig yod do/ /de'i tshe lho phyogs nas 'ongs ba'i gar mkhan gyi slob dpon zhig gis de'i skra mthong nas pha bram ze la skra 'di nga la tshongs shig gser ba ṇa stong 'jal lo/ /bram zes tshig drag pos spyos te ma btsongs pa las/ phyi de nyin bram ze rang nyid shi'o/ /de nas mi ring bar kā tya ya na 'khor bcas 'byon no zhes bram ze'i chung mas thos nas/ de ni bram ze de'i chung grogs yin na/ 'dir 'ongs pa la mgron mchod byar med do snyam nas shin tu yid khong du chud pa la/ bu mos dris pas don de bshad pa na/ 'o na bdag gi skra tshongs shig byas

so/ /der yang gar mkhan gyi slob dpon de la dris pas/ da ni mi dgos mod 'on kyang pa ṇa lnga brgyar 'tshong na blang ngo zer ro// der skra btsongs te pa ṇa lnga brgya blangs/ 'phags pa kā tya ya na 'khor dang bcas pa la gdugs tshod gsol ba'i mchod pa bzang por byas so/ /de nas bram ze mo chos nyan pa'i phyir 'dug pa na/ 'phags pas skra can ga re zhes dris pa na/ spyod lam nyams te mchis so zhes sngar gyi lo rgyus gsol to/ /de nas 'phags pa'i zhabs drung du skra can bos te zhabs la phyag 'tshal du bcug/ der bram ze mos skra can 'di su la sbyin zhus pas/ rab tu byung ba la 'tsham pa ma yin pa zhig dris mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'di gang la sbyin pa de las sbas pa'i rgyan lnga brgya/ phyi'i rgyan lnga brgya/ grong gi mchog lnga brgya thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan te byon pa las/ gang gi tshe 'phags pa 'khor bcas grong khyer 'phags rgyal du byon pa'i mod kho na la/ nad gtong ba'i mi ma yin shas che ba dag ring du bros te/ yams nad kyi phyed tsam zhi'o/ /grong khyer gyi sgo srung pas cha byad sngon ma mthong ba'i dge sbyong lnga brgya grong khyer 'dir 'ongs pa'i mod la yams kyi phyed zhi'o zhes rgyal po la gsol bas rgyal po dgyes so/ /bram ze rnams ni bdag cag gis zhi ba'i las byas pa'i mthu'o zhes zer/ der rgyal pos glang po che'i bres mi gtsang ba'i sa phyogs su kā tya ya na sogs dge slong lnga brgya dang*/ bram ze rnams bos te kha zas ngan pa dag bstabs so/ /phyir byung ba na/ rgyal pos mi zhig do gal med par ltar byas te/ rnyed bkur bzang ngan 'drir bcug pas/ bram ze rnams ni rgyal po la ngan du smra/ dge slong rnams ni sbyin pa pos ni byin/ len pa pos ni blangs/ 'byung ba rnams tshims te nyin zhag gcig gi rgyags blangs so/ /zhes zer ba rgyal po la bsnyad do/ /yang nangs par gnas khang gtsang mar sde gnyis ka bos te kha zas bzang pos bstabs shing*/

phyogs gzhan du mi gzhan zhig sngar ltar 'drir bcug pas bram ze rnams ni rgyal po la bstod/ dge slong rnams ni snga ma kho na bzhin du zer ro/ /de bzhin du rta'i bres la sogs pa mang por sngar bzhin yang yang brtags pas dge slong rnams 'gyur ba med cing*/ bram ze rnams ni sred pas zas ngo la lta zhing 'phral 'phral du ngo 'gyur bar shes nas/ yon gnas mchog ni dge slong du nges pa rnyed pas yang yang mchod cing*/ lan cig bro gar rtse ba du ma yod pa la rgyal pos glu gar bzang ngan dris pas/ dge slong rnams kyis ma thong zhing ma thos so zhes lan btab pas rgyal po yid ma ches pa la/ chad pas gsod dgos pa la thug pa'i mi zhig gi lag tu snum gyis kha da chad du gang ba'i gzhong pa gtad/ thigs pa gcig bo yang gsod do zhes sdigs nas/ bro gar rtse ba rnams kyi mdun na phar lam byas te 'gror bcug go /de'i rjes su glu dang rol mo ji lta bu mthong zhes 'drir bcug pas/ bdag ni gsod pas 'jigs te gang yang ma mthong ngo zhes so/ /der 'phags pas gsungs pa/ 'di tshe gcig gi sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs pas bag yod pa'ang 'di 'dra na/ dge slong rnams tshe rabs du ma'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs pas bag yod kun tu srung ba lta ci smos gsung*/ de nas rgyal po lhag par yang dad de 'phags pa 'khor bcas la cher mchod nas/ 'phags pa la mchod pa 'di lta bus mchod pa gzhan yod dam/ zhes zhus pas/ 'di tsam ngo mtshar mi che yi/ bu mo zhig la yo byad gzhan gang yang med do/ /rang gi skra pa na lnga brgya la btsongs te 'di ltar tshim par byas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyal pos pa na lnga brgyar 'doms pa'i skra dang ldan pa ni lha rnams kyi nang na yang dkon no snyam ste zho shas 'tsho ba rnams slong du btang nas/ bram ze'i bu mo skra can ma de 'byor ba chen pos btsun mor blangs shing*/ sbas pa'i rgyan lnga brgya la sogs pa yang ma bram ze mo la byin no/

/skra can ma 'phags rgyal du nam sleb pa na yams nad kyi lhag ma rnams kyang mod la zhi bas btsun mo ba zhes ming du btags so/ /skabs 'dir 'phros don gyi lo rgyus ni/ de lta bu'i rjes thogs la min yang*/ de nas ring zhig lon pa'i dus gzhan zhig na rgyal pos phra men ma mang po yang bsad/ bram ze mang po dag la mchod ston ster ba ltar byas te tshogs pa la/ thog ma nas brda sbyar te bram ze re re'i rgyab tu gshed ma re bsdad de/ zho long zhig ces brjod pa na thams cad kyis mgo bcad de dus gcig tu bsad do/ /der de'i nub mo rgyal po'i rmi lam du/ lo ni stong phrag drug cu dang*/ /lo ni brgya phrag drug cu ru/ /sems can dmyal bar 'tshed rnams kyis/ /nam zhig mthar ni phyin par 'gyur/ /zhes pa la sogs pa sa bla'i sgra drug dang*/ 'di la snying po tsam zhig lus/ /thams cad gsog tu phyung zin te/ /rgyal bo srin de snying po la/ /dga' ba med pas re ba bor/ /zhes pa la sogs pa bar snang gi sgra drug kyang thos/ lus la tsan dan dkar pos byugs pa dang*/ dmar pos gtor ba dang*/ mgo la me 'bar ba dang*/ mchan khung gnyis nas sbrul re 'phyang ba dang*/ rkang pa gnyis la nya mkhar ba re ldag pa dang*/ ngang pa gnyis nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang*/ ri nag po zhig mdun nas 'ong ba dang*/ chu skyar gyi mgo la mi gtsang ba 'thor ba ste rmi ltas brgyad rmis so/ /nangs par bram ze rnams la dris pas/ bzang bar shes kyang log par ston dgos so snyam nas/ mchog lnga bsad pa'i khrag la khrus byed dgos pa sogs smras so/ /gtam des rgyal po ma mgu ba la zhi bas bskul nas kā tya ya na la zhus pas/ rmi lam bzang gi ma 'jigs shig ces dbugs phyung nas/ sa bla'i sgra drug ni/ rgyal po khyod kyi pha mes rim pa drug tsam chos dang ma yin pa 'dres pas rgyal srid byas te/ dmyal bar skyes pa rnams sdug bsngal myong bas sngon gyi tshul la 'gyod de smras pa'o/

/bar snang gi sgra drug las dang po ni/ khyod kyi khyim gyi gdung snying po ma gtogs pa phal cher srin bus zos zin pas gdung de spos shig gnyis pa ni rta rdzi gnyen len gyis bya rog mo'i sgo nga thams cad bton pa ste phyin chad tshang 'joms su ma 'jug cig gsum pa ni skyed mos tshal gyi rdzing bu'i chu bskams nas chu skyar skyo ba ste rdzing chus khongs shig bzhi pa ni ri bo gtum ldan nas glang pau che gzhon nu zhig bzung 'dug pas/ des pha ma long ba dag dran te rtswa mi za chu mi 'thung bar smre sngags 'don pa ste de thong zhigalnga pa ni khyod kyis ri dwags cig bzung ba des zla bo dran pas smras pa ste de'ang thong zhigadrug pa ni khyod kyis ngang pa cig bzung ba de ngang pa gzhan 'phur 'gro ba mthong pas yid skyo ba ste de'ang thong zhig rmis ltas brgyad kyi dang po ni/ rgyal po khyod la lus 'phags kyi rgyal bos be'u ras skyais su bskur ba dang*/ gnyis pa ni sa 'dzin gyi rgyal bos lwa ba rin po che dmar po zhig dang*/ gsum pa ni ya ba na'i rgyal pos gser gyi phreng ba zhig dang*/ bzhi pa ni rgya yul gyi rgyal bos ral gri zung zhig dang*/ lnga pa ni sing gā la'i rgyal pos nor bu'i lham zung zhig dang*/ drug pa ni ba ga la'i rgyal pau'i rta gnyis dang*/ bdun pa ni ka ling ka'i rgyal po'i glang po che'i gtso bo zhig skyes su bskur ba'i ltas te/ de rnams zhag bdun gyi nang du 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ brgyad pa ni khyod dang zhi ba gnyis kyis shes so/ /'on kyang bram ze rnams la ngan sems ma skyed cig /ces gsungs pas rgyal po srog rnyed pa bzhin rab tu dga' zhing ji skad gsungs pa rnams bsgrubs/ zhag bdun gyi khongs su skyes rnams kyang sleb ste/ rgyal po rab tu dad nas skyes kyi dang po be'u ras yug chen 'phags pa kā tya ya na la phul/ gzhan mchog lnga la ci 'dod khyer zhes 'dam du bcug pas/

btsun mo zhi bas gser phreng*/ btsun mo skya sengs bu mo sgrol mas lwa ba/ sras gzhon nu ba lang skyong gis rta gnyis/ blon po gsos pas ral gri/ bram ze mdun na 'don gyis lham 'dams so/ /glang po che ni rgyal po nyid la'o/ /de nas rgyal po rab snang gis 'phags pa kā tya ya na dge 'dun dang bcas pa la rgyal srid phul yang bzhes su ma gnang*/ 'dod pa thams cad la stobs kyis spyod pa'i rgyal srid phyed phul yang bzhes su ma gnang*/ longs spyod dang yo byad kyi mchog 'bul bar zhus pa la/ kā ta'i bus 'phags rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang nas ston pa la zhus shing*/ ston pas 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed cing*/ mnyan yod nas bka'i gnang ba stsal ba/ kā tya ya nas lha'i rna bas gsan te zhu ba zhu lan mdzad do/ /skye bo phyi rabs la snying brtse ba'i phyir dang*/ sbyin bdag gi longs spyod 'phel pa'i phyir dge 'dun la ni de lta bu gnang gi gang zag la ni ma yin no/ /longs spyod ni grong dang zhing ngo*/ /longs spyod kyi mchog ni ba lang dang ma he dang*/ ra lug la sogs pa rnams so/ /zhes sogs gsungs shing rgyal pos yo byad phun sum tshogs pa'i gtsug lag khang mang po dang*/ longs spyod dang longs spyod kyi mchog rnams phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun la phul lo/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis nga'i dge bsnyen rnams kyi nang nas dge 'dun la thog mar 'dod pa thams cad kyis stob pa'i mchog rab snang ngo zhes lung bstan zhing*/ bshos 'bul ba'i mchog gzugs can snying po/ gnas mal 'bul ba'i mchog mgon med zas sbyin/ gtsug lag khang byed pa'i mchog khyim bdag bzang ldan no/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /rgyal po gtum po rab snang de la yod pa'i mchog lnga ni gong du bshad pa de dag yin zhing*/ nye ba'i mchog lnga ni glang po che 'dam bu ri zhes bya ba nyi ma gcig la dpag tshad brgya chod pa dang*/ glang mo bzang ldan zhes bya ba nyin gcig la dpag tshad brgyad cu chod pa dang*/

rnga mong rgya mtsho'i rkang zhes bya ba nyin gcig la dpag tshad bdun cu chod pa dang*/ rta gos mgrin zhes bya ba nyi ma gcig la dpag tshad lnga bcu chod pa dang*/ 'phar ma ba ste pho nya ba khwa ta zhes bya ba nyin gcig la dpag tshad nyi shu chod pa rnams so/ /de ltar na re zhig nyan thos theg pa'i lugs ltar na grong khyer 'phags rgyal du ston pas dngos su zhabs kyis ma bcags pa'i dbang du byas bas/ 'phags pa kā tya ya na der mngags pa nyid ston pa dngos kyi mdzad par 'gyur zhing*/ 'phrin las kyi rnam thar che ba'i sde tshan gcig yin te/ de'i phyir skabs 'dir bkod do/ /so drug pa khyim bdag me skyes btsas pa ni/ yang bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bzhugs te/ de na khyim bdag rab bzang zhes bya ba ches longs spyod dang ldan pa zhig mu stegs gcer bu pa la lhag par dad pas gnas so/ /de'i tshe ston pa khyim der bsod snyoms la gshegs pa na/ khyim bdag de'i chung ma mngal sems can dang ldan pa la/ ston pas 'di la bu pho btsa' zhing rigs gsal bar byed/ lha mi'i dpal 'byor nyams su myong ste nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan/ der kha zas mchog gis lhung bzed bkang ste bsod snyoms phul lo/ /ston pa phyir gshegs pa na/ der gcer bu pa dag bdag cag gi yon bdag 'di gau ta mas kha drangs so snyam der song ste dris pas sngar bzhin bshad pa na/ gcer bu pa de dag gis rdo rgyus blangs te rtsis btab pas bden par shes mod/ 'di bden par lung bstan to zhes brjod na 'di dag dge sbyong gau ta ma la lhag par dad pa skyer 'ong snyam nas de dag gis smras pa/ bu phor btsa' ba dang*/ rigs gsal bar byed zer ba ni bden te/ gsal ba ni me yin pas btsas nas mi ring bar khyim mes 'tshig go /lha mi'i dpal 'byor myong ba ni mi bden te lha'i dpal 'byor mis myong ba med pa'i phyir ro/

/rab tu 'byung ba ni bden te des bza' rgyu med nas rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom par 'gyur ba ni mi bden te/ re zhig gau ta ma nyid la'ang dgra bcom pa med na de'i nyan thos la lta ci smos/ de nas khyim bdag rab bzang mi dga' bar gyur te/ chung ma la mngal 'jig par byed pa'i sman byin yang sems can de srid pa tha ma pa yin pas gnod pa med kyi steng du phan zhing rgyas par gyur/ ma'i dku khu tshur gyis mnyes pas kyang g.yas g.yon du phan tshun bros te 'gro zhing*/ bud med des cho nges kyis btab pa na/ khyim mtshes kyis dris pas bu skye'o zhes byas so/ /de nas cho nges btab pa na gzhan gyis tshor gyis dogs te nags tshal dben par song nas bud med de'i dku gnyes pa thal ches te bud med de rang shi ba na/ phung po khyim du khyer te rab bzang gi chung ma shi'o zhes byas nas yang dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du bskyl lo/ /der gcer bu pa dag dga' ste/ da ni gau ta mas lung bstan pa thog tu ma bab po zhes sgrog par byed do/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das zhal 'dzum pa mdzad de/ zhal gyi sgo las 'od zer spros te las gnyis mdzad de zhal nyid du thim mo/ /rgyu zhus pas/ deng dur khrod du gshegs dgos kyi dge slong dag chos gos longs shig /ces gsungs te bcom ldan 'das 'khor lha mi brgya stong du mas bskor te dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du gshegs so/ /lam kha na bram ze'i khye'u zhig dang*/ rgyal rigs kyi khye'u zhig gtam 'gro bar byed pa las/ bram ze'i khye'u na re/ gau ta ma'i lung bstan brdzun par ma gyur grang*/ rgyal rigs na re/ gza' dang skar ma'i tshogs chen sa la lhung yang srid/ /sa 'di ri thang nags bcas mkha' la 'gro yang srid/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i chu ni skam par 'gyur srid kyi/ /drang srong chen po rdzun gsung 'gyur ba srid pa min/ /de nas de gnyis kyang ston pa'i drung du phyin te/

rgyal rigs kyi khye'u des ched du brjod pa'i tshigs bcad byas so/ /ston pa dur khrod du byon pa thos nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po 'khor bcas kyang der 'ongs/ bcom ldan 'das stan la bzhugs nas zhal 'dzum pa mdzad pa gcer bu pas mthong nas khyim bdag rab bzang la bos te/ skal chad de da dung ma shi'o byas so/ /de nas khyim bdag des chung ma'i ro me la bsregs pas gzhan thams cad tshig kyang lto ba'i nye skor de yun ring du ma tshig go /ji zhig na de brdol te me tog padma chen po byung la padma de'i snying po la khye'u lta na sdug pa zhig 'dug go /der skye bo rnams ngo mtshar skyes shing gcer bu pa rnams gdong smad de 'dug go /ston pas khyim bdag la gzhon nu long shig ces gsungs pas/ de gcer bu pa'i gdong du lta zhing 'dug pa la/ gcer bu pas khyod nyid tshig par 'gyur ro zhes smras pas ma blangs so/ /ston pas 'tsho byed gzhon nu gsos la gzhon nu long zhig ces bka' stsal bas/ des the tshom med par me nang du zhugs te blangs pa na mes gnod pa lta ga la zhig ste/ tsan dan sa mchog gi reg pa ltar bsil ba sngar ma myong ba'i bde ba'i reg pa myong bar gyur to/ /de nas khyim bdag la khye'u long shig ces byas na/ de gcer bu pa'i gdong du lta'o/ /gcer bu pa rnams na re/ 'di blangs na khyim 'tshig la/ khyod nyid kyang srog dang 'bral lo zhes zer bas des ma blangs so/ de nas ston pas gzugs can snying po la khye'u 'di long zhig ces bka' stsal pas rgyal pos blangs te/ ming me skyes zhes btags so/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo mang po 'dus pa de dag la chos bstan pas/ phal cher zhig dgra bcom pa nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i bar la bkod do/ /de nas mi skyes ma ma brgyad la gtad cing*/ rgyal po'i pho brang du skyed bsrings pa las dus gzhan zhig na me skyes kyi zhang po yul gzhan nas 'khor te 'ongs pas sngar gyi tshul rnams zhib por thos nas/
khyod kyis khye'u spangs 'dug pa da len na legs/ mi len na deng nas gnyen du mi brtsi la/ rab yig kyang 'dor/ nga'i sring mo bsad pa'i dril yang sgrog

/rgyal po la'ang zhus te chad pa chen po gcod do zhes sdigs pas/ de shin tu skrag pas rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i drung du song ste gzhon nu bdag la zhu'o zhes zhus so/ /rgyal pos kyang sangs rgyas la zhus/ ston pas kyang bkas gnang ste/ gzhon nu rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan/ glang po che la bskyon te pha'i khyim du btang ngo*/ /de nas ring zhig lon pa'i phyis rab bzang shi nas me skyes khyim bdag tu gyur pa de'i tshe lha'i 'byor pa nyams su myong ba yin no/ /so bdun pa 'bar ba'i phug tu lha rnams la chos bstan pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'khor brgyad khri dang bcas pa bden pa la 'god par bzhed nas 'od ma'i tshal du mi snang bar gyur te/ rgyal po'i khab kyi lho phyogs bram ze'i grong a mra'i nags khrod kyi byang*/ ri lus 'phags kyi dbang po'i brag phug tu gshegs nas me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de'i tshe lha'i dbang po brgya byin lha dbang che ba brgyad khri dang*/ bde sog ma la sogs pa lha'i bud med rnams dang*/ grogs po dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa 'khor du ma dang bcas pa dang yang lhan cig tu lus 'phags kyi ri la 'ongs nas/ rab tu bltas na sku las 'phros pa'i me dpung gi gzi brjid ma bzod de drung du bsnyen par ma nus so/ /brgya byin dang zur phud lnga pa bgros te/ zur phud lnga pa dri za lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu bai ḍurya'i pi wang blangs te tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis lha rnams la chos ston par gsol ba btab cing bskul lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs shing dbang po'i brag phug der lha de dag thams cad 'khod du rung bar byin gyis brlabs pas/ brgya byin 'khor dang bcas pa dag der 'ongs shing zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas mchod pa dpag tu med pas mchod/ bar der lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang zhu lan mang du mdzad de/

brgya byin mgu bas/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /gang zag khyod kyi zla ma mchis/ /dpa' bo chen po khyed la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ de nas ston pas chos bshad pa des brgya byin lha'i gtso bo brgyad khri dang bcas pa chos la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes te/ gnas der stan de la 'khod bzhin du bden pa mthong ba'i mjug thog kho nar brgya byin de tshe 'phos shing*/ 'phos ma thag slar yang gnas de nyid du brgya byin du skyes/ de ltar 'phos shing skyes pa ni/ mig 'dzum pa dang mi snang bar gyur pa'i reg pa'i skad cig la rtogs par 'gyur te/ brgya byin rang nyid dang bde sog ma las gzhan pa'i lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /de nas lha dang dri za de dag skyabs su song zhing*/ bslab pa'i gnas lnga yang dag par blangs te bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos lan gsum du phyag byas zhing*/ lan gsum du bskor ba byas nas mdun gyis phyogs pas phyi nur du song ste bcom ldan 'das mig lam du mi mthong ba'i sar phyin pa na slar yang phyag byas te mi snang bar song ngo*/ /so brgyad pa mgon med zas sbyin bden pa la bkod pa ni/ de'i tshe mnyan yod na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin rang gi bu drug gi khyim ni phug zin/ bu bdun pa legs skyes kyi mna' ma len zhing khyim 'bubs pa'i don du gangs ri'i glang po brgya/ rta brgya/ gser gyi rgyan brgya/ dre'u'i shing rta brgya/ tho gar yul gyi bu mo brgya rnams mna' ma'i rin du khyer zhing*/ rgyal po gzugs can snying pos gsal rgyal la skyes su bskur rgyu'i gangs can gyi glang po che brgya len pa la sogs pa dgos pa 'ga' zhig gi phyir rgyal po'i khab tu 'ongs te/ mna' ma'i pha khyim bdag de'i khyim du nub mo 'dug pa las/ khyim bdag de nangs par sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa spyan drang par 'dod pas nam gyi gung la langs te/

g.yog 'khor dag dang lhan cig tu bza' bca' rgya che ba'i sta gon byed pa mgon med zas sbyin gyis mthong ste/ khyed ci bag ma gtong len byed dam/ tshong pa'i tshogs la ston mo'am/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po spyan 'dren sogs dris pas/ de dag ma yin te/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa gdugs tshod la spyan 'dren no zer ba na/ sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra thos pa tsam gyis ba spu zing zhes byed de sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun ji lta bu zhes dris pa na/ des kyang rgyas par bshad pas mgon med zas sbyin shin tu dad pa skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das de gang na bzhugs/ zhal lta bar rung ngam zhes dris pa la/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal na bzhugs te/ 'dir byon pa na nga mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes byas so/ /de nas mgon med zas sbyin sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i dran pa dang ldan pas cung zad nyal/ yang gnyid sad pa na snang ba'i 'du shes kyi dran pa'i mthu las mtshan mo'i dus de nyid du nam langs pa ltar phyogs thams cad gsal bar mthong*/ der langs te lho sgo'i phyogs nas 'gro ba'i tshe/ pho nya ba rgyu 'grul gyi don du sgo phye ba dang 'grigs nas grong khyer gyi phyi rol tu thon pa na nam ma langs te mun par 'dug go /der mi dang mi ma yin pas gnod par mi 'gyur grang snyam ste slar ldog par 'dod pa la sgo der gnas pa'i lhas/ phyogs de nas dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal gyi bar thams cad snang bas khyab par byas te/ 'di skad ces/ rta brgya dang ni gser rgyan brgya/ /dre'u'i shing rta brgya dang ni/ /sna tshogs nor gyis spung pa yi/ /rgod ma yi ni shing rta brgya/ /gom pa gcig gcig bor ba yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zhes slar mi ldog cing 'gro bar bskul bas/ khyod su zhig dris pas/ khyim bdag khyod nyid kyi grogs po rnying pa bram ze sbrang rtsi'i phung po yin te/ mchog zung gcig la dad cing shi bas lhar skyes nas lho sgo 'dir gnas so zhes zer

ro/ /de nas khyim bdag ya mtshan du gyur te bsil ba'i tshal du song ste/ bcom ldan 'das gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol na zhabs 'chag par mdzad par mthong nas snyun dris pas/ gang zhig 'dod pas ma gos la/ /zag med rab tu rnam grol ba/ /mya ngan yongs 'das bram ze ni/ /thams cad du ni bde bar mnal/ /zhes sogs bka' stsal te/ nang du byon nas gdan la bzhugs pa na/ khyim bdag gis kyang zhabs la phyag byas te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa la chos bstan pas de nyid du bden pa mthong zhing*/ ched du brjod nas dge bsnyen du gyur/ der zhus lan cung zad mdzad nas/ khyim bdag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod du gshegs shig dang*/ dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsnyen bkur bgyi'o/ /bka' stsal pa/ de na gtsug lag khang yod dam/ gsol ba ma mchis so/ /bka' stsal pa/ gang du gtsug lag khang yod pa der dge slong rnams 'ong ba dang 'gro ba dang gnas par sems so/ /gsol ba/ bdag gis ci nas kyang gtsug lag khang brtsig go /bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo*/ /so dgu pa rgyal byed kyi tshal bzhengs pa ni/ de nas mgon med zas sbyin gyis rgyal po'i khab tu rang gi bya ba sgrub dgos pa rnams grub pa na/ ston pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal du 'ongs nas/ bdag la dge slong gcig grogs su stsal tu gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bus 'dul bar mkhyen nas bka' gnang ngo*/ /'phags pa shā ri'i bu yang nangs bar bsod snyoms spyad cing gnas mal ma khos su phab nas/ mnyan yod kyi phyogs su rgyu zhing gshegs/ khyim bdag gis kyang tshur lam mnyan yod kyi 'khor gyi kun dga' ra ba dang*/ skyed mos tshal dang*/ nags tshal thams cad du rnam par brtags shing 'ongs pa na/ gtsug lag khang gi sa gzhi la rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi kun dga' ra ba ni yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan par mthong ngo*/ /rgyal bu rgyal byed ces bya ba de ni rgyal bo gsal rgyal gyi spun zlar gyur ba zhig go

/de nas mgon med zas sbyin gzhon nu rgyal byed kyi drung du song nas/ kun dga' ra ba bdag la stsol zhigader sangs rgyas kyi gtsug lag khang rtsig pa lags/ zhes smras pa*/ rgyal byed khas mi len no/ /lan gsum du bslongs pas gsum pa la rgyal byed na re/ kun dga' ra ba gser gyi bye ma khebs par gshibs kyang nga mi gtong ngo*/ /zas sbyin gyis smras pa/ gzhon nu kun dga' ra ba'i rin thang ni bcad zin gyis gser gyis gser long shig /de nas de gnyis rin thang bcad ma bcad la rtsod par gyur to/ /de nas zhal lce gcod pa rnams kyi gan du song ba na/ 'jig rten skyong ba rgyal chen bzhi zhal lce gcod pa'i mi bzhir sprul te/ de rnams kyis gzhon nu rin thang bcad zin gyi gser long shig /kun dga' ra ba 'di khyim bdag gis yin no zhes zer bas rgyal byed kyis thabs ma rnyed do/ /de nas mgon med zas sbyin gyis shing rta la sogs pa mang pos gser bskyas te kun dga' ra ba'i sa gzhi thams cad la bkrams na/ phal cher khebs kyang phyogs 'ga' zhig ma khebs par mthong nas/ de dang 'tsham pa'i gter zhig gang du yod bsams shing phyogs rnams su bltas pa na/ rgyal byed kyis smras pa/ khyim bdag 'gyod pa skyes na gser slar longs shig /kun dga' ra ba ni nga nyid kyi'o/ khyim bdag gis don de rgyas par bshad pa na/ rgyal byed kyis bsams pa/ kye ma sangs rgyas 'byung ba ni mchog yin te/ 'di yis kun dga' ra ba'i ched du nor 'di snyed cig gtong na/ bdag gis kyang cung zad cig bya'o snyam nas/ 'o na gser ma bkram pa'i sa phyogs 'di bdag la byin cig / bdag gis kyang sgo khang brtsig par bya'o/ /zhes bgros nas khyim bdag dang gzhon nu yang blo mthun par byas so/ /de nas gtsug lag khang rtsig par byas pa na/ mu stegs byed rnams 'dus te mgon med zas sbyin gyi drung du lhags nas/ kye kho bo cag gis grong khyer bgo bsha' byas zin te/

dge sbyong gau ta ma'i ni rgyal po'i khab yin la/ nged cag gi ni mnyan yod yin na/ gau ta ma'i phyir khyod gtsug lag khang ma rtsigs shig /ces zer ba la khyim bdag gis de rnams la/ khyed cag grong khyer bgo bsha' byas srid kyang*/ nga'i nor khyed cag gis ma bgos pas rang gang la mngon par dga' ba'i chos kyi phung po rtsig go /de nas rgyal po'i drung du song nas kyang sngar bzhin gleng ba la/ khyim bdag gi gshags kyis pham par byas kyang da dung mu cor sna tshogs smra zhing gtsug lag khang ci dgar rtsig tu mi gzhug gi /gau ta ma'i nyan thos kyi mchog de dang nus pa 'gran te/ gal te de rgyal bar gyur na rtsigs shig ces zer bas/ khyim bdag gis shā ri'i bu la zhus pas/ mu stegs de dag gi rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba'ang yod la/ de dag bdag nyid kyis 'dul ba la rag las par yang mkhyen nas khyim bdag de bzhin du bya ste/ 'on kyang zhag bdun nas so/ /des mu stegs rnams la brjod pas/ de rnams gros byas te da lta nus pa mi ston par phyi dus 'debs pa ni yang na ni 'di 'bros/ yang na ni phyogs 'tshol te/ bros na ni der zad pas re shig bdag cag kyang phyogs 'tshol lo zhes thams cad bkram ste/ nyin zhag gi rim pa bgrang zhing tsab tsab por phyogs 'tshol ba las/ kun tu rgyu mig dmar zhes bya ba mig 'phrul la shin tu byang ba zhig yod pa de rnyed nas grogs bcol lo/ /de dag tu nyin re bzhin gdul byar gyur pa'i skye bo mang po yang 'dus/ zhag bdun lon pa na sa phyogs shin tu yangs par stan bshams/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu seng ge'i khri la bzhugs shing zhal 'dzum pa sngon du btang nas 'dul ba'i skye bo rnams la gzigs so/ /de nas mu stegs byed rnams dang ltad mo ba'i skye bo dpag tu med pa 'dus pa na/ kun tu rgyu mig dmar gyis shing sa ha kā ra me tog rgyas pa sprul pas/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bus rlung dmar dang char drag po btang nas shing rnams rtsa ba nas bcag cing bton la gtor ro/

/yang padma'i rdzing bu sprul pa la/ glang po che mang po sprul nas dkrugs shing brdzis la lhag ma med par byas so/ /sbrul mgo bdun pa btang ba la/ mkha' lding mang po sprul nas drangs shing zos so/ /mthar des ro langs rbad pa na/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bus ro langs la phur bus btab bo/ 'di ni chos nyid de ro langs btang ba la pha rol pos phur bus btab na/ gtong ba po nyid gsod pa yin pas ro langs slar ldog ste mig dmar la sogs pa mu stegs rnams bdas pas/ de dag 'jigs skrag nas mgon skyabs gzhan med de/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu la skyabs su song bas 'phags pas phur bu phyung ba na ro langs zhi bar gyur to/ /de nas kun tu rgyu mig dmar dad pas rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs la chos bstan pas dgra bcom pa'i bar du gyur to/ /'phags pa shā ri'i bus 'khor tshogs 'dus pa thams cad la bsam pa ji lta bar chos bstan pas lha dang mi'i skye bo mtha' yas pas bden pa mthong zhing*/ skal ba dang 'tsham par byang chub rnam pa gsum la gzhol par gyur to/ /da dung bden pa ma mthong ba'i mu stegs can mang po dag glags lta zhing skabs 'tshol bar 'dod nas/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi drung du lhags te smre sngags 'don bzhin bdag cag gla mi bya ste gtsug lag khang rtsig tu chug cig/zer ba na khyim bdag gis kyang shes bzhin du khas blangs nas de dag de ltar byed du bcug pa na/ lan cig de dag las byed pa'i nye logs shing drung zhig na 'phags pa shā ri'i bu 'chag cing bzhugs so/ /der skye bo gzhan med pa'i skabs shig mu stegs de rnams kyis 'phags pa shā ri'i bu 'gags te shing la dpyangs nas bkrong bar bsams te thag pa thogs shing drung du 'ongs tai mtha' bskor ba na/ 'phags pas las byed pa'i rgyab mi gyad stobs pau che'i lus can lcags dbyug thogs pa mang po sprul te/ mu stegs de dag phan tshun du bdas shing brdung ba sogs sdigs pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pas 'phags pa la skyabs su gsol bas bde bar song*/

der de dag dad pa skyes shing chos bstan pas bden pa mthong la/ thams cad rab tu byung nas mi ring bar dgra bcom pa'i bar la bkod do/ /de nas gtsug lag khang gi thig 'debs pa'i tshe/ thig skud kyi mtha' gcig nas ni 'phags pa shā ri'i bus bzung*/ gcig shos nas ni mgon med zas sbyin gyis bzung ste thig dang po btab pa na 'phags pa 'dzum pa mdzad do/ khyim bdag gis de'i rgyu dris pas/ dga' ldan gyi lha'i gnas su yang gser gyi khang pa dpag tshad bzhi bcu pa grub bo zhes go bar mdzad do/ /de nas thig gnyis pa btab pas gser gyi khang pa de rin po che sna bzhi las grub par gyur to/ /de nas rim gyis dbus su gtsug lag khang chen po yod pa la/ gtsug lag khang bcu drug gis bskor ba dang mtha' khang phran drug cus bskor ba/ phyi rol ra ba dang bcas pa yo byad thams cad kyis rgyas par byas shing*/ gzhon nu rgyal byed kyis kyang sgo khang legs par tshang bar gyur to/ /bzhi bcu pa mnyan yod du spyan drangs pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas spyan drangs par 'dod de/ khyim bdag gis 'phags pa shā ri'i bu la/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma rer bshul so ji tsam re 'byon zhes dris pas/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bzhin te rgyang grags bcu'i lam du'o/ /de nas mnyan yod nas rgyal po'i khab kyi bar du zhag mal brtsis nas zhag sa re rer sbyin gtong gi khang pa re yang brtsigs/ gzhan duyang dus dang thun tshod so so'i mchod pa'i yo byad kyang bzhag

rta babs dag kyang brtsigs/ gdugs tshod gsol ba'i mi dag kyang bzhag lam rnams chag chag btab cing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan/ mi zhig pho nyar mngags te bcom ldan 'das spyan 'dren par btang*/ des kyang rgyal po'i khab tu phyin zhing ston pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te mnyan yod du phebs pas gsol lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu/ rgyal bo'i khab nas mnyan yod kyi bar gyi ljongs rnams rgyu zhing*/ khyim bdag gis gus pas bshams pa'i mchod yon sbrengs pa'i gnas rnams rim gyis brgyud de/ bcom ldan 'das dul ba 'khor dul ba/ zhi ba 'khor zhi ba/ grol ba 'khor grol ba/ dbugs byin pa 'khor dbugs phyin pa/ rnam par dul ba 'khor rnam par dul ba/ dgra bcom pa 'khor dgra bcom pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba 'khor 'dod chags dang bral ba/ nyi ma 'od zer stong gis bskor ba lta bu/ sku rin po che'i ri bo 'gro shes pa dang 'dra ba/ 'od 'dom gang ba/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang*/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin sogs skye bo'i tshogs rnams dang*/ lha brgya stong du mas zhabs 'bring byas te grong khyer gyi sgo'i them pa la zhabs bzhag ma thag tu sa chen po rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'od kyis khyab/ nam mkha' nas lha rnams kyis me tog gi char phab cing rol mo'i sgra bsgrags/ sa mtho dman can rnams ni mnyam par gyur/ glang po che dang rta dang khyu mchog rnams ni skad 'byin/ rol mo'i cha byad thams cad dang snod thams cad las ni rang sgra 'byin/ long bas mig thob/ 'on pas sgra thos/ lkugs pas smra nus/ dbang po ma tshang ba dag dbang po rnams yongs su rdzogs shing*/ chang dang dug gis myos pa dang phan tshun mkhon pa rnams zhi/ sbrum ma rnams bde bar btsas/ btson du bcings pa rnams ni thar/

nor med pa rnams kyis ni nor rnyed do/ /'di lta bu'i ya mtshan gyi chos ni rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa ma yin par rang shugs kyis 'byung bas ya mtshan nar ma sna tshogs zhes bya ba de yin no/ /'di ni gong 'og tu ston pa 'khor bcas rgyal po'am khyim bdag la sogs pas spyan drangs te/ sngar ma byon pa'i yul phyogs gang dang gang du byon pa thams cad la sbyar ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das khyim bdag gis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang du byon te dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi dbus su gdan bshams pa la bzhugs so/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin nye du 'khor tshogs dang lhan cig pas bkur bsti dang bcas te khyim bdag nyid kyis gser gyi bya ma bum thogs nas chu sbrengs pa las bya ma bum nas chu 'bab tu ma btub bo/ /de nas bdag gis las ma legs pa byas sam snyam nas mi dga' ba la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bu ma yin mod/ 'on kyang sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams la khyod kyis phyogs 'di nyid phul ba yin pas phyogs gzhan du chu sbrengs shig /der sbrengs pas chu byung ngo*/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas la phul tshul ni/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi dus khyim bdag rgyal byed ces bya bar gyur pa dang*/ gtsug tor can la khyim bdag rgyas pa dang*/ thams cad skyob la khyim bdag mchu dang*/ 'khor ba 'jig la khyim bdag srid sbyin dang*/ gser thub la khyim bdag phur bu dang*/ 'od srung la khyim bdag chu stong du gyur te phul/ ma 'ongs pa na byams pa la khyim bdag nor bzang du gyur te 'bul lo/ /zhes lung bstan to/ /'dir chu sbreng ba ni 'phags yul ba rnams kyi yul chos te/ bza' btung ma yin pa'i sbyin pa rgya che ba gang la'ang chu gtsang sbreng ba yin pas/ skabs 'dir yang gtsug lag khang 'bul ba'i brda yin no/ /de'i tshe gang sbyin pa'i dngos po de nyid brjod dgos pas/ skabs der rgyal bu rgyal byed kyis bsams pa/

bcom ldan 'das kyis dngos po brjod pa gsung pa na/ bdag gi ming thog mar smos te gsungs na ci ma rung snyam pa ston pas mkhyen nas bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di ni rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba yin no// zhes gsungs pa thos nas gzhon nu rgyal byed rab tu dga' ste sgo khang rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin dang ldan par byed du bcug go /zhe gcig pa gsal rgyal dad pa la bkod pa ni/ de nas zhag mang po ma lon pa'i dus shig na/ ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das rgyal byed kyi tshal na bzhugs par thos nas rang nyid 'khor dang bcas pa ston pa'i drung du song*/ phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas des smras pa/ dge sbyong gau ta ma bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so zhes gsung par grags na/ de dge sbyong gau ta ma la rdzun gsung zhes skur pa 'debs pa ma lags sam/ bka' stsal pa/ ma yin te nga ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /gsol pa/ re zhig rgan zhing rgan pa'i dge sbyong dang bram ze rdzogs byed la sogs pa rnams kyang de lta bu khas mi 'che na/ shes ldan gau ta ma 'khrungs nas ring po ma lon pa gsar du rab tu byung ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ zhes zhus pa na/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis/ rgyal rigs dpe byad ldan pa dang*/ /de bzhin brang 'gro me dang ni/ /dge slong tshul khrims ldan de la/ /blo dang ldan pas brnyas mi bya/ /zhes pa'i don gzhon nu dpe'i mdo rgyas par bka' stsal bas/ rgyal po gsal rgyal/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du yid ches nas zhabs gnyis la mgo bos gtugs te song ngo*/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang bcas pa grong khyer mnyan yod kyi phyogs rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin kyi kun dga' ra bar dbyar gnas par mdzad cing*/
