de'i lo phyi ma yab sras mjal bar mdzad do/ /zhe gnyis pa yab sras mjal ba'i sde ni/ de yang rgyal po gsal rgyal yang dag pa'i dad pa thob nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma la/ lha dgyes pa bskyed du gsol/ khyed kyi sras kyis bdud rtsi brnyes nas bdud rtsis 'gro ba tshim par mdzad do zhes 'phrin yig phul bas/ rgyal po zas gtsang gis ston pa'i drung du pho nya zhig btang ba/ ston pa dang chos kyi gzi byin gyis rab tu dga' ba'i shugs kyis phun sum tshogs pa nyams su myong nas de nyid du rab tu byung ste phyir ma 'ongs so/ /de bzhin du pho nya gnyis pa nas bdun pa la sogs pa'i bar du btang yang thams cad kyang rab tu byung ste phyir ma ldog pas 'phrin las skyel ba su yang ma byung ngo*/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma lag pa 'gram pa la gtod de sems khong du chud cing 'dug pa la/ mdun na 'don gyi bu 'char kas rgyu mtshan dris pas/ gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa sngon dka' ba spyod pa'i tshe thams cad kyis gtam khyer nas 'ong na/ da lta bdud rtsi thob nas phun sum tshogs pas gnas pa'i tshe 'phrin skyel ba btang ba thams cad kyang ldog 'ong ba med pas so/ /de nas 'char kas lha don de la bdag 'gro'o/ /rgyal pos khyed kyang de'i phun sum tshogs pa mthong nas der 'dug par 'gyur ro/ /des bdag slar nges par 'ong ngo byas nas/ de'i tshe rgyal po zas gtsang mas rang nyid kyis 'phrin yig bris te 'di skad ces/ lhums su zhugs pa bzung nas su/ khyod ni bdag gis cher bskrun te/ /nyon mongs me rab 'bar bzhin du/ /rgyal ba ljon shing la bsdad na/ /da ni khyod kyi slob ma yi/ /yal ga lcug ma 'phel gyur na/ /gzhan ni bde bas dga' bar gyur/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal skal par ldan/ /gzhan yang gang gis khyod ni ljon shing lcug phran mtshungs tsam na/ /bdag gi bu ni 'di yin snyam nas chung nas bskrun bskrun te/

/bu gcig yul mi mang pos 'bras bu yongs su spyad thob na/ /de la yon tan 'bras bu mi ster khyod la snying rje med/ /gang tshe thog ma bltams pa na/ /nyid don bsgrubs nas gnyen rnams ni/ /shin tu che dang phan gdags zhes/ /khyod kyis dam bcas mdzad nas ni/ khyod kyis zhi gnas de brnyes na/ /bdag dang gnyen gyi tshogs rnams la/ /thugs brtses rjes su bzung mdzod de/ /gshegs par dgongs pa mdzad du gsol/ zhes so/ /de nas 'char kas zhu 'phrin gyi yi ge khyer te song ba las zhag bdun mnyan yod du phyin/ ston pa'i spyan sngar song ste rgyal po zas gtsang gi zhu ba'i yi ge phul ba sangs rgyas nyid kyi phyag gis bzhes te bklag par mdzad nas mtha' zhig tu 'jog par mdzad do/ /'char kas gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das ser skyar mi bzhud dam/ bka' stsal pa 'gro'o/ /de sngon bcom ldan 'das dang lhag par 'dris pas gal te mi bzhud na bdag gi mthus bkri'o/ /zhes ci brtol du gsol ba la/ gang sred pa dang bral zhing spyod yul mtha' yas mnga' ba de su zhig gis bkri bar nus/ zhes gsungs/ des gsol pa/ bdag 'gro ste zas gtsang ma la rig par bgyi'o/ /ston pas sangs rgyas kyi pho nya ni 'di lta bu ma yin pas rab tu byung zhig /gsol ba/ rgyal po la slar 'ong bar dam bcas na ji ltar bgyid/ sngon la rab tu byung la de'i rjes su dam bcas pa bzhin du gyis shig /de nas 'char ka tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la gtad de/ rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas kun tu spyod pa'i chos dag bstan te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ba na/ bka' stsal pa/ 'char ka khyod song la rgyal po'i pho brang du gya tshom du ma 'gro bar sgor sdod la/ shākya'i dge slong 'ongs su zhes rjod cig gal te nang du byon zer na 'jug par bya'o/ /dge slong gzhan yang yod dam zhe na yod do/ cais smros shig /don grub kyang cha byad 'di 'dra'am zer na 'dra'o/

khyod rgyal po'i khab tu ma sdod cigagazhon nu yang mi bzhugs sam na mi bzhugs so/ /gang du bzhugs zer na gtsug lag khang du'o/ /de ci 'dra zer na rgyal byed tshal gyi rnam pa bris pa ston cig 'byon nam zhe na 'byon no/ /dus ji srid na 'byon zhe na zhag bdun lon nas so zhes rjod cig /de nas 'char ka ser skyar 'gro ba'i dus/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus yud tsam zhig la ser skyar sleb pa na/ 'char ka sangs rgyas la lhag par dad pa skyes so/ /des kyang ston pas ji skad bka' stsal pa ltar/ pho brang gi sgo drung du bsdad nas shākya'i dge slong 'ongs so zhes brda sbyor/ dge slong gzhan dag kyang yod dam/ shes ldan dag yod do/ /de rnams kyis rgyal po zas gtsang la smras pas nang du byon cig der 'char kas nang du zhugs te sngar gyi tshul rnams rgyas par bsnyad do/ /gzhon nu yang cha byad 'di 'dra'am/ lha 'di 'dra'o/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang brgyal zhing sa la 'gyel ba tsan dan gyi chus btab nas slar gsos pas/ gzhon nu dus ji srid na 'byon gsung*/ dgung bdun lon nas so/ /zhus so/ /de nas zas gtsang gis blon po rnams la rgyal po'i khab dang pho brang byi dor gyis shig ces bsgo ba dang*/ 'char kas smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni pho brang du mi bzhugs te dben pa'am gtsug lag khang du'o/ /rgyal pos gtsug lag khang ci 'dra zhes dris pa na/ 'char kas rgyal byed tshal gyi rnam pa ri mor bris pa bstan to/ /rgyal pos kyang skyed mos tshal n+ya gro dhar de 'dra ba byed du bcug ste/ sa bdag rnams ni tshig gis ni/ /lha rnams bsam pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /de bzhin bsam gtan pa rnams kyi/ /sems bskyed pas ni thams cad 'grub/ ces bya ba yin pas khang bzang chen po dang*/ gtsug lag khang bcu drug dang*/ khang mig drug cu dang*/ rwa ba sgo khang rta babs dang bcas pa yo byad thams cad kyis yongs su rgyas pa zhag bdun gyi khongs su grub bo/

/skyed mos tshal ro hi ka dang*/ tshangs pas bskor bar yang de dang 'dra bar byas so/ /ston pa'i sku drung nas 'char ka phyir ldog pa'i mi ring ba kho nar ston pas maung gal gyi bu la bka' stsal te/ grong khyer ser skyar yab sras gdan 'dzom par 'gyur gyi/ gang de blta bar 'dod pa thams cad chos gos long zhig /ces gsungs te/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan yod nas ser skya'i bar du ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pas lam bar du dgung zhag bdun mdzad de/ bdun pa la chu bo ro hi ka'i 'gram du bzhugs so/ /de nas nangs par rgyal po zas gtsang mas chu klung gi 'gram nas n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba'i bar lam thams cad byi dor byas shing rgyan gyis brgyan/ sa phyogs shin tu yangs pa zhig tu stan dang mchod pa'i yo byad rgya chen po bshams so/ /bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po yang sbyar te/ 'ga' zhig shing rta dkar la 'dren byed kyi rta yang dkar ba/ de la gnas pa'i mi gos dang lham dang thod sogs cha byad mtha' dag dkar ba dang ba dan yang dkar ba/ yang gzhan dag thams cad ser ba dang*/ thams cad dmar ba dang*/ thams cad sngo ba dang*/ thams cad khra bo dag kyang yod la/ gzhan yang glang po che rgyan du mas brgyan pa dang*/ rol mo rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang*/ gar gyi khyad par la sogs pa mtha' yas pa bkod do/ /de nas dge slong rnams kyang chu klung la khrus la sogs pa'i bya ba byed do/ /der ston pas dgongs pa/ gal te 'dir zhabs kyis gshegs na shākya nga rgyal can rnams nas kha zer bar 'gyur ro snyam du dgongs nas rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad par brtsams so/ /der phyogs dang phyogs nas skye bo dpag tu med pa dag sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas bskul nas phyogs der yongs su 'dus par gyur te/ kha cig ni dad pas 'ongs/ kha cig ni ya mtshan skyes/ kha cig ni yid gnyis su gyur/ kha cig ni gzhan gyis bskul ba sogs rkyen 'jug tshul tha dad pa du ma yod mod kyi/

phal cher chos rtogs pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa sha stag go /de nas skye bo de thams cad kyi mngon sum du gsal bar ston pa 'khor bcas steng gi bar snang la mngon par 'phags nas/ nam mkha' la bzhugs pa dang*/ bzhengs pa dang*/ 'chag pa dang*/ mnal bar mdzad/ sku las 'od zer sna tshogs pa dag kyang spro/ sku smad nas me 'bar zhing sku stod nas chu'i rgyun grang mo 'bab pa dang*/ de nyid go ldog pa dang*/ glog dang*/ sprin dang*/ sgra dang*/ char 'bab pa dang*/ me 'bar ba dang*/ gsal ba dang*/ lam mer 'dug pa ste cho 'phrul rnam pa bzhi po phyogs bzhir bstan/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam pa de bsdus nas/ shing ta la bdun srid tsam gyi nam mkha' nas tshur gshegs te/ de'i tshe dge slong dag ta la drug srid tsam gyi nam mkha' nas 'byon no/ /rim pa des bcom ldan 'das nyid ta la nyis srid tsam dang*/ dge slong dag ta la gcig tsam gyi nam mkha' la/ de nas sangs rgyas mi 'greng bdun tsam gyi nam mkha' la gshegs tsam na/ dge slong rnams mi 'greng drug tsam/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das mi gang lhag tsam nas phebs pa na/ dge slong rnams sa gzhi la'o/ /der rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa mang pos lang long du gyur pas/ rgyal pos bcom ldan 'das ngo ma shes pa la 'char kas brda sprad pas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la lus thams cad kyis btud nas phyag mdzad do/ /blo gros yangs pa khyod la 'di dang ni/ /kun spyan zhabs la lan gsum phyag byas te/ /bltams pa'i tshe na sa ni g.yos pa

dang*/ /dzambu'i grib ma sku las ma 'das pa'o/ /de nas shākya rnams yab kyis sras la phyag mdzad pa ci'i tha tshig ces ma dad pa la/ rgyal pos ngas da sdod kho na phyag byas pa ma yin gyi/ dang po kho nar bltams pa'i dus sa g.yos shing 'od kyis khyab pa dang*/ dzambu'i grib mas sku lus ma btang ba'i skabs su'ang phyag byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor tshogs de dag zil gyis mnan te dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi dbus su bzhugs khri bshams pa la bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das sngon rgyal srid kyi 'byor pa'i bde ba la longs spyod cing bzhugs pa las/ da ltar 'dod pa spangs pas 'o brgyal bar bzhugs so snyam nas mig mchi mas gang zhing zhus pa/ gzhal med khang gi gnas rnams su/ /yab kyi khab na bzhugs pa las/ /dgon pa 'jigs dang bcas rnams su/ /ji lta bur na 'ba' zhig bzhugs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi yi bdag po gang du ni/ khyim gyi 'chi ba las grol pa/ /'phags pa yi ni gnas pa bcus/ /thub pa rnams ni gnas par mdzad/ /ces gsungs/ de dag la sogs pa zhu ba zhu lan mang du mdzad pa na/ rgyal pos zhu ba zhus pa'i lan las brtsams te chos kyi gtam rgya chen po mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal po yang sras kyis yon tan mchog brnyes par mkhyen nas lhag par yang dgyes shing*/ ston pas 'khor gyi tshogs thams cad kyi bsam pa mkhyen te chos bstan pas shākya'i rgyal bu zas dkar la sogs pa shākya bdun khri bdun stong gis bden pa mthong ngo*/ /de'i tshe lhas byin khro bas kun nas £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+cher bslangs pa'am £© dkris pas/ gal te 'di 'dra ba'i sgyu ma shes na/ bdag gis kyang 'jig rten thams cad dbang du bya ba zhig zer ba la/ shākya rnams kyis la las sdigs shing la las gzhams te bzlog pas lhas byin cang mi smra'o/ /de bzhin du nangs par yang tshangs pas bskor ba zhes bya ba'i skyed mos tshal du chos bstan pas rgyal bu bre bo zas la sogs pa shākya drug khri drug stong gis bden pa mthong ngo*/

/de'i yang nangs par ro hi ka zhes bya ba'i skyed mos tshal du chos gsungs pas rgyal bu bdud rtsi zas la sogs pa shākya lnga khri lnga stong gis bden pa mthong ngo*/ /nyi ma de gnyis la yang lhas byin sngar skad zer zhing shākya rnams kyis bzlog go /de ltar na nyin zhag gsum po de la lha dang mi'i skye bo bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig rgyun zhugs dang*/ phyir 'ong dang*/ phyir mi 'ong dang*/ dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu la bkod pa dang*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal du sems bskyed pa dang*/ lha'i gtso bo rnams su 'gyur ba'i dge ba bsags pa dang*/ sdig pa'i las spangs pa sogs rang rang gi skal pa dang 'tsham par rmad du byung ba'i gnas thob ste/ 'khor de dag phal cher yang sangs rgyas la gzhol ba/ chos la 'bab pa/ dge 'dun la bab par bkod do/ /de dag tu rgyal po zas gtsang mas bden pa ma mthong ste/ bdag gi bu kho na mthu dang rdzu 'phrul che'o snyam shin tu dregs shing dga' ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das la sngon ni lha dang lha ma yin rnams kyis mchod par byed na/ da lta ni mi kho nas mchod kyi/ lhas ni ma yin no snyam du ha cang zhum pa ste rgyu gnyis po des bden pa ma mthong pa yin no/ /de nas 'phags pa maung gal gyi bu la bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po zas gtsang ma la soms shig ces bka' stsal pas/ 'phags pa maung gal gyi bus rgyal po zas gtsang gi drung du song ste/ nam mkha' la spyod lam bzhi byed pa dang*/ 'od 'byin pa dang ya ma zung gi cho 'phrul sogs bstan nas stan bshams pa la 'dug go /de nas rgyal pos 'di skad ces/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos rdzu 'phrul dang mthu che ba gzhan yang mchis sam/ 'phags pas shin tu mang por yod do/ /der rgyal po sngar gyi dga' ches pa'i dregs pa zhi'o/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pas lha rnams la chos ston par bzhed pa lha'i tshogs kyis shes te n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra bar lha'i bzo bos lha'i gzhal med khang skad cig la 'du byas shing tshar ba dang*/

brgya byin la sogs pa lha dbang che ba thams cad 'dus shing*/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhis sgo bzhi nas srung pa dang*/ mchod pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par byas so/ /de nas 'phags pa maung gal gyi bu chen pos rgyal po zas gtsang ma khrid de bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du phyin nas shar sgo nas 'jug par brtsams pa na/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung na re/ rgyal po chen po nang du ma 'gro zhigabacom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor dag pa la chos 'chad de mir gyur pa 'jug tu mi dbang ngo*/ /de bzhin du sgo gzhan rnams su yang de ltar sbyar te de'i tshe ston pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis lha rnams kyis byas pa'i rin po che sna bzhi'i khang pa brtsegs pa dang*/ n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba gang yin pa de dwangs shel las grub par sprul pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das lha rnams kyis bshams pa'i stan la bzhugs shing*/ lha rnams la chos ston pa rgyal bos mngon sum du mthong ste/ sngar gyi zhum pa'i sems de yang zhi bar gyur nas dga' ba dang mgu ba bla na med pa thob ste zhabs la phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos bstan pas rgyal po zas gtsang mas kyang bden pa mthong ngo*/ / de nas nangs par pho brang du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs par zhus te/ zas dkar gyi drung du byon nas gzhon nu khyod kyis rgyal srid gyis shig lha ci'i slad du mi mdzad/ ngas bden pa mthong ngo*/ /nyin mo gang la lags/ de ring kho na'o/ /bdag gis ni shākya bdun khri bdun stong dang lhan cig bden pa mthong lags so/ /de bzhin du bre bo zas dang*/ bdud rtsi zas la yang sbyar ro/ /de nas shākya bzang ldan rgyal srid la bskos/ nangs par rgyal po zas gtsang gi pho brang du bsod snyoms gsol zhing*/ gser gyi bya ma bum nas chu sbrengs te n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba phul lo/ /der ston pas/ sbyin pa'i bsod nams gang yin 'dis/

/shākya rnams kyi bsam pa yi/ /yid la re ba rdzogs nas ni/ /rtag pa'i gnas ni thob par shog /ces yon bsngo bar mdzad do/ /de nas nyi ma gcig ni rgyal po'i pho brang du bsod snyoms gsol/ nyi ma gcig ni btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du gdugs tshod gsol ba na/ grags 'dzin ma 'di snyam du/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis dbang du 'gyur pa'i thabs shig yod na legs so snyam pa las/ kun tu rgyu ba mo rig sngags mthar phyin pa zhig la pa ṇa lnga brgya rngan par byin nas dbang du byed pa'i la du byas te grags 'dzin ma la gtad/ des gzhon nu sgra gcan 'dzin la gtad de khyod kyis yab la phul zhig ces bsgos pa na/ grags 'dzin ma la mi snyan par gleng ba spong ba'i don du sangs rgyas kyi sku lnga brgya sprul lo/ /sgra gcan 'dzin gyis brtags pa na/ sprul pa dang sprul gzhi so sor ngo shes te sprul gzhir gyur pa ston pa dngos la phul lo/ /de nas slar yang la du de gzhon nu nyid la gnang bas des zos shing ston pas yon bsngo ba mdzad nas phyir gshegs pa'i rjes su sus kyang bzlog tu ma btub par ston pa'i zhabs phyir 'brangs so/ /der sgra gcan 'dzin gyis sprul pa dang sprul gzhi'i bye brag shes pas ston pa'i sras ma yin nam snyam pa'i dogs pa yang sangs/ sgra gcan 'dzin 'di srid pa tha ma pa yin pas khyim na gnas pa'i skabs med do zhes bka' stsal bas/ rgyal po zas gtsang mas 'o na deng gi nyin par rab tu mi 'byin par gsol/ bdag gis mchod pa bya dgos so zhes zhus te/ nyi ma gzhan la dus ston chen po dang bcas te 'phags pa shā ri'i bu la gtad de rab tu byung ngo*/ /de nas yang nyi ma gzhan la btsun mo'i pho brang du gdugs tshod gsol ba'i skabs shig bud med drug khri thams cad rgyan gyis brgyan/ dga' tshal gyi lha'i bu mo bzhin du 'dug nas sgeg 'chos dang brdeg 'chos sna tshogs pa'i chags pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bud med kyi sgyu ma dag ston pa na/

bud med 'di dag 'dod chags kyis gdungs pas bden pa'i snod du mi 'gyur zhing*/ gdul ba'i skye bo dus las kyang yol bar 'gyur na/ so so skye bo rnams ni rdzu 'phrul la myur du dad par 'gyur ro zhes dgongs nas/ 'od zer spro ba dang*/ nyi ma dang zla ba phyag gis nom pa dang*/ ri rab phyag tu blangs te bskor ba sogs cho 'phrul du ma bstan te gdan bshams pa la bzhugs so/ /de nas btsun mo'i 'khor rnams mngon par dad pa skyes pa la chos bstan pas sa 'tsho ma dang*/ ri dwags skyes ma la sogs pa bud med drug khris rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob ste/ 'on kyang grags 'dzin ma ni da dung 'dod pa'i rnam rtog gis gzir pas bden pa ma mthong ngo*/ /de nas ston pa phyir gshegs pa na grags 'dzin ma khang bzang gi rtse mo nas mchongs so/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos can yin pas ston pas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' las blangs nas sa la bzhag ste/ gang thos na grags 'dzin mas bden pa mthong bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan pas dus der grags 'dzin mas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob cing*/ phyis ring zhig lon nas rab tu byung zhing dgra bcom pa'ang thob ste/ btsun mo'i 'khor gzhan phal cher yang de dang 'dra'o/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po zas gtsang gis bsams pa/ dge slong 'di rnams spyod lam zhi zhing dbang po dul ba yin mod kyi/ rigs sna tshogs las byung zhing sngon dka' thub drag pos lus gdungs pa la sogs pas mi mdzes so/ /'khor mdzes pa ni shākya'i rigs mchog rnams kyis so snyam ste/ shākya thams cad 'dus pa la shes ldan dag bcom ldan 'das rab tu ma byung na cir 'gyur/ de rnams kyis gsol ba/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal du'o/ /de'i tshe khyed cag ci byed/ g.yog bgyid do/ /da lta chos kyi rgyal por gyur na ci'i phyir g.yog mi byed/ lha ci rab tu 'byung ngam/

rab tu byung zhigaci thams cad lags sam/ min te khyim re nas re re'o/ /de nas rgyal pos dril bsgrags so/ /de'i tshe shākya ming chen gyi bu gnyis po las ma 'gags pa ni steng gi khang bzang gi gzhi na dga' zhing rtse bas gnas la/ ming chen ni las kyi mtha' la brtson no/ /de gnyis kyi mas ming chen la khyod rab tu byung zhig ces byas pa na/ nga las kyi mtha' byed dgos pas ma 'gags pa bde bar gnas pa rab tu byung zhig ces zer ro/ /de bsod nams can yin pas ma 'gran zhig byas pa na/ yum nyid dgyes pa de bsod nams che mod/ de min snod stong pa zhig bskur dang mngon du 'gyur ro zhes zer ro/ /der rdze'u stong pa zhig kha ras kyis g.yogs rgyas btab nas g.yog mo zhig la bskur te btang bas/ brgya byin gyis lha'i zhal zas dang mtshungs pa'i tshod ma dag gis bkang ngo*/ /ma 'gags pas de kha phye ba na tshil de dri zhim bos khyab par gyur te/ ro brgya dang ldan pa'i zas mchog tu shes nas slar yang de'i phud nas ma la bskur nas/ nyi ma re re bzhin zas 'di lta bu skur zhig ces byas nas slar bskur te btang ba g.yog mo des kyang don de rgyas par smras pas/ mas ming chen la de bstan nas bu mthong ngam/ mthong ngo*/ /de bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa yin pas khyod rab tu byung zhig de de dang ldan yang rung mi ldan yang rung*/ kho bo rab tu mi 'byung ngo zer ro/ /de nas mas ma 'gags pa la bu rab tu 'byung ngam/ ma 'gags pa na re/ de'i phan yon ci lags/ khyim du gnas nas legs par bsgrubs na lha mi dang nyes na ngan song ngo*/ /rab tu byung nas nyes na'ang lha mi dang legs na mya ngan las 'das pa thob bo/ 'o na rab tu byung ba'i nyes dmigs gang yin pa de/ khyim na gnas pa'i phan yon yin pas bdag rab tu 'byung ngo*/ /ma 'gags pa'i ne'u ldang ste/ na mnyam chung grogs ni rgyal po bzang ldan yin pas de bzang ldan gyi khyim du song ngo*/

/bzang ldan gyis de la don ci la byon/ rab tu 'byung ba'i don du'o/ kho bo yang rab tu 'byung bas gros bya yi/ 'di nyid du gnas thob cig de'i nub mo ras bzang po dag bting zhing me tog kyang dor/ ma 'gags pa der nyal bas stan reg bya tsha zhing 'bar 'bur du mi bde nas/ 'di na rdo ba dag yod dam zhes bltas pas me tog gi rtsa ba zhig rnyed pa ring du bsams pa'i don gyi rtsa ba 'grub pa'i ltas su go nas ngo mtshar skyes so/ /nangs par mal bde'am dris na/ mi bde ste rims bags kyis sbags pa'i gos kyis so/ /de ji ltar yin mal 'cha' ba la dris so/ /des kyang 'khor ba la'o/ /des kyang thags mkhan la dris pa na/ 'di ni med de 'di 'thag 'phro la bdag rims kyis thebs pa lags so zer/ ma 'gags pas rtags ci las shes/ tsha ba'i reg pa las so/ khyod ni mkhas shing skal pa bzang po'o zhes bsngags so/ /der ma 'gags pa rab tu 'byung 'dod pas rgyal po bzang ldan la dris pas legs so zhes lan btab cing*/ bzang ldan rang nyid kyang rab tu 'byung bar spro ste/ 'on kyang kho bo rab tu byung na lhas byin rgyal por 'gyur te thams cad la gnod par 'gyur ba'i gnas yod pas dang por lhas byin la spro ba dri'o/ /zhes lhas byin gyi thad du song nas kho bo cag thams cad ni rab tu 'byung na/ khyod ci byed/ lhas byin gyis bsams pa/ da lta nga rab tu mi 'byung ngo byas na bzang ldan 'dis rgyal srid mi 'jog la/ da lta rab tu 'byung bar khas blangs nas/ 'di dag rab tu byung zin pa na nga rab tu mi 'byung ste rgyal srid byed pas thabs bsham mo snyam ste/ khyed cag thams cad rab tu 'byung na bdag ci ste 'dug ces smras so/ /rgyal po bzang ldan gyis bsams pa/ lhas byin 'di rdzun du smra ba yin pas dam 'char yang bcug cing mang pos rig par bya'o snyam ste dril bsgrags shing shes ldan dag nyon zhig bzang ldan dang nam gru dang ma 'gags pa dang lhas byin zhes pa la sogs pa shākya lnga brgya'i bar tu ste/

'di rnams rab tu 'byung bas dga' ba skyed cig ces so so'i rtags blangs te/ skye bo kun bsags pa'i nang du dril bsgrags so/ /de nas lhas byin sdug bsngal chen po skyes shing*/ da ni rab tu ma byung na rdzun smra ba'o zhes rgyal srid kyang mi thob pas re zhig rab tu byung la phyis rgyal srid bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas grong khyer byi dor byas mtshan mkhan rnams kyang bsags/ shākya rnams rang rang gi 'byor pas rab tu 'byung bar byed de/ shākya lnga brgya rnams kyi 'byor pa'i tha ma blta'o zhes shākya pho mo rnams dang yul sna tshogs kyi skye bo rnams kyang 'dus/ grong khyer gyi shar sgor seng ge'i khri bshams pa la rgyal po nyid 'dug nas 'khor brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor te bzhugs so/ /der thog mar rgyal po bzang ldan rgyan gyis brgyan zhing shing rtar zhugs te byung ba la mtshan mkhan rnams kyis brtags pas/ 'dis ston pa mnyes par byed par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan/ lhas byin byung ba na/ gtsug gi nor bu kha dog dmar por yod pa sha dang nor te bya khras khyer ba na/ 'di ni ston pa la 'khu bas dmyal bar 'gro'o/ /zhes dang*/ ko ka li ka dang*/ khanṭa dra bya dang*/ ka ta mo ra ka ti ṣya dang*/ rgya mtshos byin rnams phyir byung ba na/ bong bu skad 'byin pas 'di dag ni dam pa la ngan du smras pas dmyal ba 'gro'o/ /nyer dga' glang po che la zhon nas phan tshun lta ba na mu tig gi do shal lhungs pa glang po che la babs te de blangs

so/ /'di ni ha cang 'dod zhen ches pas dmyal bar skye'o/ /gzhan nam gru dang ma 'gags pa la sogs pa phal cher la bzang por lung bstan te/ shākya lnga brgya po rnams skyed mos tshal du dus ston la 'gro ba bzhin du bzang 'gran du byas te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ngo*/ /de nas ston pas dgongs pa/ tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs pa ni srid pa tha ma pa kho nar nges la/ 'di dag gi nang na srid pa tha ma ma yin pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa mnyes par mi byed pa dag kyang yod pas/ dge 'dun gyi gsol bzhi'i las kyis rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs su gzhug par dgongs te/ dge 'dun rnams la'ang de ltar du bka' stsal to/ /de rnams kyi skra 'breg par 'breg mkhan nye bar 'khor rgyal po zas gtsang gis mngags shing*/ des rgyal po bzang ldan gyi skra 'breg pa'i dus na/ de mchi mas brnangs shing bdag skyes bu gtso bo la bsnyen bkur bgyid bgyid pa'i mi/ skye bo phal pa la bsnyen bkur bgyid par 'gyur ba lta/ zhes zer ba la bzang ldan gyis/ khyod mya ngan ma byed cigakhyod phal ba la bsnyen bkur bya mi dgos pa de ltar ngas bya'o zhes byas te/ bzang ldan gyis shākya rnams la smras pa/ 'breg mkhan nye bar 'khor 'dis bdag cag la bkur sti byas la/ bdag cag kyang slar khyim du mi gnas pas rgyan mi dgos te/ 'di'i 'tsho ba'i rkyen du bdag cag gi rgyan thams cad byin cig ces byas nas/ ras chen po bting pa'i steng du/ shākya lnga brgya'i rgyan rnams spungs pas phung po chen por gyur to/ /de nas nye bar 'khor gyis shākya lnga brgya'i skra rim gyis bregs so/ /mthar shākya rnams khrus la song ba'i bar skabs der nye bar 'khor gyis bsams pa/ 'di dag rgyal srid la sogs pa'i dpal dang 'byor pa chen po la'ang ma chags par rab tu 'byin na bdag 'di dag gi rgyan la chags par mi 'os mod/ rigs ngan du ma skyes na bdag kyang rab tu 'byung ba zhig snyam du yid mi bde bar 'dug pa 'phags pa shā ri'i bus mkhyen nas/

ston pa'i gsung rab la rigs dang rus snying por byed pa ma yin/ sgrub pa snying por byed pa yin te/ zhes sogs dbugs phyung nas ston pa'i spyan sngar khrid de/ ston pas kyang nye bar 'khor tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do/ /de nas shākya lnga brgya po rnams/ khrus zin nas 'khor te/ rgan rim la phyag 'tshal ba'i skabs/ nye bar 'khor gyi thad du sleb pa na/ bzang ldan gyis nye bar 'khor yin par shes nas/ ci bdag gis 'di'i rkang pa la'ang btud par bgyi'am/ zhes gsol pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bu nga rgyal spong ba'i phyir rab tu byung ba yin pas 'di rgan gyi/ nga rgyal dang dregs pa chog la btud cig de nas nye bar 'khor gyi rkang pa la bzang ldan gyis mgo bos btud pas sa chen po rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /de la 'di rgan gyi zhes pa ni/ bslab pa rgan pa ste na tshod rgan pa'i don min no/ /de nas gzhan rnams kyis kyang bka' bzhin byas la/ lhas byin gyis ma btud de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis btud cig par bka' stsal pa na/ ngas 'di'i rkang pa la ma gtugs na khyed la gnod pa ci mchi zhes mi 'dud de/ dang po nyid nas ston pa'i gsung bcag go /de nas lnga brgya po dge 'dun gyis bsnyen par rdzogs shing ring por ma thogs par nye bar 'khor yang dgra bcom pa thob nas 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog tu lung bstan la/ bzang ldan la sogs pa lnga brgya po shas che ba dag gis kyang rim gyis bden pa mthong ngo*// gang gi tshe bdud rtsi zas kyi khye'u kun dga' bo la mtshan mkhan rnams kyis 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi rim gro par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pas/ bdud rtsi zas khye'u la rab tu gces pas/ ston pa ser skyar byon pa'i tshe yul bai shā lar skyel bar byed/ der byon pa'i tshe ser skyar skyel bar byed do/ /lan cig khye'u de ser skya na yod pa la ma tshor ba kho nar bcom ldan 'das bdud rtsi zas kyi khang par gshegs shing gdan bshams pa la bzhugs so/

/der kun dga' bo khyim de'i phug gi khang phran zhig tu bcug ste sgo bsdams so/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus sgo'i rim pa rnams rang bye zhing*/ khye'us bcom ldan 'das mthong bas rab tu dga' ches te rgyugs shing 'ongs nas sangs rgyas kyi zhabs la phyag byas te/ snam logs su bsil yab g.yob cing 'dug go /bdud rtsi zas 'khor bcas la bcom ldan 'das kyis chos bstan te phyir bzhud pa na/ khye'u kun dga' bo yang phyi bzhin 'brangs te/ pha ma la sogs pa rnams kyis thabs sna tshogs kyis bzlog kyang ngu zhing bzlog par nus so/ /'di ni srid pa tha ma pa yin pas ma zlog cig ces bka' stsal ba na/ gal te de lta na rim pa bzhin bgyi'o/ /der gnang ste bdud rtsi zas kyis dge sbyong dang bram ze dang phongs pa'i tshogs la sbyin pa rgya chen po'ang btang*/ rang gi skye bo dang gnyen gyi tshogs la bzod par gsol te/ khye'u glang po che la bskyon/ 'khor tshogs dang bcas te n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra bar btang ba'i lam du glang bo ches utpal la'i sdong po zhig sna zhags kyis phyung nas zos so/ /mtshan mkhan rnams kyis gzhon nu 'di thos pa 'dzin pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /de nas ston pa'i spyan sngar song zhing zhabs la phyag byas/ ston pas kyang 'phags pa 'od srungs stobs bcu pa la gtad de rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /de dag ni yab sras mjal ba'i rjes su lo de nyid la 'brel chags su byung ba yin no/ /zhe gsum pa shāka rigs kyi bud med rnams la chos bstan pa ni/ yang ston pa ser skya'i gnas n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe shākya phal mo che bden pa la bkod pa de'i tshe shākya rnams dus gsum du gtsug lag khang du 'gro zhing chos kyang nyan no/ /rgyal po zas gtsang ma yang dus gsum du shākya'i tshogs kyis bskor nas ston pa'i spyan sngar 'gro'o/

/ston pas sbrang rtsi lta bu'i chos bstan pa na 'khor shas che ba dag kyang dbang pau mi g.yo bas nyan no/ /de'i tshe ming chen gyis sangs rgyas 'byung ba ni bdag la 'bras bu dang bcas pa'o zhes smras pas/ de'i chung mas khyed la ni legs na bdag la ni ma yin te/ ston pa ni bud med kyi phyir chos mi ston pas so/ /ming chen gyis khyod de skad ma zer cig ston pa ni sems can thams cad la thugs mnyam par brtse ba yin gyi/ chos nyan pa'i phyir song zhig des smras pa/ lha zas gtsang 'khor dang bcas pa dus gsum du 'byon pas bdag cag 'gro ba ngo tsha lags so/ / gal te lha snga dro mchi na/ bdag cag phyi dro 'gro bar 'tshal/ de nas ming chen gyis rgyal po zas gtsang ma la zhu'o snyam na'ang*/ dngos su ma nus te skye rgu'i bdag mo brgyud nas zhus pas zas gtsang gis gnang ngo*/ /de nas snga dro'am phyi dro rgyal po mi 'byon pa'i dus na bud med rnams chos nyan du 'gro'o// lan cig skye rgu'i bdag mo shākya'i chung ma lnga brgyas bskor te chos nyan du song ba na/ ming chen gyi chung ma yang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te song ngo*/ /de kun dga' bos mthong nas/ 'di thams cad 'dod chags dang bral ba kho na'ang min pas/ rgyan gyis brgyan te 'ongs pa ma legs zhes smras pas/ des rgyan bkrol nas g.yog mo skyed ma la bskur te khyim du btang ngo*/ /de'ang myur du 'khor te ston pas de rnams la chos gsungs pa na/ shākya'i bud med gcig chos la rna ba mi gtod par rang gi mu tig gi do shal la lta zhing nom par byed do/ /de ming chen gyi chung mas mthong nas/ sangs rgyas kyis 'du byed thams cad mi rtag par gsungs na yang*/ 'di 'di la chags sam/ nga'i mu tig gi do shal mthong na/ 'di'i dregs pa zhi bar 'gyur ro snyam ste/ g.yog mo skyed ma la nga'i mu tig gi do shal las nyung shas shig longs shig /g.yog mo skyed ma de chos nyan pa la sems bsdus pas/

kye hud bran du gyur pa ni re sdug bsngal/ 'di 'dra ba'i chos nyan pa'i dbang yang med do snyam nas tshigs bcad kyang smras so/ /ston pas bran mo 'di sangs rgyas la bya ba byas pa yin yang tshe cung zad med par mkhyen nas chos tshigs bcad gcig yi ger bris te de la stsal/ de'ang yid dga' zhing*/ sangs rgyas la dad pa'i sems kyis song ba las lam du ba brus ma zhig gis brdungs te shi'o/ /de ma thag sing gha la'i gling gi rgyal po'i btsun mo dam pa'i mngal du zhugs shing nying mtshams sbyar/ phyis btsas pa na mu tig gi char yang babs so/ /der rgyal po'i bu mo mu tig can zhes btags/ 'di'i gtam rgyud kyi 'phros 'og tu 'byung ngo*/ /'di yab sras mjal ba'i rjes thog rang la min yang*/ lo mang po ma lon pa'i skabs shig la yin par snang ngo*/ /yang ston pa rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal na bzhugs shing*/ nye sde rab tu byung ba dang*/ sngar shākya lnga brgya rab tu byung ba rnams kyang sems rnam par grol ba'i phyir chos ston par mdzad de/ lhas byin dang ko ka li ka la sogs pa nyung shas shig ma gtogs pa phal cher gyis mi ring bar dgra bcom pa thob bau/ /zhe bzhi pa gcung dga' bo rab tu byung ba ni/ yang phyis dus gzhan zhig gi tshe/ bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gnas n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi gcung po gcung dga' bo zhes bya ba yod de/ gtsug gtor dang mdzod spu ma gtogs mtshan sum cu dang ldan pa/ ston pa las sor bzhis lus thung ba stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur bar lung bstan pa zhig go /de rang gi chung ma punṭa rī ka zhes bya ba ches gzugs mdzes shing bud med kyi sgyu ma mkhas pa zhig yod pa de la lhag par chags pas dus 'da' ba zhig go /de 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ snga dro zhig bcom ldan 'das de'i thad du bsod snyoms la gshegs te phyi rol gyi sgo drung na bzhugs

so/ /der gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i 'od btang nas khyim snang bar mdzad pas ston pa byon par shes nas phyir 'gro bar brtsams pa na/ rab tu byung dogs te bud med kyis dga' bo'i gos kyi mtha' nas 'jus te bkag kyang nan gyis 'chu bas gos kyi steng du chus mtshan ma btab ste/ 'di ma bskams par byon zhig /ma byung na pa ṇa lnga brgya bcad do/ /de nas dga' bos phyir 'ongs te bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal/ lhung bzed blangs nang du 'ongs te/ kha zas mchog gis bkang nas de bzhin gshegs pa la 'bul bar phyin pa na/ de nyid du ma bzhes par phyi bzhin 'brang pa/ 'phags pa ā nanda la'ang ma len cig pa'i brda mdzad nas phyir gshegs pa'i rjes su 'brangs te n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra bar bsod snyoms phul/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis yongs su gsol ba'i lhag ma gcung dga' bo nyid la gnang ste/ de za zhing 'dug pa'i tshe bka' stsal pa/ khyod ci ste rab tu mi 'byung ste rab tu byung zhig /de bzhin gshegs pa ni sngon thugs dang po bskyed pa nas bzung*/ mkhan po'am/ slob dpon nam/ pha'am/ ma'am/ bkur bar 'os pa su'i yang dag chos dang ldan pa nam yang gcog par ma mdzad pas shin tu bka' btsan pa'i phyir bka' las 'gong bar ma nus te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag rab tu byung ngo zhes zhus so/ /de nas ston pas 'di'i skra bregs shig ces gsungs te/ phyi rol tu 'breg mkhan bos te 'breg par brtsams pa na/ des nga ni mi ring bar stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur te/ gal te khyod kyis nga'i skra 'breg na de'i tshe khyod kyi lag pa gcod do zhes sdigs pas 'breg mkhan skrag ste 'breg spyad kyang sbas so/ /de nas ston pa nyid kyis chu snod phyag tu bzhes/ dga' bo'i mgo la blugs te 'breg mkhan des skra dang kha spu bregs so/ /des bsams pa/ da lta ni ston pa'i bkas rab tu mi 'byung ba'i dbang med kyi/

mun pa sros pa na khyim du 'gro'o snyam ste de'i tshe song ba na/ ston pas g.yang sa chen po sprul pas slar ldog nas nam langs na 'gro'o snyam/ nam langs ma thag ston pa'i bkas dga' bo khang skyong byed du bcug go /de nas dge slong rnams bsod snyoms la song ba'i 'og tu dga' bos phyag dar byas la khyim du 'gro'o snyam na'ang*/ phyag dar zin dus med par gyur te 'phro bor nas sgo bcad de 'gro'o snyam pa la sgo gcig bcad pa na gzhan gcig bye ba sogs de yang zin pa med de/ sgo bcad 'phro bor nas/ bdag rgyal por gyur na 'di bas lhag pa'i gtsug lag khang bya'o zhes song ste lam po che la phyin pa la ston pa dang mjal gyi dogs nas gseb lam zhig nas song bas/ lam de nyid nas ston pa tshur 'byon pa mthong ste/ shing gi yal ga thur du 'phyang ba'i phag tu yib pa las/ bcom ldan 'das phyogs der byon pa na yal ga rang nyid gyen du 'phags so/ /dga' bo gar 'gro tshur shog /'dong ngo zhes bka' stsal pa na/ de ngo tsha zhing zhum pas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyi bzhin du song ngo*/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod du gshegs te/ ri dwags 'dzin gyi ma sa ga'i gtsug lag khang na bzhugs so/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gcung dga' bo la ri spos ngad ldan lta bar spro ba bskyed nas/ chos gos kyi mtha' la dga' bo 'jur bcug ste de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' la gshegs nas ri spos ngad ldan gyi a mra'i shing drung du byon no/ /de na nags kyi spra mo zhar ma zhig 'dug ste/ ston pa'i bka' las khyod kyi pun da rī ka dang*/ 'di gnyis gzugs gang bzang*/ nga ni gnyis ka la chags pa dang bral bas khyad par mi rig go ces gsungs pas/ btsun pa 'di ni dpe dang rgyu yang mi 'gro ste/ pun da rī ka ni lha'i bu mo dang 'gran pa lags so/ /zhes zhus so/ /bka' stsal pa/ dga' bo spra mo 'di la'ang 'dod pa dang*/

sdug pa dang*/ yid du 'ong bar byed pa ni yod do/ /yang sngar bzhin du nam mkha' la gshegs te/ mthar sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i gnas su byon pa na/ dga' tshal gyi skyed mos tshal du bzhugs te/ dga' bo khyod song la sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams la ltos shig ces gsungs pas des kyang thams cad du lta bar song ba na/ gnas thams cad na lha dang lha mo gnyis ka 'khod pa las/ gzhal med khang gcig na lha'i bu med par lha mo kho nas gang ba mthong nas 'di ci zhes dṛs pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gcung po dga' bo zhes bya ba zhig yong par 'dug ste/ de tshul khrims bsrungs na shi nas 'dir skye bar 'gyur te bdag cag de la sgug cing sdod do/ /de ltar na punṭa rī kas lha mo de dag gi brgya stong gi char yang mi 'gran/ dpe dang rgyur yang ma rung nas de la chags pa drag po de ldog par gyur cing*/ lha la smon pas tshul khrims la brtson no/ /de nas mnyan yod du phebs shing*/ dus gzhan zhig na dga' bo la dmyal ba'i gnas lta ba spro bar mdzad de/ sngar bzhin dga' bo chos gos kyi grwa la 'jur bcug nas dmyal ba'i gnas su gshegs nas/ dga' bo dmyal gnas rnams ltar bcug pas/ des kyang dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa mthong bas shin tu yid skyo zhing*/ phyogs gcig na zangs snod zangs zhun khol mas gang ba srog chags med pa zhig mthong ste/ dmyal srung rnams la dris pas bcom ldan 'das kyi gcung po dga' bo zhes bya ba lha'i 'jig rten la dga' bas tshul khrims bsrungs na/ de lha nas shi 'phos nas 'dir 'ong bas/ de'i ched du 'di dag sdogs te kho bo cag kyang de la sdod cing 'khod do/ /der 'jigs skrag spu zing zhes byed de dbugs kyang 'kham/ myur bar bros nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ste/ rgyas par gsol ba la/ der 'jig rten la smon pa'i nyes dmigs gsungs pas dga' bo la nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa skyes so/

/de nas dus gzhan zhig na/ bcom ldan 'das grong khyer tsam pa na drang srong gar ga'i rdzing 'gram gyi gtsug lag khang na zhugs pa'i tshe/ dga' bo la sogs pa dge slong lnga brgya la mngal du 'dug pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs gsungs/ dga' bos ni bden pa mthong la/ gzhan lnga brgyas ni dgra bcom pa thob

bo/ /de nas nyin zhag 'ga' zhig 'das pa na gcung dga' bos kyang dgra bcom pa thob ste/ dbang po'i sgo bsdams pa rnams kyi mchog tu lung bstan to/ zhe lnga pa dge slong ma'i dge 'dun bstan pa ni/ yang phyis bcom ldan 'das ser skya na n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa la sngon nu ma bsnun pa'i ma mar gyur pa skye rgu'i bdag mo chen mo gau ta mī shākya mo lnga brgya dang lhan cig 'ongs te/ bud med kyi dge sbyong tshul gyis 'bras bu bzhi thob pa'i skabs mchis na/ bdag cag bud med rnams rab tu byung zhing bsnyen rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes zhus pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gau ta mī 'di ltar khyod gos dkar po gyon la nam 'tsho'i bar du de 'ba' zhig pas tshangs par spyad pa spyod cig khyod la yun ring por phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bka' stsal nas rab tu 'byung bar ma gnang la/ lan gnyis lan gsum du zhus kyang ma gnang ngo*/ /de nas ston pa yul pṛ dzi'i ljongs brgyud de/ yul na di kar gshegs nas go dzi zhes bya ba'i gnas na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe gau ta mī lnga brgya yang skra bregs nas/ gos sbyar ma gyon te/ ston pa 'khor bcas kyi phyi bzhin 'brangs nas gnas der ston pa'i zhabs la btud de sngar bzhin du lan gsum du gsol ba btab kyang*/ sngar bzhin bka' stsal te ma gnang ngo*/ /de nas de dag phyi rol sgo khang gi phyogs gcig tu ngu zhing 'dug pa 'phags pa kun dga' baus mthong ste dri lan rgyas par byas te dbugs phyung nas/ de rnams kyis ji ltar gsol ba bzhin zhus pas/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis bud med rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs par ma gsol cig bud med rab tu byung na chos 'dul ba yun ring du gnas par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs rgyas par bka' stsal pa las/ lan gnyis lan gsum du zhus pa las mthar gnang ste/ 'on kyang dgag cing mi 'da' ba'i phyir lci ba'i chos brgyad bcas pa la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bslab par bya'o/

/de nas kun dga' bos lci ba'i chos brgyad de dag la bshad cing*/ de dag gis kyang bslab par gyur pa 'di ni bdag gi ngag dang yid dang spyi bos kyang nod do/ /zhes khas blangs ba tsam gyis skye rgu'i bdag mo sogs shākya mo lnga brgya dge slong mar gyur zhing*/ bud med rab tu 'byung bar 'dod pa gzhan dag la gsol bzhi'i cho ga yang rjes su gnang ngo*/ /gau ta mī lnga brgya po de rnams kyang yun ring ma lon par dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas so/ /gcung dga' bo dang skye rgu'i bdag mo rab tu byung ba'i skor 'di rnams yab sras mjal ba'i dus kyi skabs nas lo mang dag cig lon pa na byung bar 'dug kyang mtshams gang du 'jug gi gsal kha med phyin/ shākya'i rigs btul ba'i gtam rgyud phyogs mthun pa'i phyir skabs 'dir bkod do/ /zhe drug pa grong khyer slob ma lta bur phebs pa ni/ yul der khyim bdag ṛddhi na zhes bya ba zhig la bu 'byor len 'byor skyob 'byor dga' zhes bya ba dang*/ bran mo las btsas pa'i bu gang po zhes bya ba yod pa las/ gang pos rgya mtsho chen por zhugs te rin po che len thengs lan bdun song ba las/ bdun pa'i skabs su gru nang du yul dbus kyi tshong pa rnams kyis mdo sde dag bton pas rkyen byas te/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thos nas rab tu 'byung bar 'dod pa skyes so/ /de nas gang po dang nor gcig pa 'byor len yin pas zong rnams de la gtad/ ji ltar byas kyang 'o skol gyi yo byad zad par mi 'gyur gyi/ rgya mtsho chen po 'di 'jigs pa dang bcas pa yin pas ma 'gro zhig ces gdams te/ gang po nyid rim gyis yul dbus su chas so/ /mnyan yod du sleb ste khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi drung du phyin nas brda lon sbyar bas nang du bos te gang gi phyir byon zhes dris pas/ ston pa'i spyan sngar rab tu byung ba'i phyir 'ongs so zhes brjod pa na/

zas sbyin rjes su yi rang bar gyur te/ nangs par lhan cig tu spyan sngar song ngo*/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs te/ gnas pa'i yul du bas mtha'i gnas mal brten zhing zla ba gsum du bsgrubs pas dgra bcom par gyur te/ tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang po zhes grags so/ /de nas byams ma'i bu gang pos bzod pa'i go cha chen po bgos pas rngon pa cig dad cing ri khrod pa pho lnga brgya dang mo lnga brgya dge bsnyen pho mor bcug nas mtha' 'khob kyi yul tha dad pa rnams su de rnams su de rnams kyis gtsug lag khang lnga brgya lnga brgya yang byed du bcug go /byams ma'i bu gang po rab tu byung ba'i shul du 'byor skyabs dang 'byor dga'i nor ni zad/ 'byor len dang phyogs gcig byed 'dod pa la/ 'byor len gyis nga'i nor ni lugs chos dang mthun par bsgrubs pa yin/ khyed gnyis kyis ni ma yin pas mi bsre'o byas pa na/ nu bo gnyis kyis smras pa/ bran mo'i bus yang yang rgya mtshor phyin nas blangs pa yin mod/ khyed kyis rgya mtshor 'gro ni ma nus nor ci zhig bsgrubs zhes byas so/ /tshig de gnad du phog nas 'byor len tshong pa lnga brgya dang bcas te rgya mtshor zhugs/ tsan dan sa mchog gi gling du sleb ste/ tshong pa rnams kyis tsan dan dag bcad cing gru bkang ste tshur 'phags so/ /de'i tshe gling de srung ba'i gnod sbyin dbang phyug chen po zhes bya ba/ gnod sbyin gyi mdun sa thag ring por song ba las/ gnod sbyin gzhan dag gis sbran te skabs der de yang der sleb nas rlung nag po mi bzad pa btang bas gru shin tu bskyod pa'i tshe tshong pa lnga brgya po rnams ches skrag pas tsham tshom du gyur kyang*/ 'byor len ci bder 'dug pa la gzhan rnams kyis rgyu dris pas/ gang po zer ba de bden/ de'i ngag ma nyan pas 'di ltar gyur mod/ da ni thabs med pa la tsab tsob byar ci yod byas pas/

tshong pa thams cad kyis gang po bdag nyid chen por shes nas/ thams cad kyis gang po la skyabs su mchi'o zhes byas so/ /de gang po la dga' ba'i lhas sbran te/ der gang pos rdzu 'phrul gyis skad cig gis gru'i steng du 'ongs pa na/ rlung nag po de'ang ri rab la thogs pa bzhin du phyir ldog go /de nas gang pos gnod sbyin de la khyod kyis ci'i ched du tsandan srung*/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i ched du'o/ /de bas kyang ches mchog tu gyur pa sangs rgyas yin pas de'i don du tsandan rnams thong zhig gsungs pas gnod sbyin gyis kyang btang ngo*/ /de nas gru bde bar 'ongs te grong khyer slob ma can du sleb nas/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang tsan dan gyi khang bzang byas nas spun thams cad blo mthun par sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa spyan drang par byas shing*/ rgyal po dang yang blo mthun par byas so/ /de nas 'phags pa byams ma'i bu gang pos khang stengs su 'dzegs/ mchod pa rnams bshams/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du kha phyogs te ston pa 'khor bcas spyan 'dren pa'i don du gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus me tog rnams khang bzang du gyur/ bdug spos ni sprin gyi rnam pa dang*/ chu ni bai ṭūrya'i phung po'i rnam par gyur te nam mkha' la 'phags te song bar kun kyis mthong zhing*/ de ma thag rgyal byed kyi tshal du ston pa'i spyan sngar mchod rdzas rnams sleb pa na/ kun dga' bos 'di gang nas byung zhus shing*/ ston pas slob ma can nas yin pa dang*/ dpag tshad brgya phrag du ma'i thag yod par gsungs/ dge slong rnams la nangs par grong khyer slob ma lta bur zan za bar spro ba dag tshul long shing long shig ces bsgrags te tshul shing brims pa na/ yul chu mangs na gnas pa'i gang po shes rab rkyang pas rnam par grol pa'i dgra bcom pas kyang len par brtsams pa na/ kun dga' bos rdzu 'phrul dang mi ldan pas ma yin par brda sprad pa na/

des rdzu 'phrul mod la bsgrubs te/ gnas brtan gnyis la tshul shing 'brim pa'i bar du 'grub nas/ gsum pa la ma brims pa'i sngon du blangs so/ /yul de mu stegs can lhag par gnas pa'i phyir dge slong rnams rdzu 'phrul ston par bkas gnang ngo*/ /nangs par snga bar grong khyer slob ma can gyi rgyal pos grong khyer phyag bdar dang tsan dan gyi chus chag chag dang mchod pa sna tshogs bshams/ rgyan sna tshogs bkram/ grong khyer la sgo chen po bco brgyad yod pa las/ sgo gzhan bcu bdun du ni rgyal po'i sras bcu bdun po re re bzhag shar gyi sgo mo cher rgyal po rang nyid 'phags pa byams ma'i bu gang po dang*/ 'byor len spun dang bcas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs mang po dang bcas pa lhan cig 'dug go /der nam langs ma thag nas dge slong lo ma dang snod spyad 'drim pa dang*/ chu'i sta gon byed pa dag rdzu 'phrul gyis der sleb pa la/ rgyal pos sangs rgyas byon nam snyam dris pas/ gang pos 'di lta'o zhes smras so/ /de nas dge slong gnas brtan rnams sna tshogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang bcas te der byon te/ de skad du/ kha cig seng ge stag dang glang chen rta dang klu dang khyu mchog bzang po chibs/ kha cig rin chen gzhal med khang dang ri dang shing mdzes shing rta 'bar ba la brten/ /gzhan dag nam mkha'i ngos las chu 'dzin glog gi phreng bas brgyan pa lta bur ni/ /rab tu dgyes shing lha yi pho brang lta bur rdzu 'phrul dag gis gshegs par brtson/ /la la sa brtol gyen du 'byung*/ /'ga' zhig nam mkha'i dkyil nas 'bab/ kha cig stan las sprul par byed/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i mthu la ltos/ zhes pa ltar ro/ /de'i rjes su bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du zhabs bsil te/ dri gtsang khang la zhabs bzhag pa'i tshe/ sa chen po rnam pa drug tu g.yos pa dang*/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i 'od zer bkye ste/ phyogs thams cad du khyab pa na yang*/

slob ma can gyi rgyal po ngo mtshar gyur pa la gang pos de dang der brda sprod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgra bcom lnga brgya dang thabs cig tu nam mkha' la gshegs shing*/ rgyal byed tshal na gnas pa'i lhas shing ba ku la'i yal ga chen po zhig bzung ste ston pa'i sku la bsil grib 'bul zhing song ba la chos bstan pas lha des kyang rgyun du zhugs pa thob bo/ /de nas lam bar gyi yul phyogs gzhan zhig na yug sa mo lnga brgya tsam gnas pas sangs rgyas sku mtshan dpe 'bar ba nam mkha' la byon pa mthong ste/ dad pas de rnams kyis gdan bshams pa la ston pa bzhugs te chos bstan pas de nyid du yug sa mo lnga brgyas bden pa mthong zhing*/ de dag gis gsol ba btab pa la rdzu 'phrul gyis bcad de dbu skra dang sen mo yang gnang*/ de'i mchod rten yang brtsigs/ lha des shing ba ku la'i yal ga de'ang der btsugs pas sdong po rab tu rgyas par gyur to// de nas yang nam mkha'i lam la gshegs shing byon pa na/ yul gzhan zhig gi bsti gnas na drang srong lnga brgya gnas te/ de rnams kyi dregs pa gzhom pa'i phyir rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus skad cig la me tog dang 'bras bu ni brlag chu ni bskams/ ne'u seng ni rlog 'dug gnas rnams sdibs so/ /de dag yid khong du chud pa la bka' stsal pa/ ci'i phyir sems khong du chud/ gsol ba/ khyed gshegs pas gnas skabs 'di 'dra bar gyur to/ /'o na sngon bzhin du bya'am/ bcom ldan 'das mdzad du gsol/ de ma thag sngon bzhin du gyur pas ya mtshan skyes pa la chos bstan pas de rnams kyis phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob cing rdzu 'phrul yang bsgrubs/ tshur shog gis bsnyen par yang rdzogs nas 'bad pa dang brtson 'grus brtsams pas de'i mod la dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /de rnams kyang zhabs 'bring du 'ongs shing*/ brtun gyi ri la gnas pa'i drang srong shing lo'i gos can gyis thag ring po nas mthong bas dad pa skyes te ri de las mchongs pas/

ston pas rdzu 'phrul gyis blangs te sa la bzhagachos bstan pa nas dgra bcom thob pa'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgra bcom pa stong gis yongs su bskor te nam mkha' la cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa ston zhing slob ma lta bur gshegs pa na/ sgo gcig nas gshegs na sgo gzhan dag na 'khod pa rnams mi dga' bar 'gro bar mkhyen nas/ nam mkha'i lam las grong khyer gyi dbus su gshegs so/ /rgyal po 'khor bcas ston pa'i drung du 'ongs shing zhabs la phyag btsal/ de nas bcom ldan 'das tsan dan gyi khang bzang du dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa la bzhugs/ rgyal po la sogs pas mchod pa dpag tu med pas yang dag par mchod/ phyi rol tu 'khod pa'i skye bo rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das ma mthong nas khang bzang zhig pa la thug pa tsam du gyur pa na/ khang bzang shel gtsang ma'i rang bzhin du sprul nas sangs rgyas kyi sku sgrib pa med par mthong bas rab tu dga' bar gyur/ de nas 'khor de dag gi bsam pa thugs su chud pas yang dag pa'i chos bstan pa na/ 'khor tshogs dpag tu med pa zhig nges par 'byed pa dang 'bras bu bzhi la bkod cing*/ byang chub gsum du sems bskyed pa la sogs pa mtha' yas pa'i bar du'o/ /de nas nyi ma gzhan zhig la 'byor len gyis gdugs tshod 'bul bar brtsams pa'i dus kyi tshe klu'i rgyal po nag po dang gau ta ma gnyis klu lnga brgya'i 'khor dang bcas te sangs rgyas la blta ba'i ched du 'brug gi sgra 'byin/ chu bo'i lnga brgya 'bebs bzhin du chas par gzigs te de dag 'ongs na grong khyer bur mar brlag ste 'gro bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang maung gal gyi bus gdugs tshod kyi skal ba sngon la bzhes nas/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram du klu gnyis kyi gan du phar gshegs te/ grong cher slob ma lta bur gnas pa rnams la gnod pa ma byed cig ces bka' stsal/ des kyang srog chags grog sbur tsam la'ang gnod pa mi bgyid do zhes zhus/

klu de dag skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gnas la bkod/ chos bstan pas dad par mdzad do/ /de nas zas kyi bya ba mdzad pa na/ klu de dag gis kyang chu'i btung ba 'bul lo snyam pa maung gal gyi bus klus phab pa'i chu bo lnga brgya 'dres pa las lhung bzed gang blangs te ston pa la phul zhing gsol to/ /zhe bdun pa 'od zer can du gshegs pa ni/ de nas mi ring ba'i dus zhig na/ 'phags pa maung gal gyi bu chen pos rang gi ma la phan gdags par 'dod nas ma de 'gro ba'i gnas gang du skyes zhes rnam par brtags pa na gang du yang ma mthong ste/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la don de zhus pa na/ 'di nas nub phyogs kyi ngos la 'jig rten gyi khams 'od zer can zhes bya ba yod de der skyes so/ /de nas maung gal gyi bus bdag gi ma de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi gdul byar 'gyur ba lags pas thugs brtse bas nye bar bzung ste gdul bar gsol/ bka' stsal pa/ maung gal gyi bu 'o skol cag su'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi rdzu 'phrul gyi'o/ /de nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i dbus ma'i ri rab kyi rtse mo nas nub phyogs logs kyi stong gsum gzhan gyi ri rab dbus ma'i rtse mor gom pa gcig 'dor ba de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul gyis byon nas/ nyin zhag bdun 'das pa na 'od zer can du 'byon to/ /sngon maung gal gyi bu'i mar gyur pa dus der bu mo bzang mo zhes bya bar yod de/ des 'phags pa maung gal gyi rgyang ring po nas mthong ste bu'i 'du shes nye bar skyes nas/ e ma ho yun ring po zhig lon nas bdag gi bu mthong ngo zhes 'phags pa'i phyogs su rgyugs shing drung du gtugs so/ /der skye bo'i tshogs kyi dge slong 'di ni rgan/ bu mo 'di ni gzhon na 'di ni 'di'i ma ji ltar yin/ de nas maung gal gyi bus don de rgyas par bshad do/

bcom ldan 'das kyis bu mo de la chos bstan pas des kyang rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob cing*/ des phul ba'i gdugs tshod kyang gsol/ yon bshad par yang mdzad nas lhung bzed 'khru bzhin pa'i skabs/ maung gal gyi bu la da ni rgyal byed kyi tshal du 'gro'am/ maung gal bus zhus pa 'tshal lo/ /su'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro/ bcom ldan 'das kyi'o/ /'o na rgyal byed kyi tshal yid la gyis shig gsung*/ de kho nas rgyal byed kyi tshal du byon te/ ston pas 'di ni rdzu 'phrul yid mgyogs zhes bya'o/ /maung gal gyi bu ngo mtshar du gyur nas bla na med pa'i byang chub la bsngags shing ched du brjod pa mdzad do/

/zhe brgyad pa bram ze padma'i snying po btul ba ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rim gyis mnyan yod nas gshegs te/ yul 'dod pa mthun pa'i ljongs rgyu zhing*/ 'dod pa mthun pa'i nags khrod na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe bram ze padma'i snying po bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya la gsang tshig klog ga ོ /des ston pa 'dod pa mthun pa'i nags khrod du bzhugs pa thos nas/ bram ze'i khye'u ma sdug la khyod shes ldan gau ta ma ga la ba der song la/ shes ldan gau ta ma de bla na med pa'i byang chub brnyes so zhes thos te/ ji ga de'i dge ba dang grags pa'i gtam dang*/ de'i mtshan bzang po rnams kyang yang dag pa yin nam ma yin rtog shigade nas bram ze rgan rabs mang po dang lhan cig tu song nas ston pa'i spyan sngar sleb pa na/ ston pas bram ze rnams dga' ba dang mgu bar 'gyur ba'i chos gsungs pa'i tshe/ khye'u ma sdug de lham gyon nas 'chag cing*/ glo bur du gtam smra la/ gtam mthar phyin par mi sdod/ ma gus pas bsnyas shing slar zlog par byed do/ /ston pas khyed bram ze gsum rig pa dang gtam 'di lta bu smra'am/ gsol pa/ bram ze 'gro ba rnams ni 'gro ba dang*/ 'greng ba rnams ni 'greng ba dag dang smra/ 'dug pa dang nyal ba dag kyang phan tshun smra ste/ dge sbyong mgo breg nag po'i rtsa lag dag dang 'di ltar gleng du rung ngo*/ /bka' stsal pa/ khyod bla ma'i tshogs la bsnyen bkur ma byas pa zhig go /de khros 'khrugs yid ma rangs nas/ gau ta ma shākya rnams ni da byung gi rigs yin pas bram ze rnams la bla mar mi byed do/ /bka' stsal pa/ shākya rnams kyis khyod la gnod pa byas sam/ gsol ba/ nga bya ba zhig la ser skyar song ba na/ 'di ni bram ze khye'u yin no zhes mdzub skor gyis ston par byed de bkur bsti mi byed do/ /bka' stsal pa/ re zhig bye'u khug rta yang rang gi tshang du ji ltar 'dod par skad 'byin na shākya rnams smos ci dgos/

ser skya gzhi 'di ni shākya rnams rang gis gnas yin no/ /gsol ba/ rigs bzhi po rnams kyis bram ze la bkur bsti byed kyang*/ shākya 'di dag da byung kho na yin pas mi byed do/ /bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyi rigs ci yin/ gsol ba/ mig mi 'dzum gyi'o/ /bka' stsal pa/ de ni shākya rnams kyi bran mo'i bu las byung ngo*/ /de nas bram ze rgan rabs rnams kyis gsol ba/ kye gau ta ma de skad ma gsung zhig ma sdug 'di ni mang du thos pas lan btab pas rdo thogs so/ /bka' stsal pa/ don 'di la khyed cag ma smra bar ma sdug nyid lan 'debs su chug cig /bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes kyis bu bzhi bskrang pa las shākyar grags so/ /shākya'i mgo 'dzugs pa de yin pa khyod kyis thos sam/ gsol ba thos so/ /bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes kyi bran mo sdod phod ma zhes bya ba dang*/ gdol ba'i rigs kyi drang srong zhig 'dus pa las khye'u btsas pa na/ sha za rnams kyis mig mi 'dzum gyis zhes ming btags so/ /mig mi 'dzum gyi mgo 'dzugs pa de yin par thos sam/ de ltar lan gnyis lan gsum du dri ba mdzad kyang*/ ma sdug gnong thog tu bab pas cang mi smra'o/ /de'i tshe gnod sbyin lag na rdo rjes khyod lan bden par mi gsol na/ rdo rjes mgo bo tshal ba bdun du 'gags par bya'o zhes rdo rje me 'bar ba phyar zhing ma sdug la sdigs pas skrag ste/ gau ta ma mig mi 'dzum gyi thog ma de lags par thos so zhes drang por gsol to/ /de nas bram ze gzhan thams cad ston pas ni bden par gsungs na/ bdag cag sngar yid ma ches par zad do snyam mo/ /bka' stsal pa/ khyed rnams kyis ma sdug la bran mo'i bu zhes ma smra zhig drang srong de ni rdzu 'phrul che ba yin no zhes so/ /de nas ma sdug shin tu zhum par gyur pa la slar yang gtam 'jam pos gleng bar mdzad nas/ zhus lan shin tu rgyas par mdzad pa'i mthar/ bram ze las kyang rgyal rigs gra ma mchog tu bsngags te/

'di skad du/ rus dang 'brel ba gang yin pa'i/ /rgyal rigs rkang gnyis nang na btsun/ /lha dang mi rnams nang na yang*/ /rig dang zhabs su ldan pa btsun/ /zhes mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas smras pa'i lung 'dren par mdzad do/ /de nas ma sdug dad pa chen po skyes te chos ston par gsol ba btab pa la/ ston pas dga' ba dang mgu bar gyur pa'i chos rgya cher gsungs nas/ gang gi don du khyod 'ongs pa'i mtshan ma legs par zung zhig /des kyang de bar du brtags pas/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu ni mthong ste/ gsol ba/ bdag gis thub pa chen po'i mtshan/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis thob pa gang*/ /sku la gnyis shig ma mthong bas/ zhais sogs zhus pas ljags ky-i dkyil 'khor zhal ras khebs pa bstan zhing*/ lba ba sbubs su nub pa yang 'od kyi mtshan mas gsal bar mdzad do/ /de nas ma sdug dang bram ze'i tshogs rnams phyir dengs nas bram ze padma'i snying po'i drung du phyin te gtam de dag rgyas pas bshad do/ /der bram ze padma'i snying po khros te mchil lham gyis ma sdug gi mgo bor brdegs shing*/ kye ma ho pho nya byed pa kye ma ho 'phrin byed pa 'di 'dra bas ni bdag kyang ngan song du ltung bar 'gyur ro/ khyod kyis shes ldan gau ta ma la khyad du bsad pa de ltar byas pa'i khongs su kho bo yang brtsi bar dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smra'o/ /shes ldan dag deng kho bo gau ta ma la blta bar 'gro ba las dgongs mor song bas ma nus par zad de sang 'gro'o/ /de'i nub mo sta gon byas te/ nangs par shing rta mang po bza' btung gis bkang zhing*/ bram ze'i tshogs rnams kyis yongs su bskor te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ngo*/ /der 'dod pa mthun pa na gnas pa'i dge slong thams cad bsdus te gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bsod snyoms rgya cher phul/ yon bsngo ba mdzad/ bram ze de dag dga' ba dang mgu bar 'gyur ba'i gtam yang dag par mdzad de de'i mthar gsol ba/

khar sang bram ze'i khye'u ma sdug 'ongs sam/ bka' mchid ji lta bu mdzad/ ston pas rgyas par bka' stsal pas/ de byis pa'i rang bzhin lags pas bzod par mdzad du gsol/ bram ze bzod do/ /gsol ba/ shes ldan gau ta ma bdag shing rtar zhugs pa'am/ srab skyogs 'dzin pa'am/ thor tshugs la nom pa'i bar du byas na phyag 'tshal bar bzung du gsol/ zhes sogs zhus pa na/ 'di da dung nga rgyal dang bcas so dgongs te/ de'i nga rgyal spang pa'i don du chos bstan pas bram ze padma'i snying pos rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob ste ched du brjod pa yang byas so/ /de dag la sogs pa yul 'dod pa mthun pa na gnas pa'i bram ze dang skye bo gzhan yang dpag tu med pa bden pa la bkod de/ byang chub gsum la gzhol bar mdzad do/ /zhe dgu pa khye'u gnyis ni/ yang dus gzhan zhig na/ rgyal rigs dang bram ze'i khye'u sprang po gnyis shig dge 'dun la gdugs tshod gsol pa'i sar slong du song ba la/ bram ze'i bus ni ster ba'i dus ma yin par phyin pas ci yang ma thob la/ rgyal rigs kyi bu des dus su phyin pas mang du thob bo/ bram ze'i khye'u de dge 'dun rnams la khros te/ kho bo la dbang yod na 'di rnams kyi mgo bo drung nas gcod pa zhig ces zer la/ rgyal rigs na re/ kho bo la dbang yod na/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa la zhal zas ro brgya pas stob pa zhig ces zer ba las/ mnyan yod na bram ze'i bu de shing drung zhig tu nyal ba la shing rta 'khyams po'i 'khor los de'i mgo bcad do/ /chos rnams sngon du yid 'gro yid gtso yi/ /yid mgyogs rab tu sdang ba'i yid kyis ni/ /smras sam byas na de la sdug bsngal de/ /'thob 'gyur 'khor lo 'phyan pas mgo bo bcad/ /ces gsungs/ de'i tshe tshong dpon gcig bu med par shi ba las/ tshong pa rnams bgros nas gang su zhig bsod nams che ba zhig tshong dpon du bkur ro zhes brtags pa na/

sngar gyi rgyal rigs kyi khye'u de shing drung zhig tu nyal ba la shing gzhan rnams kyi grib ma 'phos kyang de ma 'phos te/ bsod nams dang ldan par rig nas tshong dpon chen por dbang bskur te 'byor pa dpag tu med pa dang ldan par gyur nas/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa la gdugs tshod gsol zhing*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la chos bstan pas bden pa mthong ngo*/ /lnga bcu pa klu dga' bo nye dga' btul ba ni/ de'i tshe klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang*/ gnyen dga' bo gnyis sbrul gyi lus ring pos ri rab la skor ba gsum du dkri bar nus pa de dag yun ring du gnyid log cing gnyid sad pa na/ dbugs kyi rlung drag po btang bas ri rab dang gser gyi ri la gnas pa'i bya dang ri dwags sogs srog chags du ma dag dug gis shi nas mtsho nang du lhung ba rnams bza' bar byed do/ /dge slong rdzu 'phrul thob pa dag ri rab kyi bang rim na gnas shing bsam gtan sgom pa dag kyang dbugs kyi rlung dug dang bcas pa des phog pas lus rid cing skya bo seng seng por gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gyis 'phags pa maung gal gyi bu la bka' stsal pa/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang gnyen dga' bo gnyis la soms shig de nas 'phags pa maung gal gyi bus der rdzu 'phrul gyis song nas/ de gnyis gnyid kyis log pa la se gol gyi sgra byas so/ /der de gnyis gnyid ma sad/ de dag gi lus kyi steng du phan tshun du zhabs kyis bcags kyang gnyid ma sad nas/ de dag gi khong pa'i nang du song ste yar mar du rgyu zhing sna nas 'thon nas nam mkha' la 'phags te yang 'jug pa sogs mdzad kyang da dung gnyid ma sad do/ /de nas ri rab la lan bdun du dkri bar nus pa'i sbrul chen po ches mi bzad pa zhig tu sprul te/ de gnyis 'og tu mnan pa na gnyid sad de bltas pa na/ klu shin tu mi bzad pas rang nyid non par shes nas shin tu skrag ste bram ze'i gzugs kyis bros pa na/

ji ltar ri bo khor yug la nye ba de ltar bros pa'i tshe/ de dag gi mdun du 'phags pa maung gal gyi bu lus dngos su bstan te byon nas/ ci klu dag gar 'gro/ klu gnyis kyis bsams pa/ de ni dge slong 'di'i mthu yin yang dag go snyam nas/ 'phags pa ku re ma bgyis sam/ ci ston pa'i pho nya la mi sems sam/ 'o na ji ltar bgyi/ der dad par 'gyur ba'i chos bshad nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dong ngo zhes khrid nas/ ston pas kyang rgya mtsho'i ngogs su gshegs te bzhugs pa na/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang gnyen dga' bo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod pa du mas yang dag par mchod nas zhabs la phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis las ngan pa la rab tu smad cing chos bstan/ ri rab kyi bang rim na gnas pa rnams la gnod pa mi byed par bka' stsal/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi la bkod do/ /de ltar dga' bo dang nye dga' bo chos la bkod pa de'i tshe nas brtsams te klu'i 'gro ba 'bum phrag mang po zhig mi ring bar chos la 'khod par gyur to/ /nga gcig pa gsal rgyal klu'i gnod pa las bskyab pa ni/ de nas klu gnyis bo de dus bzang bo dag la ri rab kyi bang rim nas mnyan yod kyi bar du rin po che'i rwa ba gnyis dag byas pa de'i bar nas song ste ston pa la bsnyen bkur byed do/ /yang res 'ga' mtshan mo gzhal med khang nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i nang du zhugs nas lha'i cha byad kyis 'ong la/ nyin mo ni khye'u 'am khyim bdag gi cha byad kyi 'ong bar byed na/ klu gnyis po de la 'khor grags pa dang ldan zhing stobs dang ldan pa'i klu nyis stong lnga brgya re yod do/ /gzhal med khang rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa dang*/ bza' btung rnams lha'i bdus rtsi'o/ /de nas lan gcig khyim bdag gi gzugs kyis bcom ldan 'das la chos nyan zhing yod pa'i tshe/ rgyal po gsal rgyal yang ston pa'i drung du 'ong ba rgyang ring po nas mthong ste/

bdag cag gnyis rgyal po la bsnyen bkur bgyi'am chos la bsnyen bkur bgyi/ ston pas chos la bsnyen bkur gyis shig /de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal drung du byung ba la ldang ba ma byas so/ /rgyal pos bltas na de gnyis rang gi yul 'khor gyi khyim bdag 'dra bar snang na/ 'di gnyis nga'i yul du gnas nas nga la ldang ba mi byed do snyam nas khros so/ /ston pas khro ba'i nyes dmigs gsungs kyang rgyal po sems yad yud du gyur nas gsal bar snying la ma 'phrod de myur bar langs te song nas sgo drung du zho shas 'tsho ba dag cig bzhagakhyim bdag de gnyis phyir byung na mgo bo chod cig byas te skyed mos tshal du song ngo*/ /de skad zer ba klu gnyis kyi g.yog ra ba'i kha na sdod pa dag gis thos te/ rgyal po'i steng du mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'i char 'bebs par brtsams pa na/ ston pas 'phags pa maung gal gyi bu la rgyal po gsal rgyal la soms shig ces gsungs/ maung gal gyi bus mtshon cha'i char de dag padma dang utpal la sogs par byin gyis brlabs nas mi'i lag gis len nus tsam gyi bar snang la chags par byas so/ /der rgyal po dang blaun po dang btsun mo dang rgyal po'i gnyen rnams me tog gi char 'di ni rang rang gi bya ba legs pa'i bsod nams kyi mthu'o zhes ngag mi mthun par gyur nas tshur 'ongs te ston pa la zhus pas/ de dag thams cad ma yin gyi/ 'di ltar maung gal gyi bu'i mthu'o/ /gal te yid mi ches pa lta na de las gcig gcig long ste sa la bor cig der de dag gis de blangs te bor bas mtshon char gyur zhing sgra 'byin pa na shin tu skrag ste rgyal pos 'di ci zhes zhus pa na/ khyod kyis klu la sdang sems bskyed pas yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ bdag gis de mthong bar yang mi dran na zhus pas/ sngar gyi don rgyas par gsungs so/ /'on kyang klu gnyis po de ni ma khros te/ de'i 'khor dag khros pa'o/

/'o na 'di la ji ltar bgyi zhes zhus pas bzod par gsol shig gsung*/ de nas dus gzhan zhig na klu gnyis po de sngar bzhin 'ongs pa na/ ston pas sbran pa na rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis lag pa brkyangs te bzod pa gsol zhing*/ de gnyis kyis kyang bzod par byas so/ /nga gnyis pa gnod sbyin 'brog gnas btul ba ni/ gang gi tshe gsal rgyal dang gzugs can snying pos rgyal srid skyong ba na/ chom rkun pa rnams chad pas bcad pas/ de rnams ma ga dhā dang ko sa la'i bar gyi nags tshal dang 'brog dgon pa dag tu gnas te don mthun tshong pa thams cad 'joms par byed do/ /gzugs can snying po'i drung na stong thub dpa' bo zhig yod pas/ tshong pa mang po rgyal po'i khab nas ko sa lar 'gro ba'i lam sel la stong thub de mngags so/ /des mda' lnga brgya lnga brgyas gang ba'i dong pa gnyis thogs te tshong pa'i gdong nas phyin pa na/ chom rkun pa rnams kyis khyod phyir ldog cigaganod par gyur ta re/ zhes zer ba la stong thub kyis 'jam por smras kyang mi nyan te/ des chom rkun pa gcig nas lnga brgya'i bar du byung ba la mda' snun no/ /de nas chom po gzhan lnga brgya sleb pa dang*/ stong thub na re/ ngas lnga brgya bsad zin gyi khyed rnams ldog cig de dag gis nged gcig kyang ma shi na ci'-i phyir ldog

'o na go phud cig phud pa dang lnga brgya shi ste gnod sbyin zhig go zer nas thams cad byer ro/ /de nas stong thub des nags phan tshun gyi bar du lam sel gyi khyim brtsigs/ deng 'brog gnas zhes bya ba grong khyer chags/ tshong 'dus chen po yang byung*/ grong dpon yang stong thub de nyid kyis byed pa las/ dus gzhan zhig na log par lta ba'i lha khang zhig brtsigs te/ yul de'i bag gsar la 'gro ba thams cad dang por lha khang de la bawa zhing*/ phyi nas thog mar grong dpon des mi rigs par spyod pa las/ phyi zhig na grong mi rnams kyis rkyen de la brten nas grong dpon gsod par bgros pa las/ nyin gcig mchog zung grong dpon 'brog gnas kyi sar byon pa la/ der bsod snyoms phul ni zin/ yon bshad pa ma tshar ba'i bar de la yul pa rnams kyis khrus kyi rdzing bu byas te grong dpon la 'bul ba'i pho nya sleb nas de'i sar phyin te rdzing 'gram du skra bkru ba'i skabs 'gyur byed kyi 'dag rdzas dag mig tu song nas 'gags pa la/ de dag gis mtshon cha bsnun te grong dpon bsad pa na mchog zung gcig la bsod snyoms phul ba de'i mthu las 'di dag gsod pa zhig tu skye bar gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ /de ma thag de gnod sbyin gdug pa can du skyes nas rnam thos kyi bu la gnas stsol bar zhus pas/ 'brog gnas nyid byin to/ /de nas des mi nad chen po btang ste khyogs nas khyogs su 'doms pa dag byung ngo*/ /ltas mkhan rnams la dris pas grong dpon shi nas gnod sbyin du skyes pas byas so zhes byung nas/ de dag yul gzhan du 'bros par brtsams pa ni srin po'i gzugs kyis dngos su 'ongs nas lam bkag pas/ grong dpon bzod par mdzod cig byas pa la nyin re la mi stong stong 'bul na bzod do/ /de nas mthar brgya'i bar du phab bo/ /der 'ga' zhig gis de lta na grong khyer stongs par 'gyur gyi/

ba lang drug dang ldan pa'i shing rta bza' bcas bkang ba re dang*/ ba glang khrid pa'i mi re nyin re bzhin 'bul gyi bzod par mdzod cig / gnod sbyin na re/ 'o na khyod kyis de dud mo ma byed par bro gar dang glu dang rol mo dang bcas pas phul zhig de rnams kyis kyang khas blangs pas nad yams chad do/ /de nas grong pa rnams la re mos 'bab par byas/ khyim gyi ming byang rdza mar bcug ste dkrogs nas gang thon pa de tshab ma mi btang bar rang ngam bu 'gro'o zhes khrims su bcas so/ /de ltar byed cing dus 'ga' zhig 'das pa na/ khyim bdag cig yul gzhan du song ba'i dus na khyim du chung ma la bu skyes so/ /de rang khyim du 'khor ba na khyim byad sgo la btags pa mthong ngo*/ /nang du chung mas dgyes par mdzod cig /bu btsas so/ /de cang mi smra ste dris pas/ 'di ltar ro zhes bshad/ de nas des bu btang bar byas te pha ma de dag gis mtshan mo nam bsros pa na khang steng nas mchod pa bshams/ sangs rgyas la gus pa chen pos bdag gi bu bskyab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab bo/ / nangs par bu dang bcas pa'i shing rta sogs sngar bzhin song ngo*/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni mi mkhyen pa med pas/ bcom ldan 'das 'brog gnas kyi gnod sbyin gyi gnas su bzhud pa na/ dus der 'brog gnas gnod sbyin gyi mdun sar song ba la gnod sbyin bong bus rings par brda btang ste/ 'brog gnas phyir ldog 'ongs pa na/ rang gi gnas na sangs rgyas bzhugs pa mthong nas brtag pa'i phyir dge sbyong phyir phyung zhig byas pa na/ ston pas phyir byon to/ /yang nang du bzhud cig byas pa na nang du zhugs so/ /de ltar lan gsum song nas/ yang phyir byung zhig byas pa na/ bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyis gnas 'dir nga la lan gsum du byin pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs te ma bzhengs so/ /de na re/ ngas dris pa bzhin du lan thob cig ma yin na skal ldan shing rta'i slad rol du 'phang ngo*/

/ston pas khyod kyis de ltar mi nus kyi/ ci 'dod pa zhus shig ces so/ /mdo sde 'ga' zhig dang*/ gnas skabs gzhan gyi lo rgyus las/ de ltar mi nus kyi zhes gsungs pas de rab tu khros te 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis ston pa'i drung du rgyugs pa na des ston pa yi dwags ches mi sdug cing drag shul che ba/ zhal dang phyag sna tshogs par 'dug pa shin tu 'jigs su rung bar mthong ste 'jigs skrag dngangs te dran med du 'gyel lo/ /brgyal ba sangs pa na/ ston pas bka' stsal pa sogs 'byung ngo*/ /de'i tshe dris lan gyis de'i sems dad par mdzad nas/ khyod kyis mchog zung gcig la zan byin pas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lhar skye ba las smon lam log pas 'dir skyes so/ /de nas de skyabs su song zhing bslab pa'ang blangs/ 'brog gnas pa rnams la gnod pa mi byed par byas so/ /de nas ston pa'i bka' ltar de phyin chad zas skom gyi gtor ma blangs te mi dang ba lang mi len no/ /de nas khye'u de gnod sbyin gyi lag tu byung ba ston pa la phul/ ston pas pha la gnang bas de'i ming lag brgyud ces btags so/ /de ltar na skabs 'dir 'byung rgyu 'brog gnas btul ba'i mdzad pa ni de yin no/ /nga gsum pa lag brgyud bden pa la bkod pa ni/ de nas lo mang zhig lon pa'i phyis lag brgyud cher skyes te sgyu rtsal la mkhas par gyur/ grong khyer kau shambī na khyim bdag gi bu mo sngo sangs ma zhes bya ba bud med mchog cig yod pa des yul so so'i rgyal po dang tshong dpon sogs kyi gzugs byas te skye bo'i dbus su khyim thabs 'dam par byas pa lag brgyud kyi phyogs su me tog gtor ro/ /de nas sngo sangs ma kau shambī nas song ste 'brog gnas su phyin pa na/ ston pas dgongs te/ lag brgyud 'di sngo sangs ma dang 'phrad na phyis bden pa'i snod du mi 'gyur bar mkhyen nas lag brgyud la chos ston par bzhed pa la/

lag brgyud shing rtar zhugs te nam langs ma thag grong khyer gyi phyi rol du phyin pa dang*/ sngo sangs ma shing rtar zhugs te nang du 'ongs pa'i shing rta'i gnya' shing thug ste phan tshun du dris pas/ ngo shes te lag brgyud kyis de la khyod khyim du song shig nga myur du 'ong gi zer nas ston pa'i spyan sngar song ste/ ston pas lag brgyud la chos bstan pa na/ des phyir mi 'ongs gi 'bras bu thob bo/ /der lag brgyud khyim du 'khor du dga' ston ni rgya cher byas na/ des sngo sangs can la smras pa/ ngas ni phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob pas 'dod pa la mi spyod kyi/ khyod pha'i khyim du 'gro bar 'dod na'ang songs zhig 'di nyid du 'dug par 'dod na'ang ming po'i 'du shes kyis 'dug cig sngo sangs ma yang 'dod pa la chags pa shas chung bas/ bdag gis 'phags pa 'di lta bu bkur ba'i 'os su rnyed pa ni legs so snyam nas/ slob dpon gyi tshul lam ming po'i 'du shes kyis lag brgyud la bkur bsti byed cing der 'dug go /skabs de ni ston pas 'brog gnas kyi gtsug lag khang du dbyar gnas pa mdzad pa'i dus te/ 'brog gnas kyi skye bo rnams kyis rgya cher mchod cing phyogs der yang lha dang mi dpag tu med pa bden pa la bkod do/ /de nas mi ring ba zhig na lag brgyud 'brog gnas nas dus las 'das te/ gnas gtsang ma'i nang tshan mi gdung ba'i lhar skyes so/ /dus gzhan zhig na/ bcom ldan 'das 'brog gnas su byon pa de chos nyan pa'i phyir 'ongs te lus gser gyi mdog ltar snang ba 'od rab tu 'bar bas lta bar dka' ba/ ri bo dang sa gzhi sogs gang la'ang thogs pa med par 'ongs nas/ ston pa'i spyan sngar 'khod pa na/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi sa gzhi la 'dug par dka' ba la/ sa'i 'du shes skyed cig par bka' stsal nas/ der de 'dug pa la chos kyi gtam rgya cher mdzad do/ /de rab tu dga' zhing mgu nas/

de nyid du mi snang la mi gdung ba'i gnas su snang bar gyur to/ /nga bzhi pa grong khyer sgra sgrogs pa'i lo rgyus ni/ yang bcom ldan 'das 'od ma'i tshal na bzhugs so/ /sngon grong khyer sgra sgrogs dang*/ rgyal po'i khab gnyis 'byor rgud res mos su yong pa zhig yod pa las/ skabs der gnyis ka shin tu dar bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe sgra sgrogs na rgyal po u tra ya ṇa yod de/ phyogs der yul dbus kyi tshong pa lhags pa rnams slar ldog pa'i tshe rgyal po gzugs can snying po la sgrom rin po ches gang ba skyes su bskur te/ khyed ni ma mthong ba'i grogs lags so/ /grong khyer sgra sgrogs su khyed la bgyi ba cung zad mchi na/ thams cad bdag gis sgrub bo zhes byas so/ /yang gzugs can snying pos kyang gos khyad par can mang pos rab tu gang ba'i sgrom skyes su bskur te/ sngar skad springs so/ /de'ang sgra sgrogs na ni rin po che mod la/ gos mchog dkon/ ma ga dha na ni de las ldog go /de ltar tshong pa rnams la skyes phan tshun du bskur res byas pa las/ dus lan gcig u tra ya ṇas ma ga dhā'i tshong pa rnams la dris pa/ khyed kyi rgyal po lus kyi chu zheng ci 'dra/ de dag gis lha nyid ci 'dra ba de 'dra ste/ 'on kyang rgyal po gzhan dag g.yul 'thab dgos so/ /de nas u tra ya ṇas go khrab rin po che dus tshigs su lus la reg na bde ba dang*/ bcad par dka' ba dang*/ 'bugs par dka' ba dang*/ dug 'jil ba dang*/ snang ba'i bdag nyid de yan lag lnga dang ldan pa zhig skyes su bskur te/ 'di rang nyid bcang ba las gzhan su la'ang ma stsol cig byas so/ /de nas tshong pa rnams 'khor te de phul ba na/ gzugs can snying pos rin thang rtog pa po dag pos de brtags na/ thams cad kyis rin thang mi thebs par bcad do/ /de nas gzugs can snying pos de la dod mtshungs pa'i skyes lan bskur rgyu ma rnyed nas mi dga' bar gyur pa la/

bram ze dbyar byed kyis zhus pa/ lha nyid kyi yul du sangs rgyas byon pas de'i sku gzugs bris la skur zhig /rgyal pos ston pa la zhus pas legs so zhes gnang ste/ lha bzo ba dag bos nas 'brir bcug pa la/ ci tsam brtags kyang mtshan ma bzung bar ma nus nas/ yi chad pa la/ ston pas sku ji lta bu'i 'od kyi gzugs brnyan btang ba de'i steng du ri mo ba rnams kyis tshon rtsis bkang ste/ ras bris kyi sku gzugs zin par mdzad do/ /sku gzugs kyi 'og tu skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ bslab pa'i gnas lnga dang*/ rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi tshig rnams yi ger bris so/ /steng du ni/ brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar bya zhes pa la sogs pa so sor thar pa'i tshigs bcad gnyis bris so/ /der pho nya la bris sku 'di sgra sgrogs kyi sa phyogs yangs par kha phye la/ 'di dang 'di ji ltar yin cis 'dri na/ 'di dang 'di lta bu dag go rjod cig ces sogs rgyas par bslabs nas/ bris sku dri bzang sna tshogs kyis bgos te legs par gril nas gser dang dngul dang zangs kyi dong bur rim pas bcug /gos mchog sna tshogs kyis dkris/ grong khyer mdzes par byed pa sogs bkur bsti chen po dang bcas te skyes su bskur ba las rim gyis sgra sgrogs su phyin zhing 'phrin gyi yi ge sngar khyer te rgyal po u tra ya ṇa la phul ba las/ 'jig rten gsum na ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i skyes bskur yod na/ dpag tshad phyed dang gsum lam mdzes par byed pa dang*/ bdag nyid dpung dang bcas pas bsu ba mdzod/ sa phyogs yangs par bkur bsti chen po dang bcas te kha dbye bar mdzod/ ces bya ba 'dug nas/ u tra ya ṇa ni de tsam pa'i skyes ci zhig bskur na/ 'dis ngal brnyas so snyam khros te dmag shoms shig zer ba la blon po rnams na re/ rgyal po de ni bdag nyid chen po zhig lags zhes gda' na/ skyes ngan ngon zhig mi bskur bas dang por gzigs shing brtags la thugs ma mnyes na de ltar bgyi'o/

/der yi ge'i nang nas ji skad bsgo ba bzhin byas te/ sa phyogs yangs pa zhig tu ras bris de shing ring po la gzar te zhal phye ba na/ yul dbus kyi tshong pa dag gis mthong nas/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes skad phyung ngo*/ /rgyal pos sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra sngar ma thos pa der thos nas spu zing zhes byed cing mig 'bru tshugs su lta'o/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya ba su zhig der ston pa'i yon tan bsnyad cing*/ 'og gi yi ge 'di ci zhes pa la skyabs 'gro dang bslab gzhi ni bsgrub par bya ba yin pa dang*/ rten 'brel ni bsam par bya ba dang*/ steng gi yi ge ni khyad par thob pas mngon par spro bar bya ba yin par brda sprad do/ /de'i tshe bris sku'i steng gi nam mkha' nas lha mang pos mchod par byas so/ /de nas bris sku pho brang gi khang bzang du spyan drangs/ mchod pa du mas yongs su mchod de/ rgyal po nyid gtsang sbra dang bcas pas skyabs 'gro dang bslab gzhi bdag nyid kyis blangs/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi don bsams pas de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das pa'i mthar rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yang thob/ de bden pa mthong ba dang ched du brjod pa/ ring na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /shes rab mig ni rnam par spyangs/ /gang la de 'dra'i gsos mnga' ba/ /sman pa'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes ched du brjod do/ /de nas rgyal po u tra ya ṇas gzugs can snying po la khyod kyi drin gyis bdag gis bden pa mthong ste/ da dung dge slong dag mthong bar 'dod pas 'dir btang bar rigs so zhes 'phrin bskur bas/ gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba na/ 'phags pa kā tya ya na 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa mngags so/ /de nas lam du bsod snyoms spyod cing*/ rim gyis sgra sgrogs su byon pa na/ bkur bsti chen pos bsus te spyan drangs zhabs la gtugs mchod pa du mas mchod do/ /de nas yul der 'phags pa kā tya ya nas bram ze dang khyim bdag sogs skye bo mang po la chos bstan pas 'bras bu bzhi thob pa dang*/

byang chub gsum du sems bskyed pa dpag tu med pa zhig byung ngo*/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag rgyal dang skar rgyal zhes bya ba gnyis rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa thob ste/ 'bar ba dang gsal ba la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul du ma bstan nas mya ngan las 'das shing de gnyis kyi mchod rten yang byas te skye bo rnams mchod par byed do/ /de nas btsun mo'o 'khor rnams chos nyan par 'dod nas 'phags pa kā tya ya na la zhus pas/ dge slong pha btsun mo'i 'khor du 'gro bar ma gnang ngo*/ /'o na yul dbus su sus ston/ dge slong mas ston no/ /de nas yang gzugs can snying po la dge slong ma dag rdzong bar zhus pa na/ des kyang bcom ldan 'das la zhus te/ dge slong ma ri ma 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa mngags so/ /der de dag lam du bsod snyoms spyod cing song ba las snga ma ltar bkur bsti chen pos spyan drangs/ dbyar khang yang lnga brgya byas so/ /des rgyal po'i btsun mo rnams la chos bstan te/ gzhan yang bud med kyi tshogs mang po rnams la'ang bstan pas skye bo mang po zhig bden pa la bkod do/ /rgyal po u tra ya ṇa ni pi wang la mkhas/ btsun mo zla 'od ni gar la mkhas pa las/ de nas dus ring zhig na rgyal pos pi wang brdungs/ zla 'od kyis gar byas pa na/ rgyal po ni brtag pa la mkhas pas brtags pa na/ de zhag bdun nas 'chi bar shes te/ lag nas pi wang lhung

ngo*/ /des de'i rgyu mtshan dris pa na/ rgyal pos bshad pas der rab tu 'byung bar zhus pa rgyal pos gnang ste/ dge slong ma ri mas rab tu byung bsnyen par rdzogs te/ zhag bdun nas dus las 'das pa rgyal chen bzhi rigs kyi lhar skyes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos nyan pas bden pa mthong ngo*/ /de nas lha de rgyal po u tra ya ṇa gnyid log pa'i sngas mgor song nas gnyid sad par byas pa na/ khyod su yin zhes dris pas/ bdag ni zla 'od deng ni lhar skyes so/ /rgyal po nyid kyang rab tu byung zhig ces zer te mi snang bar song ngo*/ /de nas u tra ya ṇas rang gi sras gtsug phud can rgyal rigs la bskos/ blon po he ru ka dang bhi ru ka bskos te/ chos kyi rgyal srid gyis shig ces gdams nas g.yog gcig dang lhan cig tu song nas rgyal po'i khab tu 'ongs/ rgyal po gzugs can snying pos bkur sti chen po dang bcas te bsus nas/ rab tu 'byung ba'i don du byon pa la rjes su yi rang ba phul/ nangs par gzugs can snying po dang u tra ya ṇa lhan cig bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar byon/ don de gsol bas ston pas tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do/ /de nas u tra ya ṇa brtson pa dang ldan pas dus gzhan zhig na phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /gtam 'di'ang 'phags rgyal btul ba dang 'dra ste/ yul der ston pas zhabs kyis dngos su ma bcags pa'i rnam gzhag dang bstun na/ kā tya ya na'i mdzad pa nyid ston pa'i mdzad pa yin pa dang*/ 'gro phan rlabs po che yin pa'i phyir bkod do/ /nga lnga pa seng ge btul ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod nas rgyal po'i khab kyi bar du gshegs par bzhed pa la/ don mthun tshong pa bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig 'babs par 'dod pa rnams kyis zhal zas 'bul bar zhus shing gnang nas/ ston pa dge 'dun dang lhan cig gshegs pa'i tshe/ kun dga' bo ni don mthun tshong pa rnams dang lhan cig song ba las/
