/de nas bcom ldan 'das ma ga dha'i grong khyer na ladar byon te/ de nas kun tu rgyu 'dam bu'i tshong pa zhes bya ba lo brgya nyi shu lon pa dgra bcom par bkur ba zhig yod pas/ de la grogs po lha zhig gis/ 'di sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar rab tu byung zhig byas na mi nyan te thabs shig bya'o snyam/ dri ba bzhi bo 'di dag yid kyis dris la/ gang shes pa de'i rjes su zhugs shig ces zer ba ltar/ des kyang rdzogs byed la sogs pa ston pa drug gi thad du phyin nas yid kyis dri ba dris na/ dris pa tsam yang ma shes na lan lta ga la zhig /skabs der des bsam pa/ re zhig ston pa drug gis kyang ma shes na gau ta ma gsar bus ga la shes/ yang bsams pa/ brnyas par mi rung ba yang srid snyam ste spyan sngar song nas yid kyis dri ba bzhi po dris pas/ ston pas lan tshigs su bcad pa bka' stsal pa na/ de mchog tu dad de rab tu byung zhing dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /de nas 'od ma'i dbyug pa can zhes bya ba'i grong du de'i nub mo bzhugs te der bden bzhi'i chos gsungs nas/ nangs par gyi nyin grong khyer dmar bu can du gshegs te/ dmar bu can gyi nye skor mchod rten gyi gnas su bzhugs so/ /der skye bo'i tshogs la bag yod las brtsams te chos bstan nas/ de'i nangs par bram ze dbyar byed ces bya ba/ ma skyes dgra'i 'dun na 'don de/ dmar bu can gyi grong khyer rtsig pa'i kha ta byed cing gnas pa/ des bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa bsod snyoms la spyan drangs te gdan bshams pa la bzhugs nas/ phyogs de na lha mthu che ba dag sa la 'gre bar gzigs te/ der mi mthu che ba rnams sems gzhol bar 'gyur la/ de bzhin du bar ma dang tha ma la'ang ngo*/ /ya rabs kyi gnas kyi mchog ni 'di yin te/ 'di la me dang chu dang nang 'khrug gi bar du gcod pa gsum 'byung ngo gsung ngo*/ /de nas bsod snyoms kyis legs par tshims par byas te/

rgyal po'i don du dge ba bsngo bar zhus pa ltar de bzhin du mdzad do/ /dbyar byed kyis bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das sgo gang la gshegs pa'i sgo de la gau ta ma'i sgo dang*/ gang gā'i chu ngogs gang nas gshegs pa de la gau ta ma'i 'jug ngogs so zhes ming 'dogs so snyam pa la de dgongs shing mi legs par mkhyen nas/ dmar bu can gyi dbus nas nam mkha'i lam la gshegs te gang gā'i 'gram du bzhud do/ /der ma skyes dgras mngags pa'i mi rnams kyis rtsibs brgya dang ldan pa'i gdugs lnga brgya dbu thog tu 'dzin zhing 'bul lo/ /yangs pa can pas kyang byang ngos nas gdugs lnga brgya 'dzin no/ /mi'i 'gro bas kyang 'di ltar mchod na/ bdag cag ci'i phyir mchod par mi spro zhes bsams te klu rnams kyis kyang rin po che'i gdugs lnga brgya bzung ngo*/ /rgyal chen bzhi bos kyang gdugs mchog lnga brgya bzung ngo*/ /brgya byin gyis kyang gdugs mchog lnga brgya bzung ste/ de dag re re yang ston pa'i dbu gtsug gi steng na rang rang gi gdugs 'dzin par mthong bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /de'i rgyu zhus pas/ rgyal po legs mthong gi lo rgyus gsungs nas/ sngar 'khor los sgyur rgyal nyis stong lnga brgyar skye ba bzhes shing*/ 'phrin las kyi lhag ma da lta gdugs nyis stong lnga brgya dus gcig la dbu thog tu bzung ba 'di yin no/ /deng byang chub brnyes pa 'di min na/ da dung 'khor los sgyur rgyal nyis stong lnga brgyar 'gyur ba las/ de'i bsod nams kyi rnam par smin pa de'i nyan thos rnams kyi longs spyod du rnam par smin pas bsngos te/ mu tig bre gang gis 'bras bre gang las mi khugs pa'i yul du'ang nga'i nyan thos rnams bsod snyoms kyis brel bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgras gadgā la gru zam btsugs pas/ yangs pa can pas kyang de bzhin du btsugs/ gadgā la gnas pa'i klus kyang gdengs ka'i zam pa btsugs so/

/bcom ldan 'das dang kun dga' bo ni gdengs ka'i zam pa las byon/ dge slong rnams ni gru zam gnyis po las 'ongs shing*/ chu bo'i phar 'gram gyis sa'i sgang mtho ba zhig tu phaibs te der gzigs so/ /dge slong dag lha'i mchod sdong blta bar 'dod dam/ 'tshal lags/ phyag g.yas pa sa la reg pas/ sngon lhas bzos pa'i mchod sdong dpangs su 'dom stong dang*/ sboms su 'dom drug cu yod pa zhig mchod sdong de'i bdag po klu rnams kyis sa steng du bsgreng bar byas so/ /de nas dge slong rnams la mchod sdong myur du nub par 'gyur gyi rtags zung zhig gsungs pas/ der dge slong gzhan thams cad lta zhing rtog la/ dge slong legs ldan ni mi lta bar rgyab kyis phyogs nas/ phyag dar khrod kyi snam sbyar 'tshem mo/ /de'i rgyu zhus pas sngon rgyal po sgra chen kyi lo rgyus dang*/ phyis sangs rgyas byams pa 'byung ba'i tshul rnams gsungs/ mchod sdong yang nub bo/ /yang phar gshegs te shing sha pa'i tshal du zag med phung po lnga'i gdams pa bstan nas/ grong khyer sgra can du byon/ der lo de la mi ngas chen po byung bas dge bsnyen brtan pa la sogs pa mang po 'das so zhes thos nas/ kun dga' bos ston pa la de dag gang du skye zhes zhus pas/ dge bsnyen brtan pa la sogs pa sum brgya ni tha ma'i cha dang mthun pa lnga spangs te/ phyir mi 'ong ba thob pa yin pas gzugs khams su skye la/ la la ni rgyun zhugs yin pas 'dod pa'i lhar skye'o/ khyod de ltar zhu ba tshul dang mi mthun no zhes gsungs/ de nas a mra skyong mas ston pa 'byon par thos te/ ne tso bzhin rgyas zhes bya ba la khyod song la/ bcom ldan 'das la bsnyun gsol te/ yangs pa can du 'byon pa'i thog mar bdag gi khyim du gdugs tshod la spyan drongs shig /ne tso de song ba dang*/ khye'u dag gis smad 'tshong ma'i ne tso yin no zer nas mda' 'phangs pas mda' de phyir ldog nas 'phen mkhan rnams nyid kyi thog tu lhung ngo*/

/ne tsos smras pa/ yul 'khor gzhan yang 'gyed pa na/ pho nya mi gsod ces grags na/ /bdag lta rgyal ba'i pho nya ba/ /lus can kun gyis gang la gsod/ /de nas de song ste ston pa'i spyan sngar bsnyun gsol/ a mra skyong ma'i zhu ba zhus/ ston pas kyang bkas gnang*/ ne tso sangs rgyas la dad bzhin du phyir 'ongs pa'i lam du 'ol bas bsad de rgyal chen bzhi rigs kyi lhar skyes nas ston pa'i spyan sngar bden pa mthong ba'i bar du gyur to/ /go lnga pa yangs pa can pa rnams bde bar mdzad pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can gyi a mra'i tshal du phebs te bzhugs so/ /a mra skyong mas de thos te rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan/ 'khor bud med rnams kyis yongs su bskor te rang gi khyim nas byung ste 'ong ba gzigs pa na/ dge slong rnams la dran shes bzhin la gnas par gyis shig ces sogs yang dag spong ba bzhi rgyas par gsungs/ der a mra skyong ma 'ongs nas/ sang gdugs tshod la spyan 'dren pa'i snyan gsan phab bo/ /de'i rjes la litstsha bī rnams kyang shing rta rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa sogs yab sras mjal ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar byas nas 'ongs pa na/ dge slong sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas dang lha skyed mos tshal du 'gro ba ma mthong pa dag 'di la ltos shig gsung*/ de nas litstsha bī rnams ston pa'i spyan sngar 'ongs te/ chos kyi bka' mchid stsal ba rgya cher nyan/ der bram ze'i khye'u ser skya'i bu zhes bya bas ston pa la tshigs su bcad pas bstod/ litstsha bī rnams kyis de la bla gos lnga brgya byin no/ /de nas litstsha bī rnams kyis sang nyin gdugs tshod 'byon par zhus pa na/ thog mar a mra skyong gis spyan drangs so/ /des bdag cag bslus mod kyi/ da dung bsnyen bkur bgyi'o zer nas song ngo*/ /de'i rjes su ser skya'i bus bla gos lnga brgya po ston pa la phul ba la/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten du byon pa'i phan yon lnga gsungs shing*/

nangs par a mra skyong mas bsod snyoms phul te chos nyan/ kun dga' bo la bka' stsal te/ kun dga' bos yangs pa can gyi grong khyer gyi lcags ri'i sgo them la rkang pa bzhag ste/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo bton pas/ mi ngas gtong ba'i 'byung po thams cad byer zhing nad thams cad zhi'o/ /rjes su litstsha bī rnams kyis kyang gdugs tshod gsol ba sogs mchod pa rgya cher phul nas yangs pa can gyi nye ba'i grong 'od ma can zhes bya ba'i byang ngos shing sha pa'i tshal du dbyar gnas par mdzad do/ /dus der mu ge shin tu che bas/ bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed rnams smos mgrin ji lta bu yod pa dag las dbyar gnas par byos shig /nga yang kun dga' bo dang lhan cig gnas so/ /zhes gsungs te/ dge slong rnams kyang grong dang yul tha dad pa'i gnas mal sna tshogs pa dag bsten zhing 'thor thabs su gnas so/ /der de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu sku bsnyun te/ ji tsam du 'grongs pa la thug pa de tsam du bsnyun par gyur kyang*/ da ltar dge 'dun 'thor bas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus ma yin dgongs te/ tshor ba de ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan te lhag par 'tsho bar mdzad do/ /go drug pa mi thi la sogs la/ mi thi la dang sā la'i grong*/ /zhes bya ste/ de nas zla ba gsum 'das pa na/ yul mi thi la'i a mra'i tshal du bzhugs te 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /rgyu zhus pas phyogs der ston pa nyid rgyal po lha chen por gyur pa'i skyes rabs gsungs nas/ yul lus 'phags su sangs rgyas bzhi'i gdan ston par mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sā la'i grong du bsod snyoms la zhugs par mdzad pa na/ der bdud sdig can gyis de bzhin gshegs pa la bsod snyoms 'ga' yang 'bul ba 'byung ba med pa de bzhin du byas te/ ji ltar lhung bzed bkrus te bzhag pa de lta bur byas so/ /de nas phyir ldog ste gshegs pa na bdud sdig can bram ze'i khye'ur sprul te sangs rgyas kyi phyi bzhin du song nas bsod snyoms kham 'ga' rnyed dam zer ba la/

bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyad bsad pas/ khyod kyis bsod nams min yang bsags/ sangs rgyas rnams ni rgal dka' ba/ /sdig can ci ga mi shes sam/ /bdud na re/ da bsod snyoms la bzhud cig dang rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /bka' stsal pa/ nga la ci yang mi dgos te/ kye ma shin tu bde bar 'tsho/ /'od gsal lha rnams ji ltar bar/ /dga' ba yi ni zas za'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis nga'i sems shes so snyam skyengs te de mi snang bar song ngo*/ /go bdun pa rdo 'phangs pa ni/ de nas yul sdig pa can du byon te/ der lam kha na pha bong ches che ba shin tu sra ba skye bo rnams bskor te 'gro dgos pa zhig yod pa las/ yul sdig pa can gyi gyad lnga brgya rnams pha bong de phyogs gzhan du spo ba'am rtsa ba nas bshig par nus na/ lam yang bde zhing grags pa chen por 'gyur ro snyam nas gyad lnga brgyas thabs rnam pa sna tshogs pa dag gis pha bong de spo ba'am bshig par brtsams pa na/ de spo bar yang ma nus/ bshig par yang ma nus so/ /phyogs der bcom ldan 'das byon te bka' stsal pa/ gnas 'jog dag ci byed gsol ba/ shul lam 'di bzang por bgyid na/ pha bong 'di dor bar rngo mi thogs go /'o na ngas dor ram/ dor bar mdzod cigader bcom ldan 'das kyis zhabs g.yas kyi mthe bos pha bong de nam mkha' la 'phangs te mig gis mi bzod pa tsam du song ba na/ gyad rnams skrag cing dngangs pa la/ sangs rgyas kyis pha bong de nam mkha'i mthongs te de nyid du phye mar mdzad nas rdul du babs pa na/ gsol ba/ rdul 'di ci las byung*/ bka' stsal pa/ pha bong de'o/ /ma legs so/ /'o na slar sbyar ram/ sbyar du gsol/ de ma thag lam du 'gro ba la gnod pa med cing*/ nye skor gyi sar rdul rnams 'byar te pha bong sngon bzhin du gyur to/ /de nas gyad rnams kyis zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi stobs gang gis pha bong de 'phangs pa lags/ bka' stsal pa/ yab yum las byung ba'i stobs kyis so/

/phye mar gang gis brlags lags/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis so/ /gang gis sbyor bar mdzad pa lags/ mos pa'i stobs kyis so/ /stobs gsum po de las lhag pa'i stobs mchis sam/ yod de bsod nams kyi stobs kyis bdud bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug bcom mo/ /gzhan yang mchis sam/ yod de ye shes kyi stobs kyis nyon mongs pa thams cad rtsad nas bcom mo/ /gzhan yang mchis sam/ yod de cho 'phrul gyi stobs kyis ston pa drug bcom mo/ / gzhan yang mchis sam/ yod de mi rtag pa'i stobs kyis shing sā la zung gi drung du mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /da ltar gyi mi'i tshe dang stobs la sogs pa nyams pa la ltos/ rdo 'di ni bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams kyi phang tshad yin te/ lag rjes kyang yod do/ /zhes ston par mdzad do/ /de nas gyad lnga brgya stobs kyis dregs pa dang bral ba la chos bstan pas de thams cad kyis rgyun du zhugs pa thob bo/ /skabs 'dir yab yum las gyur pa'i stobs kyi tshad ni/ mi dang glang phal ba men sngon po dang*/ /glang chen phru gu glang chen mo dang ni/ /glang chen phal pa glang chen mche ba med/ /glang chen sngo ser dkar po dmar po dang*/ /

'bigs byed glang chen spos kyi glang chen dang*/ /tshan po che dang rab rnon stobs mchog rnams/ /snga ma snga ma'i bcu 'gyur phyi ma'i stobs/ /stobs mchog nyi shu sred med bu yi stobs/ /de stobs tshigs dang tshigs phran re rer yod/ /ces bya'o/ /༈ go brgyad pa n+ya gro dha grong sogs ni/ de nas n+ya gro dha'i grong du byon te/ ser skya nas der bag mar btang ba'i bu mo zhig gis ston pa byon pa mthong bas dad nas bsod snyoms bzhes na 'bul dgos snyam pa la ston pas phul zhig gsungs/ des kyang bdag gi sems mkhyen no snyam lhag par yang dad de phul lo/ /der 'dzum pa mdzad pa sogs spyi dang 'dra ba la/ rang sangs rgyas shin tu legs smon zhes bya bar lung bstan to/ /gtam de bu mo de nyid kyi khyo bram ze zhig yod pas thos te/ khyim du 'ongs nas gtam dris pa na/ bu mo des kyang bshad do/ /de ston pa'i drung du song nas khyed kyis bdag gi mchi 'brang la lung bstan pa bden nam/ bka' stsal pa bden no/ khyed bshos tsam gyi slad du rdzun gsung ngam/ bram ze khyod kyis ngo mtshar ba mthong ba yod dam/ yod de grong 'di'i shar na n+ya gro dha'i sdong po'i yal ga'i 'og nas shing rta lnga brgya ma reg par 'gro ba yod do/ /'o na de'i sa bon ji tsam/ yungs kar gyi bzhi cha tsam mo/ / bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin du ngas kyang rgyu chung ngu las 'bras bu chen po mthong ngo*/ der ljags kyis zhal ras khebs pa bstan te/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal rdzun gsung ngam/ gsol ba ma lags so/ /der bram ze de dad par gyur pa la chos bstan pas bden pa mthong ngo*/ /de nas yul ka pi lar byon te/ tshe dang ldan pa ka pi la la chos nyan par lan gsum du bskul yang cang mi zer bas/ kun dga' bo la dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi gsungs nas/ ka pi la'i nags khrod du lo ma'i spyil bur bzhugs/ 'phags pa maudgal gyi bu'i zhang po zhig de dang nye ba'i ri bo zhig na yod pa/

ston pas maudgal gyi bu la zhang po la soms shig / de nas maung gal gyi bus/ bram ze'i drang srong de gnas pa'i bsti gnas der phyin/ der zhang po na re/ dge sbyong ma 'dug cig / 'di ni bram ze'i bsti gnas yin no/ /maung gal gyi bus smras pa/ nga yang bram ze'o/ /des smras pa/ khyod la gtsang byed dang blugs gzar la sogs pa'ang med na/ zhes zer ba la/ bram ze nga yin ngo tsha shes/ /gtsang byed blugs bzar shes rab nyid/ /ces sogs gsungs/ de ltar yang skabs mi 'byed nas/ maung gal gyi bus rlung dang char drag phab ste/ rang nyid shing drung du bzhugs pa la dga' bo nyer dga'i 'khor gyi klu dag gis maung gal gyi bu'i sku lus la dkris nas gdengs ka byas te 'dug go /der zhang po na re/ dge sbyong bsti gnas su zhugs shig maung gal bus khyod da drang srong gi chos las nyams sam c-i/ zhes gsungs pas/ des ring du brtags na skad las ngo shes nas khyod maudgal gyi bu yin nam/ yin no/ /ci'i phyir 'dir 'ongs/ khyod kyi phyir du ste/ sangs rgyas kyi drung du bzhud do/ /byas te de ston pa'i drung du khrid de phyin/ ston pas chos gsungs pas des phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs/ bsti gnas de na gnas pa'i bram ze'i drang srong gzhan thams cad kyang bden pa la bkod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yul ku ru'i zhing du phebs te/ bang mdzod stug po can zhes pa'i grong khyer dang*/ nye ba'i nags na bzhugs so/ /skabs 'dir 'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gi sngar gyi lo rgyus rgyas par sbyar/ dus de'i tshe ku ru'i yul gyi rgyal pos/ 'phags pa yul 'khor skyong la chos nyan te/ ston pa bang mdzod stug po can gyi nag nas gshegs te/ ku ru'i yul gyi skye bo mang po la chos ston zhing*/ byang phyogs lnga len gyi grong rdal glang po che can du gshegs pa na/ bram ze gcig gi bcom ldan 'das mthong ste dad pa skyes nas/

bstod pa byas pas 'dzum pa mdzad pa sogs nas bskal pa nyi shu nas rang sangs rgyas bstod 'os zhes bya bar lung bstan to/ /de nas yul srub sna zhes bya bar byon te skye bo rnams la chos ston pa na/ bram ze dbang po zhes bya ba gzugs bzang bas dregs pa zhig yod de/ des bcom ldan 'das kyi sku ci 'dra snyam blta bar 'ongs pa na/ ring du bltas nas bsams pa/ bdag rang las 'di'i gzugs lhag par mdzes mod kyi/ tshad lhag pa ma yin no snyam ste gtsug tor gyi steng blta bar brtsams pa na ma mthong ste/ phyogs mthon po zhig tu 'dzegs nas bltas pas kyang gtsug tor gyi steng gi mtha' la steng nas thur du blta bar ma nus te/ sku tshad je mthor song nas gtsug tor gyi ngos la 'og nas blta bar kho nar gyur to/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te khyod ri rab kyi rtse mor 'dzegs te bltas kyang nga'i gtsug tor gyi mtha' mi mthong ste/ 'on kyang khyod nyid sbyin sreg byed pa'i thab kyi 'og thad sa 'og na tsandan sa mchog las byas pa'i mchod sdong yod kyi/ de thon la tshad 'jal bar gyis shig nga yab yum las 'khrungs pa'i sku tshad ni de yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas des kyang me thab kyi 'og sa drus pas mchod sdong thon te/ rab tu dad nas chos nyan pas bden pa mthong ngo*/ /ston pa la bka'i gnang ba bzhus te sa phyogs yangs pa mchod sdong gi ston btsugs pas/ dbang po'i dus ston zhes grags so/ /bar skabs sdom ni/ rang rgyal lung bstan ka pi la/ /yul 'khor skyong dang glang po can/ /dbang po zhes byas dus ston btsugs/ /go dgu pa bram ze'i grong sogs ni/ de nas bram ze'i grong du gshegs par bzhed de chas so/ /gang gi tshe cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa na mu stegs rnams mtha' 'khob tu bros te gnas so/ /der bram ze'i grong na mu stegs mang po dag yod de/ de rnams kyis ston pa bram ze'i grong du 'byon no zhes thos nas/

des bdag cag gi 'tsho ba gcod par 'gyur snyam ste mu stegs de dag bram ze'i grong gi skye bo rnams kyi mdun du song nas/ khyed rnams kyi 'byor pa mthong zin gyi rgud pa ma mthong ba la 'gro'o/ /zhes sogs grong khyer bzang byed kyi skabs dang 'dra/ gal te go ta ma gsod na kho bo cag sdod do/ /der bram ze'i grong gi skye bo mang po dag go bgos shing dbyug pa dang mda' gzhu la sogs pa thogs te song ngo*/ /de dag shākya rgan po gcig dang lam du 'phrad pas/ khyed rnams gang du 'gro/ dgra gsod du'o/ /dgra su zhig /gau ta ma'o/ /de dgra yin na/ byams pa su yin/ slar ldog cig byas kyang ldog tu ma btub ste/ de rnams song nas nub mo ri brag cig tu brang btab bo/ shākya rgan po des bsams pa/ 'di dag ston pas chos bshad pa'i snod du mi 'gyur gyi/ pha rol gnon pa bya'o snyam ste/ ri brag de'i nags la me btang bas bram ze'i grong gi dmag mi rnams kyi mtha' mes 'khor ku co chen pos skad btang bas/ ri brag de'i skye bo thams cad rgyugs te me bsad kyang cher 'bar te ma zhi ba la/ bcom ldan 'das phyogs der byon te/ me 'di zhi bar 'dod dam zhes bka' stsal pa na/ zhi bar mdzad du gsol zhes zhus pas/ de ma thag tu me rang zhi'o/ /de nas de rnams shin tu dad de/ gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing sku'i drung du 'khod pa la bcom ldan 'das kyis chos gsungs pas bram ze'i grong gi skye bo de rnams dang*/ ri brag ba de rnams phal cher gyis bden pa mthong ngo*/ /de nas yul ro hi ta ka'i nag po'i grong du byon te/ phyogs 'dir 'khor ba 'jig dang*/ gser thub dang*/ 'od srung ste sngon gyi sangs rgyas gsum gyis bzhugs so zhes sa gzhi ston par mdzad de/ bcom ldan 'das nyid der bzhugs nas/ phyogs 'dir sangs rgyas bzhi bzhugs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes sangs rgyas bzhi'i gdan bstan par mdzad cing*/

nag po'i grong gi gnod sbyin gyi gnas su gshegs nas der chos ston zhing bzhugs pa na/ gnod sbyin glang chen stobs kyis rgun 'brum gzeb ma lnga brgya phul te/ dge 'dun la brims so/ /gnod sbyin de dang gzhan gnod sbyin mang po rnams skyabs 'gro dang bslab pa'i gnas la bkod de/ gnod sbyin rnams kyi dge ba'i phyir yul pa rnams kyis gtsug lag khang lnga brgya bzhengs so/ /de ltar yangs pa can gnod pa las bskyabs pa na/ de'i bar ni byang phyogs dang nye ba'i yul rnams su 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa ste/ de dag gi bar bar na lo rgyus phra mo gzhan mang po yod kyang*/ 'dir rags pa tsam bkod pa'o/ /bar skabs sdom ni/ bram ze'i grong dang gdan bzhi bstan/ nag po'i grong du glang chen stobs//brgya pa byang phyogs kyi rgyud btul ba ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nag po'i grong gi gtsug lag khang na bzhugs te snga dro'i dus bsod snyoms mdzad nas/ de'i 'og tu zhabs bkrus te/ gtsug lag khang gi nang du bzhugs so/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nga'i sku tshe'i lhag ma ni yun thung*/ gdul bar bya ba ni shin tu mang ba zhig lus na/ gal te kun dga' bo dang lhan cig gshegs par gyur na ni lo brgyar yang byang phyogs kyi 'gro ba'i don spyod mi nus pas/ da ni gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje ste 'phags pa gsang ba'i bdag po dang lhan cig tu gshegs par bgyi'o dgongs te/ lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ da ni nga sog ma med 'dul du 'dong ngo*/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje dang lhan cig tu nam mkha' la gshegs te/ nags tshal sngon po sngo zhing bsgreng ba gzigs pas 'di ni u shi ra'i ri yin te/ da mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya lon pa na zhi gnas dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas rā ma sā la'i tshal zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan to/ /yul spungs pa can du byon te de'i skye bo'i tshogs thamasacad la chos bstan nas/

yul mi de rnams kyis gsol ba/ gnod sbyin sangs rgyas stobs 'dis bdag cag la ring du gnod pa byas na 'di 'dul du gsol/ sangs rgyas stobs kyang 'khor de nyid na yod pas/ bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas stobs thos sam/ sdig pa'i chos de las ldog cig des kyang skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ bslab gzhi blangs/ gtsug lag khang dang gnas mal brtsigs so/ /gnod sbyin de sangs rgyas kyi phyi bzhin 'brang bar 'dod pa la bzlog par mdzad nas gnas de nyid skyong bar bskos so/ /de nas yul re tu kar skye bo rnams la chos bstan zhing*/ gnod sbyin chos stobs btul ba'ang de dang 'dra ste/ re tu ka'i gnas mal dang gtsug lag khang brtsigs so/ /de nas sindhū'i yul gyi mnyan pa la cho 'phrul bstan zhing chos gsungs pas bden pa la bkod/ sindhū'i skye bo dang gnod sbyin khor chen btul nas gtsug lag khang rtsig pa'i bar yang snga ma dang 'dra/ de nas drang srong gi bsti gnas gcig tu drang srong mgo breg dang ril pa spyi blugs can zhes bya ba gnyis bden pa la bkod de/ de'i gnas mal yang brtsigs so/ /de nas sog ma med kyi gnas dang nye bar byon pa na/ klu sog ma med de khros 'khrugs rngam par gyur te nam mkha' la 'phags nas ser ba dang rdul kyi char phab pa bcom ldan 'das la a ka ru dang ta ma la'i phye ma'i char du gyur/ mtshon cha'i char chen po phab pa rnams padma dang utpa la'i char du gyur/ de khros pas du ba btul ba na ston pas de bas kyang che ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi du ba btul/ me sbar ba na de bas kyang che ba'i me sbar/ gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon lag na rdo rjes klu'i gnas dang nye ba'i ri rtse la rdo rje 'phangs pas ri nyil te/ sog ma med kyi gnas rnams non no/ /de 'bros par brtsams pa la phyogs thams cad mer 'bar nas/ ston pa'i zhabs drung 'ba' zhig zhi bar shes te zhabs la gtugs so/ /ston pas de la phyag gis gzhams nas/

khyod bum pa bzang po lta bu'i nyan thos bzhi la bsod snyoms phul bas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ba las/ smon lam log pa btab pas dud 'gror gyur la/ da dung 'tshe ba'i las byas pas mi bzad pa'i dmyal bar 'gyur ta re/ der sog ma med dang chung ma dang bu mo dang mna' ma rnams skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gnas lnga la bkod cing*/ bu ri bo yang de ltar 'dod pa la/ sog ma med kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba/ bdag cag klu rnams ni mi mdza' ba mang ba lags kyi/ 'di la bslab gzhi mi 'bog par gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ bu ri bo skyabs 'gro tsam la bkod do/ /der klu rgyal sog ma med 'khor klu drug khri dang bcas pa chos la bkod cing*/ de la lag na rdo rje thugs yi rangs te rdo rje gsor zhing gar mdzad do/ /yang bcom ldan 'das dang gsang ba'i bdag po nam mkha' la gshegs pa na/ nags tshal sngon po mtsho dang bcas pa gzigs te/ 'di ni kha che'i yul yin te nga 'das nas lo brgya lon pa na/ dge slong nyi ma gung pa zhes bya ba 'byung ste/ des bstan pa 'jog par 'gyur la/ lhag mthong dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas mal gyi nang nas mchog yin te/ grong rdal drug khri drug stong drug cu rtsa gsum mo zhes lung bstan to/ /bar 'dir yul gnyis grogs su drang srong dang gnod sbyin nyams pa 'khor bcas btul ba dang*/ yul ka ran ṭa'i gnod sbyin mo 'khor bcas btul ba dang*/ yul 'bras grong du rgyal po bde mchog gi ma bden pa la bkod pa dang*/ yul dbang ldan du rdza mkhan bden pa la bkod pa dang*/ yul sing ma can du gnod sbyin gcig gi ming la srin mo zhes pa 'khor bcas bden pa la bkod pa dang*/ yul brtsegs skyong du klu ba lang skyong dang dgar ba zhes bya ba btul ba dang*/ yul dga' 'phel du rgyal po srid pa'i lha 'khor bcas dang gtum byed kyi bu bdun dang*/ gnod sbyin sa 'tsho 'khor bcas chos la bkod pa sogs mang bo zhig mdzad nas/

drug sde'i nang gi nab so dang 'gro mgyogs gnyis shi nas byang phyogs su mtsho chen po zhig tu klur skyes te/ de gnyis kyis bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon bdag cag gnyis la chos ma bshad pas da lta klur skyes na/ ci nas kyang de'i bstan pa bur mar brlag par bya'o zhes khro zhing 'khrugs pas 'dug go /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa klu 'di gnyis ni gzhan pas mthu che la rdzu 'phrul che ba yin pas/ nga 'das nas 'dul ba po gzhan mi 'byung ste/ bstan pa 'jig pa'i gnas yod do dgongs nas/ de gnyis kyi gnas kyi mkhris mtsho nang de'i ngogs gzhan zhig tu byon te chos nyon cig par bskur ba na mtsho'i nang ston pa bzhugs pa'i gnas su de nyid zhugs te/ de dag la ston pas chos rgya cher gsungs so/ /de gnyis dad te ston pas ni sngon yang chos bshad na/ bdag cag bag med pas rnam par ma shes so/ /da lta yang bdag cag la thugs las su mdzad nas/ chos ston pa'i phyir brtse bas 'dir byon to snyam sangs rgyas la rab tu dga' bas 'dug go /de nas ston pa phyir gshegs te phyogs der gnod sbyin mo sbu gu can dang sbugs can 'dul bar mdzad de/ de bar du yang sngar gyi mtsho nang gi gnas der bcom ldan 'das kyis sku'i gzugs brnyan btang bas/ klu gnyis po de bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la thugs brtse bas da dung bzhugs so snyam mtsho ngogs der yang dang yang du 'jug par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mdung can gyi grong du gshegs te/ de na gnod sbyin mo mdung can ma zhes bya bas/ grong pa'i bu btsas pa thams cad za bar byed do/ /der grong mi rnams kyis ston pa la gdugs tshod gsol nas/ gnod sbyin mo mdung can 'dul bar zhus pas/ mdung can yang 'khor de na 'dug pa la/ dri smed mdzad de mdung can khyod kyis thos sam/ sdig pa'i chos de las ldog cig

bdag gi slad du 'di dag gis gtsug lag khang rtsig na ldog go /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo rnams la de thos sam/ thos so/ /'o na ji ltar byed/ rtsig lags so/ /der gtsug lag khang brtsigs so/ /de nas yul 'bra gor byis pa chung ngu zhig rdul gyis mchod rten la rtse ba rgyal po ka ni skar lung bstan to/ /de dag ni mtshon par byed pa tsam ste/ ro hi ta ka'i gtsug lag khang nas byon pa nas brtsams te/ sog ma med btul ba'i bar la srog chags 'bum phrag bdun bcu rtsa bdun btul zhes 'byung ste/ de dag kyang mi dang mi ma yin pa gtso bor gtso bor gyur pa rnams smos pa ste gzhan du na mtha' yas pa zhig go /sog ma med kyi rjes su yang bgrang bar mi spyod pa zhig btul te/ byang phyogs kyi gnas kha cig na ni mi mang po dag gnas so/ kha cig na ni mi ma yin pa kho na dag yod do/ /de bas na la lar mi rnams la chos bstan te bden pa la bkod do/ kha gcig tu ni lha rnams bden pa la bkod do/ /de bzhin du srin po'i gnas dang*/ klu yi gnas dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi gnas dang*/ gnod sbyin gtum po'i gnas dang*/ mi'am ci'i gnas dang*/ dri za'i gnas dang/ gzugs sna tshogs pa mang po dang ldan pa'i gnod sbyin nam 'byung po'i gnas dang*/ nam mkha' lding la sogs pa 'dab chags kyi gnas dang*/ lha min gyi 'gro ba'i gnas la sogs pa bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig tu gshegs te/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gnas lnga dang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa la sogs pa mtho ris dang byang grol gyi chos bla na med pa la 'god par mdzad do/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje dang lhan cig nam mkha'i lam las tshur phebs te/ ro hi ta ka'i gtsug lag khang gi nang du gshegs nas yang dag 'jog la mnyam par bzhag go /de ltar na byang phyogs kyi rgyud btul ba'i skor de rnams phyag na rdo rje dang lhan cig tu gshegs pa ste thun tshod gcig la grub par mdzad pa yin no/

/brgya dang gcig pa bcom brlag gi skor sogs ni/ de nas nyi ma phyi phred kyi dus na bcom ldan 'das yang dag 'jog las bzhengs nas/ kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ nga dang po'i rgyal srid ltar 'dod ngo*/ /der byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'dul bar mdzad zin pa/ 'phags pa kun dga' bos kyang ma mkhyen te/ gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das sngar sog ma med 'dul du 'dod do gsung na/ nga dang po'i rgyal srid du gshegs pa ci lags/ bka' stsal pa/ nga lag na rdo rje dang lhan cig gshegs te de btul zin to/ /byang phyogs na nyes dmigs lnga yod de/ mtho dman can dang*/ tsher mas gang ba dang*/ rdo dang gseg ma mang ba dang*/ khyi za ba dang*/ bud med gnas ngan len kun tu spyod pa'o gsung ngo*/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das grong khyer dang po'i rgyal srid zhais bya ba dang*/ grong khyer rta bzang brgyud nas yul bcom brlag gi ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs na/ ri nags tshal sngon pos brgyan pa zhig gzigs nas/ 'di ni ri rtse mtho zhes bya ste/ nga mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya lon pa na gar mkhan dang dpa' bo zhes bya bas gtsug lag khang brtsigs te/ zhi lhag gnyis ka dang mthun pa'i gnas mal gyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /'dir spos tshong sbas pa'i bu nyer sbas zhes bya ba 'byung ste mtshan med pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /der bcom brlag gi bram ze rnams 'dus te/ dge sbyong gau ta ma de 'dir 'ongs na bdag cag gi rnyed pa'i bar chad du 'gyur la/ de la bkur bsti ma yin pa byas na 'dir mi 'ong ngo zhes gros byas nas/ bram ze rnams kyi gtso bo bram ze sngon gyur zhes bya ba mngags te/ mkhan po khyod kyis gau ta ma la bkur bsti ma yin pa'i tshig gis spyo bar gsol/ des smras pa/ bdag gi lce 'di ni bden pa'i rjes su 'brang ste/ bstod par 'os na ni bstod/ spyo bar 'os na ni spyo'o/ /de nas de ston pa 'byon pa'i lam du song ba na/

sku mthong ba tsam gyis shin tu dad de bstod pa lnga brgyas bstod do/ /ston pas kyang chos gsungs pas de de nyid du bden pa mthong*/ de nas de ldog ste 'ongs ba na bram ze rnams kyis tshig rtsub pos spyos te/ khyod kyis gau ta ma la bkur sti ma yin pa byos shig byas na bstod de 'ong ngam/ des smras pa/ kho bo ni bden par smra'o zhes sngar ma smras sam/ bcom ldan 'das ni bstod par 'os pa'o/ /zhes so/ /bcom ldan 'das grong khyer bcom brlag gi nye skor du bsod snyoms la zhugs pa na/ de'i nub mo grong khyer gyi lha mo'i rgyu skar kyi dus yin pas grong khyer gyi lha mos bsams pa/ gau ta ma 'dir byon na lha dang mi ma yin pa mthu chen po gzhan dag kyang 'ong*/ grong khyer gyi skye bo rnams kyang gau ta ma de mchod cing chos nyan par 'gyur bas/ nga'i rgyu skar gyi nub mo la bar chad du 'gyur ro snyam nas lus gcer bur phud nas sgo drung na 'dug go /de la bka' stsal pa/ re zhig bud med kyi lus ni shin tu bkab kyang bzang ba ma yin na/ sgren mor phud ci dgos/ der log par lta ba'i lha mo de'ang skyengs te phyogs cig tu song ngo*/ /de nas ston pas grong khyer bcom brlag na nyes dmigs lnga yod de/ mtho dman can dang*/ sdong dum dang*/ tsher ma can dang*/ rdo gseg dang gyo mo mang ba dang*/ dgongs ka za ba dang*/ bud med g.yo sgyu can mang ba'o zhes gsungs nas/ grong khyer gyi nang du ma byon par lam gzur nas gnod sbyin bong bu'i gnas su gshegs te shing drung zhig na bzhugs so/ /de la gnod sbyin de ni bong bu'i gzugs su sprul te 'khyams pa na/ khye'u dang bu mo rnams de la zhon zhing rtse ba'i tshe/ skad cig gis nags thibs por khyer te khye'u dang bu mo de dag za bar byed pas gnod sbyin bong bu ba zhes grags so/ /der bcom brlag gi skye bo dad pa can rnams kyis bza' bca' bzang pos shing rta bkang ste/

gnod sbyin bong bu'i gnas su song nas/ yul de'i nye skor gyi dge slong thams cad bsdus te/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa la bsod snyoms gsol nas/ gnod sbyin bong bu 'dul bar gsol ba btab pa sogs snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ gnod sbyin na re 'di rnams kyis bdag gi ched du phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun la gtsug lag khang rtsig na ldog go /der bcom brlag gi skye bo rnams kyis gtsug lag khang lnga brgya brtsigs/ gnod sbyin bong bu 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa btul zhing chos la bkod/ de nas gnod sbyin mda' can dang nag ldan gnyis/ gnod sbyin mo glang rnyed dang mchu can gnyis te bzhi po de'ang btul lo/ /de nas rdzu 'phrul gyis bcom brlag gi nang du byon te bzhugs nas/ gnod sbyin mo 'gran zla ma 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa btul te gtsug lag khang lnga brgya brtsigs shing*/ spyir bcom brlag gi phyi nang du gnod sbyin mo nyis stong lnga brgya btul nas/ gtsug lag khang nyis stong lnga brgya byas so/ /bka' stsal rgyal srid rta bzang dang*/ /nye sbas lung bstan sngor gyur bstod/ /rgyu skar nub mo bong bur gshegs/ /bong bu btul dang grong khyer byon/ /brgya gnyis pa o ta la sogs ni/ de nas yul o ta lar byon te/ bsod snyoms kyi lam du zhing pa lnga brgya tsam yod pa sangs rgyas mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa skyes te lam du phyag 'tshal bar 'ongs pa la chos gsungs pas de nyid du bden pa mthong*/ glang rnams kyi gnya' shing bor/ ru thag bcad/ rmod glang stong po de dag kyang ston pa'i drung du song ba la/ tshig gsum gyi chos bstan pas ston pa la dad bzhin du shi 'phos te/ rgyal chen bzhi rigs kyi lhar skyes nas/ sangs rgyas la chos nyan pas bden pa mthong ba'i bar du gyur to/ /de nas o ta la'i grong du 'phags pa kun dga' bo dang lhan cig bsod snyoms la phebs te/ der bran mo rgan mo ka tsang ga la zhes bya ba zhig khron pa'i rtsar chu 'chur 'gro ba la kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la skyems kyi chu phul shig smras pas/

rgan mo des kyang chu bum bkang ste khyer 'ongs pa na/ ston pa mthong ma thag tu bu yin pa'i 'du shes skyes te bu bu zhes smra zhing rgyugs te sku la 'khyud par brtsams pa na/ dge slong rnams kyis zlog par zhugs pa'i tshe/ bka' stsal ba ma zlog cig /'di nga'i tshe rabs lnga brgya'i yum yin no/ /der bu'i sred pa dang bral te chos nyan pas bden pa mthong*/ skye rgu'i bdag mo la gtad de rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa thob/ dge slong ma mdo sde rnam par 'byed pa'i mchog tu lung bstan to/ /de nas yul dgra mtha'i phyogs su ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na/ bram ze zhig khron pa nas chu drangs shing kun dga' ra ba 'chu ba na/ des ston pa byon pa mthong nas chu snod dang dpyang thag sbas te gnas pa las/ ston pas kun dga' ra ba der byon pa na rdzu 'phrul gyis kun dga' ra ba thams cad chus gang bar gyur to/ /bram ze na re/ tshur byon dpyang thag dang chu snod 'di lags so zhes bstan pas/ thams cad na chu yod na khron pa'i chus ci zhig bya/ zhes gsungs te chos bstan pas dad de tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs nas dgra bcom pa thob pa'i bar du gyur to/ /bar skabs sdom ni/ zhing pa lnga brgya btul ba dang*/ /ka tsang ga la chu snod sbas/ /brgya gsum pa dgra mthar dbyar gnas pa ni/ de ltar yul dpa' bo'i sde zhes bya bar ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs nas/ grong khyer dgra mtha' dang nye ba sbu gu can gyi shing nim pa'i drung du bzhugs so/ /der dgra mtha'i rgyal po me sbyin zhes bya bas thos te/ dge sbyong gau ta ma ni rgyal po chen po thams cad kyis bkur bstir byed pas bdag cag mtha'i rgyal phran rnams kyis kyang bsnyen bkur bya'o snyam sangs rgyas kyi drung du song nas phyag 'tshal te/ zla ba gsum du bsnyen bkur bgyid par zhus so/ /des pho brang du 'ongs nas nang mi rnams la zla ba gsum du nyi ma re re bzhin bza' ba sna bco brgyad dang tshod ma rnam pa du ma sogs mi lnga brgya tshim par nus pa'i kha zas dag sbyor zhig

/ces dang*/ grong khyer du'ang gau ta ma la gzhan gyis gdugs tshod ma gsol zhig /gsol na chad pas gcad do zhes dril bsgrags so/ /de'i nub mo rgyal po me sbyin gyi rmi lam du rang gi rgyu mas dgra mtha'i grong khyer dkris pa rmis so/ /gnyid sad nas skrag ste mdun na 'don bram ze la des kyang bzang bar shes mod/ bzang ngo zhes brjod na 'di gau ta ma la lhag par dad par 'gyur srid snyam nas/ lha 'di ni rmi lam ngan te/ rgyal srid las nyams pa'am srog gi bar chad du 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras so/ /'di la thabs ci yod/ mis mi mthong ba'i phyogs su zla ba gsum bzhugs na de ltar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po me sbyin gyis zla ba gsum du nga'i drung du su'ang ma 'ongs shig byas nas mi snang ba'i phyogs su 'dug go /de nas nangs par 'phags pa kun dga' bo rgyal po'i sgor song bas mi rnams snying las chung ngus 'khod par mthong nas/ ci sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa spyan ma drangs sam/ de dag na re/ kha zas sta gon gyis shig ces gsung yang su la stsal mi gsung ste/ da ni zhu mi nus so zer ro/ /de ston pa la zhus pas/ khyod song la grong khyer rnams su zla ba gsum du sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa la bsod snyoms 'bul bar spro ba yod dam/ zhes sbron cig /kun dga' bos de skad bsgrags pa na de dag na re/ bdag cag shin tu spro mod kyi/ rgyal po gdug pa can gyis bkag go zhes zer ro/ /der byang phyogs nas ded dpon gcig rta lnga brgya la khal bkal nas dgra mthar yongs pa zhig yod pa/ des bsams pa nga rgyal po 'di'i yul pa ni min ci byar yod bsam ste/ kun dga' bo la bdag gi rta cang shes la chag nas bre do/ /rta gzhan ma rnams la nas bre re re lags na/ bcom ldan 'das dge 'dun dang bcas pa gsol bar spro na 'bul lo/ /de kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la gsol bas/ dge slong rnams la bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig zla ba gsum du rta chag gis 'tsho bas gnas par spro ba rnams tshul shing longs shig

/der tshul shing brims pa na/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu ni rlung nad shas che bas nas kyis mi 'tsho la/ maudgal gyi bu yang de'i g.yog la dgos pas de gnyis kyis tshul shing ma blangs*/ gzhan lnga brgyar gnyis kyis ma tshang bas blangs so/ /mchog zung gcig ri rtse mo gsum par song nas/ der lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bdud rtsi phul te 'tsho'o/ /skabs der kun dga' bos ston pa gsol rgyu'i nas de brdung zhing btso ba'i las byed pa rgan mo gcig la bcol bas/ de na re nga rgas kyi bdag gi bu mo 'di la chol zhig /de la bcol bas bdag gi don du chos tshig 'ga' gsung na bgyid do zhes las de byed pa na/ bu mo de na re/ sangs rgyas zhes bya ba de ci lags/ kun dga' bos bsams pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos zab mo rnams ni bud med 'dis go bar mi 'gyur gyi/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po de bsngags pa brjod do snyam ste/ de rgya cher bshad pas 'khor los sgyur ba'i gtam ni rdzogs/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi che ba ma brjod gong der nas kyi bya ba de grub nas/ 'o na dge ba 'dis bdag 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i btsun mo dam par gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ /de gsol bas/ bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis nyes te/ de la sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa brjod na phyir mi ldog pa thob pa yin pa la/ 'on kyang de 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi btsun mor 'gyur ro/ /de ltar lung bstan pa de dge 'dun gyi nas kyi las byed pa'i bu mo lnga brgyar gnyis kyis ma tshang bas thos te btsun mo rin po che'i 'khor du smon lam btab bo/ /der kun dga' bo mchi ma phyung ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nyid kyi sku yang brgyud ma nas brgyud mar sbyin par stsal na/ nas rul pa gsol dgos pa lta zhus pas/ ston pas tshems mche ba'i bar nas/ nas chan gcig bton te kun dga' bo 'tshal du bcug nas/ khyod kyis 'di lta bu'i ro myong ba dran nam/

gsol ba/ 'di lta bu'i ro phun sum tshogs pa myong ba sngar mi dran no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ro bro ba'i mchog brnyes pas/ kha zas bzang ngan gang yin yang ro brgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe de lta bu mtha'i rgyal phran dag gis thos nas/ me sbyin la pho nya btang bas de dag nang du ma tshud do/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis kyang de ltar thos nas shing rta lnga brgya tsam 'bras sā lu pa rab tu smin pas bkang ste 'bul du btang ba na/ lam du bdud sdig can kun dga' bor sprul te ston pa dge 'dun dang bcas pa la lhas bdud rtsi 'dren gyi phyir ldog cig zer ro/ /'on kyang ma ldog par 'ongs pa na bdud kyis char chen po phab ste/ chus shing rta'i lte ba tsam nub pas 'gro ma thub bo/ /de ltar zla ba gsum 'das pa la ded dpon des gdugs tshod bzang po zhig gsol te/ bdag 'khor los sgyur rgyal du gyur cig /rta cang shes ni bu thu bo rgyal tshab dang*/ rta lnga brgya ni bu lnga brgya/ btsun mor lung bstan pa ni btsun mo dam pa dang bu mo lnga brgya po rnams kyang de'i 'khor du gyur cig ces smon lam btab cing*/ ston pas kyang de ltar 'grub par lung bstan to/ /zla ba gsum po 'das pa'i mtshams der rgyal po me sbyin yang phyir byung ba na mtha'i rgyal phran rnams kyis bskur ba'i 'phrin yig dang ngag 'phrin klog cing nyan par byed do/ de dag thams cad na khyod kyis ston pa la zla ba gsum du bsod snyoms gsol bar khas blangs nas ma phul bas rta chag gi nas gsol lo bya ba yod do/ /ston pas kun dga' bo la khyod me sbyin can song la/ khyod kyi yul du zla ba gsum gnas zin gyi/ da 'gro'o zhes smos shig

kun dga' bos kyang de bzhin byas pa na rgyal po na re/ bsod snyoms 'o mi brgyal lam/ rgyal phran rnams kyi tshig bden nam zer ba la ji ltar gyur pa bsnyad pas/ rgyal po de dran med du brgyal zhing chu gtor bas dran pa rnyed nas/ nang mi rnams la ngas kha zas 'di lta bu sbyor cig ces ma bsgos sam/ de rnams na re/ gsung ste nyin re bzhin kha zas sbyor la da dung yang bgyid mod/ su la stsal ba ma shes so/ /de nas rgyal po me sbyin ston pa'i spyan sngar song nas nongs pa bshags te/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsnyen bkur bya bar zhus pa dang*/ de ma gnang bar lo bdun dang*/ zla ba bdun dang*/ dgung bdun gyi bar du zhus kyang de dag ma gnang ste/ rgyal po gdul bya ni mdang mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus dang ni nye bas rtsom pa 'di thongs shig gsung*/ thams cad kyi tha mar sang nyin gdugs tshod gsol bar zhus pas de gnang ngo*/ /blon po mkhas pa rnams kyis thabs bstan te/ zla ba gsum du kha zas sbyar ba thams cad sa la bkram ste/ dge 'dun gyi zhabs kyis bcags pas longs spyad par 'gyur bar byas/ ston pa 'khor bcas la gdugs tshod gsol zhing*/ ston pas kyang chos bstan pa dang yon bsngo ba'i bar du mdzad do/ /de ltar ljongs dpa' bo'i sde dang*/ grong khyer dgra mtha' na gnas pa'i skye bo rnams mtho ris dang byang grol gyi bde ba la yang dag par bkod de/ phyir gshegs pa na dge slong 'ga' zhig gis spyil po rnams bshig go /de rnams la bka' stsal pa/ ma bshig cig /spyil po dag ji srid gnas pa de srid du bsod nams kyang 'phel te/ de bzhin du mal cha dang chos gos dang gnas mal la yang de dang 'dra'o/ /brgya bzhi pa lnga len gyi lam bar du byung ba'i gtam ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das lho phyogs lnga len gyi chu klung gadgā'i 'gram na mar gshegs pa na/ dge slong zhig gis mdor bsdus pa'i chos kyis dgra bcom thob pa bshad du gsol/

zhus pas/ gadgā'i chu la shing sdong zhig khyer ba gzigs nas/ 'di phar 'gram dang*/ tshur 'gram dang*/ dbus su ma chags/ skam la ma phyung*/ mi dang mi ma yin pas ma bzung*/ klong du ma rul na rgya mtshor gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du khyod kyang pha rol tshur rol lam chags sogs nas mya ngan las 'das pa la gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /mdor bsdus pa de'i don de rgyas par gsungs pas des dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /de'i nye logs na dga' bo zhes bya ba'i gnag rdzi rgan po zhig gis ba lang 'tsho ba'i ngang nas 'khar ba sa la btsugs te bsdad pa na chos de dag thos so/ /sbal pa zhig kyang de'i chos nyan pa na/ gnag rdzi dga' bos ma brtags par 'khar ba sa la btsugs pa sbal ba'i rgyab tu phog pa na/ gnad chad pa la thug kyang bdag gis skad phyung na/ gzhan dag chos nyan pa'i bar chad du 'gyur snyam ste sran bkyed nas 'dug go /sbal pa de de ma thag shi nas rgyal chen bzhi rigs kyi lhar skyes/ ston pa'i spyan sngar chos nyan pas bden pa mthong*/ deng gnag rdzi dga' bos gsol ba/ btsun pa bdag kyang phar 'gram tshur 'gram du mi chags pa nas/ mi rul bar bgyid pas rab tu dbyung du gsol/ bka' stsal pa/ gnag rnams bdag po la gtad dam/ ma gtad de rang rang gi gnas su 'gro'o/ /de lta na'ang gtod dgos so/ /de nas gnag rdzi dga' bo chos kyi shugs chen po thob nas 'jigs so 'jigs so zhes bya ba'i sgra chen po 'byin zhing song ba las/ gnag rdzi ngo shes pa lnga brgya dang phrad de cis 'jigs dris pas/ skye ba dang rga ba dang na ba dang 'chi bas 'jigs so byas pas de rnams ldog go /de bzhin du rtswa thun mang po dang*/ shing thun mang po dang*/ lam du 'ongs pa rnams kyis kyang thos te slar ldog pa'i bar du snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /de nas ri bo zhig tu phyin pa dang*/ 'jigs so'i sgra thos te la la dngangs te bros/ la la go gyon no/ /der dpa' bo zhig dang phrad de cis 'jigs zhes dris pa na/

gong bzhin smras pas bag phebs so/ /de nas dga' bos gnag rnams bdag po so so la gtad/ grogs gnag rdzi lnga brgya khrid nas/ ston pa'i spyan sngar 'ongs te rab tu byung*/ chos nyan pas lnga brgya po de nyid du dgra bcom pa thob bo/ 'di la 'phags pa'i yul na 'bri g.yag med de/ ches che ba de dag gis 'dir gnag rdzi dang gnag ces bsgyur kyang phyugs rdzi dang phyugs ces bsgyur na legs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa lho phyogs lnga len gyi gadgā'i tshugs la gshegs te gang gā brgal ba na/ bcom ldan 'das res 'ga' ni gru la gshegs/ res 'ga' ni gadgā'i steng du zhabs bzhag nas gshegs/ der ngang pa lnga brgya dang*/ nya lnga brgya dang/ rus sbal lnga brgya rnams dad pas bcom ldan 'das la skor ba byed cing*/ tshig bzhi pa'i chos re gsungs/ de nas gadgā'i tshur 'gram du phebs pa na/ de dag shi nas rgyal chen bzhi rigs kyi lhar skyes te/ ston pa la chos nyan pas bden pa mthong ba'i bar du gyur to/ /der yi dwags sdong dum tshig pa lta bu lto ba ri sul tsam/ kha khab mig tsam/ me lce rab tu 'bar ba lnga brgya 'ongs nas sku'i mtha' bskor te gsol ba/ bdag cag las ngan pas chu yang mi 'tshal na/ mchil ma lta ci smos/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag la chab stsol zhig /der de rnams la chu bo gadgā ston par mdzad pa na/ 'di ni phal cher bdag cag la rab tu skams par snang zhing*/ da lta ni dbyug pa dang dgra sta 'dzin pa dag gis srung ngo*/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gadgā'i lha la bka' stsal pa/ ma srungs shig / des gsol ba/ bdag gis ma bsrungs mod/ 'di rnams nyid kyi las kyis bsrungs so/ /ston pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis yi dwags de rnams nyid kyi kha bkyed nas/ maudgal gyi bus chu blud de tshim pa'i gnas skabs thob la lto ba rgyas par gyur to/ /de dag ston pa la dad bzhin du shi bas rgyal chen bzhi rigs kyi lhar skyes nas/

bcom ldan 'das la chos nyan pas bden pa mthong ngo*/ /bar skabs sdom ni/ mdor bsdus sbal pa dga' bo dang*/ /gru dang ngang pa nya rus sbal/ /yi dwags lnga brgya tshim par mdzad/ /brgya lnga pa bram ze dbul pos bden pa mthong ba sogs ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das yul gzhon nu bskyed pa zhes bya ba dang*/ dpung rgyan ldan dang*/ nor bu can dang*/ yul sā la stobs dang*/ sā la'i stobs dang*/ gser bre dang*/ gnas bcas rnams brgyud nas mnyan yod kyi yul mtha' zin par byon pa na/ bram ze dbul po zhig snga dro zan ma zos par nas zhing gi zhing las byed do/ /der bu mo thug pa skyel du 'ongs pas/ bcom ldan 'das phyogs der byon pa dang stes te/ bram ze dad pa skyes nas zhing rmod 'phro bzhag ste sangs rgyas la thug pa phul ba na/ ston pas khron pa rnying pa zhig ston par mdzad de thug pa der blugs shig gsungs pa ltar blugs pas khron pa thug pas mer gyis khengs te rlangs pa 'thul lo/ /de nas bram zes dang por bcom ldan 'das la gsol/ de nas dge 'dun thams cad la thug pa brims kyang ma zad de/ khron pa lhag par gang ba na bram ze mchog tu dad pa la chos bstan pas des kyang bden pa mthong ngo*/ /de nas bram ze de'i zhing thams cad gser gyi ljang bu dang gser gyi snye ma dang gser gyi nas su skyes bar gyur to/ /de nas de rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi drung du song ste/ bdag gi zhing la nas rnams gser du skyes kyi/ spyan pa stsal te drug cha bzhes su gsol/ de nas spyan pa btang ste so sor bgos pa na/ rgyal po'i skal ba ni nas su gyur la/ bram ze'i skal ba rnams ni gser du 'dug go /yang spel te slar bgo bsha' byed pa de 'dra ba lan bdun gyi bar du byas kyang de bzhin du gyur nas spyan pa na re/ da khyod kyi gang blos dpogs pa de byin cig / de ltar byas pas gser nyid las ma 'gyur bar 'dug ste rgyal po la phul bas ya mtshan skyes so/

/bar skabs 'dir yang zhing pa lnga brgya bden pa la bkod pa sngar bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /de nas grong khyer chu mangs su gshegs te bram ze zhig zhing rmod pas ston pa byon pa mthong nas/ sku drung du phyin na las yal bar dogs te lcag lag tu thogs bzhin du gdugs de nyid nas phyag byas so/ /de nas ston pas gsungs pa/ bram ze 'di ni nyes te/ 'dir 'ongs te phyag byas na sangs rgyas gnyis la phyag byas par 'gyur ba la gsung*/ de nas kun dga' bos bla gos bzhi ltab du byas pa'i steng du bcom ldan 'das bzhugs su gsol lo/ /phyogs 'di na bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gi ring bsrel ma nyams par yod kyi/ blta bar 'dod dam/ 'khor rnams kyis zhus pa/ 'tshal lags so/ /der skye bo dpag tu med pa dag kyang 'dus shing*/ ston pas 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pas sa 'og gi klu dang lha rnams kyis rin po che'i sgrom bu'i snod blangs te/ de kha phye ba'i nang nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gi ring bsrel ma nyams ba phyung ngo*/ /de la skye bo thams cad lta zhing mchod par byed la/ de nas mi ring bar sa 'og tu nub par gyur to/ /rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis de thos nas/ lta bar 'ongs pa na/ sa 'og tu nub zin te ma mthong bas yid mi bde ba skyes te ldog go /dge bsnyen zhig gis sa phyogs de la skor ba byas pa dang*/ ston pas skye bo rnams la bka' stsal ba/ mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dang bas/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten dag phyir gom 'dor na/ /dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi srang tshad ni/ /stong phrag brgyar yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /de bzhin du 'jim gong 'jog pa dang me tog 'phreng ba dang mar me dang byug pa 'bul ba rnams kyi phan yon yang gsungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa la mchod pa bsod nams mnyam par gsungs so/ /der skye bo dpag tu med pas 'jim gong gcer/ mchod pas kyang mchod do/

/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo'i tshogs de rnams la chos bstan pas 'bras bu bzhi thob ba dang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa la sogs pa dpag tu med de/ phyogs der dus ston btsugs pas chu mangs kyi dus ston zhes grags so/ /yang sngar bshad pa'i bcom ldan 'das chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri la gshegs pa'i lo rgyus de snga phyi'i dbang du byas na/ skabs 'di tsam du sbyar yang rung ngo*/ /bar skabs sdom ni/ grong khyer brgyad dang dbul po dang*/ /lnga brgya zhing rmod 'od srung gdung*/ /brgya drug pa las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod du bzhugs pa na/ dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyis dang por thugs bskyed pa dang*/ bsnyen bkur mdzad pa yang bka' stsal gyi/ nga bdag cag rnams las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan par bgyi'o/ /zhes zhus so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gdon mi za bar mdzad pa ni bcu ste/ 'ga' zhig sangs rgyas su lung ston pa dang*/ mang po dag byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ gdul bya thams cad btul ba dang*/ mchog zung gcig bstan pa dang*/ mtshams bcad pa dang*/ sku tshe'i lnga cha btang ba dang*/ cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa dang*/ lha las babs pa dang*/ yab yum bden pa la bkod pa dang*/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rnams las kyi rgyu ba lung ston du 'jug par mdzad pa rnams so/ /skabs 'dir las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ bcom ldan 'das dgra bcom chen po lnga brgyar gcig gis ma tshang ba dang lhan cig mtsho ma dros par gshegs so/ ston pas 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pas klu dga' bo dang gnyen dga' bo yang der 'ongs shing*/ rin po che'i padma'i sdong po byung ste/ sdong bu ni rin po che sna tshogs las byas pa/ me tog rnams gser las byas pa/ ze'u 'bru ni rin po che rdo rje las byas pa'i padma'i sdong po ches che ba de'i dbus kyi thor to la gser gyi padma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa/

tshad shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam yod pa la ni bcom ldan 'das bzhugs/ gzhan padma so so dag la nyan thos chen po rnams 'dug go /de'i tshe 'phags pa shā ri'i bu ni bya rgod phung po'i ri la snam sbyar 'drub bo/ /de'i dus na bcom ldan 'das kyis maudgal gyi bu de'i drung du mngags so/ des rdzu 'phrul gyis phyin nas/ ston pa dge 'dun dang bcas pa khyod kyi don du bzhugs kyi/ da 'dong ngo*/ /shā ri'i bus smras pa re zhig snam sbyar drubs la de nas 'gro'o/ /der maudgal gyi bus ngas grogs bya'o byas nas sor mo lnga char gyis drubs te skad cig de la zin par byas so/ /de nas shā ri'i bus snam sbyar de rgya cang zhes bya ba ska rags kyi khyad par zhig gis bsdams te/ maudgal gyi bu la bskur nas rgya cang gi sne mo bya rgod phung po'i ri la btags so/ /de maudgal gyi bus drangs pas bya rgod phung po'i ri rtsa ba nas 'byin pa tsam du g.yos pas/ shā ri'i bus rgya cang gi sne mor ri rab la btags pa la gling bzhi dang bcas pa'i ri rab rab tu g.yos te mtsho ma dros pa'ang g.yos/ dge slong rnams kyang ldeg na/ bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i padma'i gdan ni g.yo ba med par 'dug go /de nas ston pa'i bzhugs gdan gyi padma la btags pas 'gul ma nus par 'dug go /maudgal gyi bu na re/ rdzu 'phrul rnam par rtses zin gyi 'dong ngo*/ /shā ri'i bu na re/ khyod song zhig nga 'ong ngo*/ /der maudgal gyi bus skad cig de nyid la rdzu 'phrul gyis mtsho ma dros par phyin pa na/ de'i yang sngon du shā ri'i bus sleb ste sangs rgyas bcom lda na 'das la phyag 'tshal ba yang zin/ padma'i snying po la 'dug kyang zin to/ /der dge slong rnams kyis 'phags pa maudgal gyi bu rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i mchog tu lung bstan na/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bus rdzu 'phrul gyis pham par byas pa la gzigs/ zhes zhus pas/

mchog zung gi sngon gyi lo rgyus mang du gsungs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pas brnyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ming gi rnam grangs tsam yang rang sangs rgyas kyis mi shes/ de bzhin du rang rgyal gyi de £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ dang £© 'dra ba shā ri'i bu dang*/ shā ri'i bu'i de 'dra ba maudgal bu dang*/ maudgal bus thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ming yang nyan thos gzhan rnams kyis mi shes so/ /'on kyang mang du gnas pa la brten nas maudgal gyi rdzu 'phrul che ba'i mchog tu lung bstan to gsung*/ de nas 'di skad ces bya ste/ 'od srungs che dang mchog gzung mdzes ldan dang*/ /bye ba nyi shu ngag dbang bsod snyoms len/ /legs 'ongs dga' yong grags pa dpal bskyed dang*/ /ba ku la dang 'od srung spun gsum dang*/ /grags pa gzhan dang me skyes yul 'khor skyong*/ /sa ga byin pa can dang lam phran bstan/ /sbrul 'khor ma 'gags ri dwags 'dzin gyi bu/ /sgra gcan 'dzin dang dga' bo gyad bu nor/ /nye sde bzang ldan mdzes bzang sbrang rtsi can/ /rgyu can kau di n+ya dang nye ba 'khor/ /'od byed nam gru la sogs dgra bcom tshogs/ /zhes bya'o/ /mdo las dngos su smos pa dge slong de rnams kyis rang rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan zhing*/ gzhan yang dgra bcom pa lnga brgya'i bar du rang rang gi sngon gyi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan pa'i mthar/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis lo drug dka' ba spyod dgos pa'i rgyu la sogs pa 'phrin las kyi rgyu ba thams cad lung ston par mdzad

do/ /de dag tu las 'bras la nges pa skyed pa'i gtam rgyud mang du yod mod kyi/ 'dir mangs par 'gyur bas ma bris te lung las rtogs par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa mtsho ma dros pa nas mi snang bar gyur te/ mnyan yod kyi gnas ri dwags 'dzin gyi ma sa ga'i kun dga' ra bar byon to/ /sa gas de thos nas ma dros par byon pa'i 'khor lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa la gdugs tshod rgya cher gsol to/ /de nas yul thigs pa can du gshegs shing thigs pa can gyi skye bo rnams dang*/ de dag gi nye du yi dwags lnga brgya bden pa la bkod nas/ bram ze smra 'dod kyi seng ge rab tu byung*/ dri zhim po la sogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi thabs mkhas la brten nas dgra bcom pa la bkod/ nyan thos bdug pas rnam par grol ba'i mchog tu lung bstan to/ /brgya bdun pa shākya lhag ma rnams bden pa la bkod pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das ser skya dang mnyan yod kyi bar mtshams shākya rnams kyi grong rdal mi tsu ru di zhes bya bar yun ring du bzhugs te/ shākya'i rigs shas che ba dang*/ gzhan yang skye bo mang po bden pa la bkod do/ /de'i tshe rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bu bzhon nu 'phags skyes po ni mdun na 'don gyi bu bram ze'i khye'u ma la gnod ces bya ba sdig pa'i grogs por gyur nas/ yab rgyal po gsal rgyal dang*/ blaun po lnga brgya po rnams kyi bar du phra ma bcug ste/ blaun po spyod pa'i bu ring po ma gtogs thams cad rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'khon du 'dzin la/ yab gsal rgyal ni bu la snying nye bas dogs pa mi byed do/ /de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das ma mthong bar ring zhig lon pas skyo bar gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na bzhugs zhes dris pa na/ grong rdal mi tsu ru di na bzhugs te shākya rnams la chos ston no zhes zhus so/

/de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal spyod pa'i bu ring po dang*/ gzhan yang 'khor mang po dang lhan cig grong rdal mi tsu ru dir phyin te/ thor tshugs ze'u kha dang*/ gdugs dang*/ ral gri dang*/ rnga yab dang*/ lham ste rgyal po'i chas lnga po phud nas spyod pa'i bu ring po la gtad de/ gtsug lag khang gi sgo drung nas g.yog rnams la phyi ltas su byed do/ /der rgyal po'i las gsang ba zhig yod par go nas 'khor rnams de nyid du 'dug go /der nang du song nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag byas te rab tu dad pas zhu ba mang po zhus shing*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang chos kyi rnam grangs bdud rtsi lta bu rgya cher bka' stsal to/ /der yun ring du thogs pa nas spyod pa'i bu ring pos bsams pa/ da ni 'phags skyes po rgyal srid du ma bskos na/ 'dis yab gsal rgyal bkrong par 'gyur ba'i gnas kyang yod la/ bdag la yang gnod par 'gyur ro snyam ste/ rgyal po'i chas lnga po khyer nas mnyan yod du ldog ste 'phags skyes po rgyal srid la bskos so/ /rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis ston pa'i zhabs la phyag btsal nas gtsug lag khang gi phyir 'ongs pa na g.yog dang bzhon pa su yang med de gtam dris pa na/ de dag song nas ring zhig lon no zhes zer bas/ rgyal po rang nyid rkang pas cung zad song ba na/ btsun mo gnyis 'ongs pa dang phrad nas ji ltar gyur pa bsnyad pa na/ nga ni 'phags skyes po rgyal srid 'byor pa dang bde bar spyod par gyur cig ces rtag tu smon pa yin na/ deng des rgyal srid thob na legs kyi/ 'phreng ldan ma khyod sngar nga'i rgyal srid kyi bde ba nyams su myong zin la/ da ni song la bu'i rgyal srid nyams su myong bar gyis shig ces zer te dbyar tshul ma dang lhan cig rgyal po'i khab tu song ngo*/ /de nas 'phags skyes pos shākya rnams 'joms pa'i phyir dmag chas te 'ongs pa la/ ston pas dgongs na/

da dung shākya'i rigs bden pa ma mthong ba mang po dag yod par gzigs te lam mkhar shing sha kho ṭa bskams pas lo ma srab pa grib ma chung ba zhig gi drung du bzhugs so/ /'phags skyes pos mthong nas zhabs la phyag byas te/ ci'i phyir ljon shing bzang po gzhan spangs te 'dir bzhugs pa lags/ bka' stsal pa/ 'di ni nga'i nye du rnams kyis bskyed bskyed pa yin pas gnyen bshes kyi grib ma 'di ni rab tu bsil lo/ /der 'phags skyes po bcom ldan 'das ni nye du shākya rnams la thugs brtse'o snyam ste lan cig dmag phyir ldog ste song ngo*/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis ser skya dang lhas bstan du byon te/ shākya rnams la slar yang dbang po dang 'tsham par chos bstan pas sngar bden pa ma mthong ba'i shākya rigs gang yin pa thams cad kyang bden pa mthong ste/ khye'u dang bu mo btsas nas ring po ma lon pa shin tu shed ma bye ba'i rigs dang*/ log sred can re re tsam ma gtogs/ shākya rigs kyi skyes pa dang bud med dang khye'u dang bu mo dang de rnams kyi bran pho bran mo zho shas 'tsho ba dag thams cad kyis bden pa mthong ste/ ser skya gzhi la sogs pa shākya'i yul rnams su 'phags pa 'ba' zhig ma gtogs so so skye bo 'bad pas btsal kyang mi rnyed pa lta bur gyur to/ /de ltar na bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i nye du dang*/ de'i phyogs su brten pa thams cad kyang gtan gyi bde ba bla na med pa thob bo/ / skabs der rgyal po gsal rgyal dang*/ sdig can 'phags skyes po'i tha ma'i bya ba dang*/ shākya bdun khri bdun stong kha btags pa sogs shāka rigs kyi bde sdug myong tshul 'jigs su rung ba byung ngo*/ /brgya dang brgyad pa bram ze gang po byang chub tu lung bstan pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe lho phyogs kyi ri la bram ze gang po zhes bya ba 'byor pa chen po dang ldan pa zhig mchod sbyin rgya chen po gtong ba la zhugs pa na/

mu stegs byed dang bram ze thams cad de'i mchod sbyin gyi sar 'ongs shing sbyin pa len par byed pa la des bsams pa/ kye ma dge sbyong gau ta ma de bdag gi mchod sbyin len par 'ongs kyang ci ma rung snyam mo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de mkhyen nas 'khor dge slong stong dang lhan cig gnas der gshegs nas/ ji ltar bram ze de rnams dang slong mo de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das nyag gcig ma gtogs 'khor rnams mi mthong bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas ston pa byon pa bram ze gang bos mthong nas/ dge sbyong tshur byon bdag gi mchod sbyin la longs spyod cig / bka' stsal pa dang por nga'i lhung bzed 'di gang bar gyis shig /phyis longs spyad par bya'o/ /der kha zas mang po blugs kyang lhung bzed de ma gang nas bram ze nga rgyal bskyed de/ kye ma lhung bzed 'di dgang bar ma nus par bdag mchod sbyin byed pa lta snyam/ bungs bskyed de blugs pa na skye bo stong phrag gcig tshim par 'gyur ba'i kha zas shong zhing des ni gang bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /de na re/ dge sbyong gau ta ma snod gang bar gyur gyi da ni longs spyad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul brtul te/ bram ze la sogs pa skye bo de thams cad kyis dge slong stong yang de nyid du 'dug pa mthong*/ bram ze de'i bkang sar bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa gdugs tshod gsol zhing*/ bram ze de yang rab tu dad pa chen po skyes te bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa la bsod snyoms gsol nas/ mthar ston pa la na bza' 'bum ri ba dang*/ dge slong rnams la'ang na bza' phrugs re phul te bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas thob par smon lam btab bo/ de bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par lung yang bstan te/ de dag la sogs pa snga phyir byang chub tu sems bskyed cing smon lam btab la/ lung bstan pa yang dpag tu med pa zhig go

/brgya dgu pa mi nyams pa'i rgyu gsungs ba ni/ de nas ston pa rgyal po'i khab tu byon nas 'od ma'i tshal na bzhugs pa'i dus shig na/ mchog zung gcig mya ngan las 'das pa'i gtam rgyud sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas ston pa bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la bzhugs pa na/ rgyal po ma skyes dgras bram ze dbyar byed ston pa'i spyan sngar btang nas/ ngas spong byed pa rnams rmeg med par bya na/ bka' ci stsal zhes zhus shig/bcom ldan 'das kyis ji skad lung bstan pa de zungs shig zer ro/ /dbyar byed kyis kyang de ltar zhus pa na bka' stsal pa/ ngas spong byed pa la nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i rgyu bdun bshad do/ /bdun ni/ yang dang yang du 'du zhing 'du ba la ring du gnas pa dang*/ 'gro 'dug dang dgos pa dang bya ba mthun par gnas pa dang*/ smon par bya ba ma yin pa la mi mos smon pa mi 'dor khrims bcas pa bzhin du spyod pa dang*/ bud med bgrod bya ma yin pa la mi bgrod pa dang*/ rgan rabs la bkur bsti byed cing tshig nyan pa dang*/ mchod rten la mchod cing sngon gyi mtshan ma mi 'dor ba dang*/ yul gyi dgra bcom pa rnams la dad pas bsnyen bkur byed pa'o/ /spong byed pa rnams de dag gcig dang ldan na'ang ma skyes dgras thub par mi 'gyur na/ bdun dang ldan na lta ci smos gsung*/ de nas bram ze dbyar byed song ngo*/ /dge slong thams cad bsdus te dge 'dun nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i rgyu bdun gsungs te/ dang po gsum spong byed pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ lhag ma bzhi ni 'dod chags kyi dbang du ma gyur pa dang*/ gnas brtan rgan rim la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang*/ dben par gnas mal 'cha' ba dang*/ tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la dad pas chos gos la sogs pa bsnyen bkur byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i chos bdun tshan mang po dang*/ kun tu dga' bar 'gyur ba'i chos drug gsungs so/ /brgya bcu pa yangs pa'i lam du bzhud pa ni/

de nas yangs pa can pa rnams kyis spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya btang ba ltar/ bya rgod phung po'i ri nas 'od ma'i dbyug pa can gyi grong du byon nas nub gcig bzhugs te/ nangs par grong khyer dmar bu can du gshegs nas der gnas pa'i khyim pa rnams la bag med pa'i nyes dmigs lnga gsungs pa ni/ longs spyod las nyams pa dang*/ tshogs su 'gro na zhum pa dang*/ grags pa ngan pa dang*/ rang 'gyod pa dang*/ shi nas ngan song du 'gro ba'o/ /bag yod pa la ni de las ldog pa'i phan yon lnga gsungs te/ de'i nub mo khyim pa rnams kyis gnas der bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas dmar bu can gyi 'dug gnas su bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe yang bram ze dbyar byed kyi spong byed pa rnams gzhom pa'i phyir dmar bu can du grong khyer rtsig ste/ lha mthu che bas 'dres byed pa dang*/ grong khyer gyi mchog tu 'gyur ba dang*/ 'jigs pa gsum 'byung bar lung bstan pa'i bar gong bzhin no/ /de yang snga ma byang phyogs 'dul ba dang 'brel chags su byung ba de ni dmar bu can gyi grong khyer rtsig pa tsam yin la/ 'dir spong byed pa rnams gzhom pa zhes 'byung ste/ rdzong dang btsan gnas dang 'thab chas byaid pa yin pas khyad par ni de yin no/ /de'i nangs par bram ze dbyar byed kyis gdugs tshod gsol te/ dmar bu can gyi grong khyer pa rnams kyi don du dge ba bsngo bar zhus shing ston pas kyang de ltar mdzad nas grong khyer gyi dbus nas nub sgor gshegs/ phyi rol du phebs te byang phyogs su 'khyogs nas gadgā'i tshu rol gyi 'gram nas mi snang bar gyur te pha rol gyi 'gram du skad cig gis snang bar mdzad pa de lta bu'i cho 'phrul gyis gshegs so/ /dge slong rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa rnams kyang de dang 'dra la/ 'khor phal pa rnams ni gru dang spang leb dang*/ rtsa rdzing la sogs pa thabs sna tshogs kyis song ngo*/ de nas gadgā'i byang ngos grong khyer dpyil po can brgyud de byang phyogs sha pa'i tshal na bzhugs te/

dge slong rnams la bslab pa bsrungs pa'i phan yon gsungs te grong khyer sgra can du byon to/ /der snga rol lo de nang du mi ngas chen po byung ste dge bsnyen ka ṭa ka la sogs pa mang po dus las 'das pa thos nas dge slong rnams kyis dus las 'das pa de dag gar skye zhus pas/ dge bsnyen ka ṭa ka phyir mi 'ongs pa yin pas gzugs khams su skyes nas mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'gyur la/ gzhan dge bsnyen sum brgya ni phyir mi 'ongs yin/ lnga brgya ni rgyun zhugs yin/ khyed de bzhin gshegs pa la dus las 'das so dus las 'das so zhes zhu ba ni mtho 'tsham pa yin te/ skye ba yod na 'chi ba 'byung bas de ngo 'tshar mi che'o/ /zhes rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs zlog gsungs nas chos kyi me long shes nas dad pa dang*/ 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims gnyis gsungs nas yangs pa can du byon te a mra skyong ma'i tshal na bzhugs so/ /der a mra skyong ma 'ongs pa dang*/ litstsha bī rnams kyang 'ongs pa dang*/ bram ze ser skyas bla gos lnga brgya phul zhing*/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon na ngo mtshar che ba'i chos lnga 'jig rten du 'byung ste/ /chos ston pa dang*/ gus pas nyan pa dang*/ thos nas dga' ba dang*/ de sgrub pa dang*/ don zab mo so sor rtogs pa'o zhes gsungs pa'i bar sngar dang 'dra'o/ /brgya bcu gcig pa sha ba'i tshal du bstan pa ni/ de nas 'od ma can gyi grong khyer du byon nas shing sha pa'i tshal du bzhugs te/ de'i tshe mu ge chen po byung bas dge slong smos mgrin dang ngo shes yod pa rnams de dag la brten pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das sku bsnyun tshabs chen po byung ba sogs kyang gong dang 'dra/ der dgongs pa da lta dge 'dun 'thor bas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus ma yin gyi/ bdag gi tshor ba gcig pu 'di brtson 'grus kyis bcil la mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin mngon sum du byas nas gnas par bya'o dgongs nas de ltar mdzad pas lhag par 'tsho bar gyur to/

/kun dga' bos gsol ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa bsnyun tshabs chen pos thebs pas/ bdag ni dug 'tshal ba bzhin phyogs kyang bslad/ chos rnams kyang bskyud par gyur mod/ bdag re ba ni dge 'dun rnams kyi slad du zhal chems cung zad cig bka' ma stsal gyi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da'o snyam mo/ /bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo gang dge 'dun ni bdag gi yin te/ bdag gi dge 'dun la brten par bya'o snyam pa de ni kha chems cung zad smra bar 'gyur mod/ nga la ni de 'dra'i dgongs pa mi mnga' bas kha chems bstan du ci yod/ ngas rtag tu goms par byas pa'i byang phyogs so bdun ni yang dang yang du bshad zin to/ /kun dga' bo nga ni rgas 'khogs te gnyis la brten nas 'tsho'o/ khyod mya ngan ma byed cig/'dus byas la mi 'jig pa ga la yod de gnas med do/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas na bdag nyid skyabs dang*/ bdag nyid gnas dang*/ bdag nyid gling dang*/ chos skyabs su btsal bar bya yi/ gzhan ma yin no zhes gsungs so/ /brgya bcu gnyis pa nor can gyi gtam ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can na spre'u'i rdzing 'gram gyi khang pa brtsegs pa na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe yangs pa can na mi bsod nams dang ldan pa bzhi yod de/ khyim bdag nor can dang*/ nor can gyi chung ma dang*/ nor can gyi bu dang*/ nor can gyi mna' ma'o/ /skabs der li tsa bī rnams kyis khrims su bcas te/ bdag cag re re nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la gdugs tshod gsol na phyi ma rnams kyis mi thob pas/ tshogs kyis gsol gyi gcig gis ma yin no zhes dam bcas

so/ /der nor can gyis khrims bcas pa ma thos nas/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pas gnang ngo*/ /de ma thag li tsa bī tshogs kyis zhus pas/ bka' stsal pa/ gnas 'jog gi bu dag/nangs par nor can gyis spyan drangs zin to/ /der de rnams las 'ga' zhig na re/ nor can gyis tshogs kyi khrims las 'das so/ /gzhan dag na re des khrims ma thos so/ kha cig na re/ de skyes bu mchog yin pas gdugs tshod gsol du chug cig /ces zer te gyes so/ /sang snga bar kun dga' bos langs te/ der phyin nas shar sgo nas zhugs pa dang*/ grabs su byed pa su yang med de smras pa/ ci ston pa dge 'dun dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas snying las chung ngus gnas sam/ de dag na re/ shar sgo'i phyogs 'di na ni ma mchis kyi/ lho sgo nas zhugs shig zer ro/ /der shar sgo nas 'thon te lho sgo nas zhugs pa na lha'i zhal zas lta bu shin tu mang po sta gon byas pa sogs mthong nas ngo mtshar skyes so/ /der bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa la bsod snyoms gsol zhing chos nyan/ de'i sang nyin nor can gyi chung mas gdugs tshod gsol bar zhus te gnang ngo*/ / nangs par kun dga' bos lho sgo nas zhugs pas grabs ma byas pa sogs sngar dang 'dra/ shar sgo nas zhugs shig zhugs pas sngar bzhin bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa sogs gong ma bzhin no/ /nyi ma gsum pa la nor can gyi bus spyan drangs/ kun dga' bo dang por shar sgo nas zhugs/ de nas nub sgo nas zhugs pas sogs snga ma dang 'dra/ nyi ma bzhi pa la nor can gyi mna' mas spyan drangs/ kun dga' bo dang por nub sgo nas zhugs/ de nas byang sgo nas zhugs pa sogs sngar dang 'dra'o/ /de skabs nyi ma phyi ma de rnams la yang yangs pa can pa'i tshogs kyis spyan 'dren gsol ba na/ de dang de dag gis spyan drangs shing zhal gyis bzhes zin pa kho nar gyur la/ nyi ma bzhi ba'i skabs der ston pa 'khor bcas gdan gshams pa la bzhugs pa na/

yangs pa can pa'i li tsa bī thams cad de'i sgo na 'dus te/ nor can gcig pu la nor yod dam/ 'o skol la sangs rgyas mchod pa'i skabs med par byed/ da bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas 'di'i khyim nas phar gshegs zin pa na/ khyim gyi rdo ba re re rang cag mi res bkogs te khyim bshig par bya'o zhes byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nor can la bka' stsal pa/ yangs pa can pa rnams sgo na 'dug gi song la bzod par gsol shig de phyir byung ste bzod pa gsol bas/ khyod gcig pu la nor yod dam/ bdag cag gis skabs mi rnyed par byed/ ces zer ba la/ kho bos tshogs kyi khrims bcas pa ma thos kyi bzod pa mdzod cig ces smras pas de rnams kyis kyang bzod par byas so/ /de nas yangs pa can pa rnams nang du bos pas/ nor can gyi gdan dang zhal zas la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad lha rdzas dang 'dra ba khyad par can rnams mthong ste/ ngo mtshar skyes nas 'byor pa 'di lta bu dang ldan pas khyod 'ba' zhig gis sangs rgyas la gdugs tshod gsol bar 'os so zhes bsngags pa brjod cing*/ nor can gyis yangs pa can pa de rnams la rin po che dag byin pa na/ sngon ma ma blangs pa la/ ston pas long zhig ces bka' stsal pas/ de dag gis blangs pa na gang blangs pa'i nor bu de'i kha dog ci 'dra ba de 'dra bar mi rnams kyi kha dog kyang de lta bur snang ngo*/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos bstan nas nor can dang nor can gyi chung ma dang bu dang mna' ma la sogs pa skye bo dpag tu med pa zhig bden pa la bkod do/ /brgya bcu gsum pa sku tshe'i 'du byed btang ba ni/ de'i rjes su li tsa bī rnams kyis kyang mchod pas yang dag par mchod/ skye bo dpag tu med pa byang chub gsum du nges par mdzad de/ dus lan cig bsod snyoms mdzad de shing gcig gi drung du bzhugs nas bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo mi rnams la tshe gces te/

gang su yang rung rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la brten zhing sgom pa lan mang du byas pa de ni 'dod na bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag pa'i bar du yang 'dug go /de bzhin gshegs pas kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la brten sgom lan mang du byas pas na/ bzhed na bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag pa'i bar du'ang bzhugs so/ /zhes bka' stsal na kun dga' bo cang mi zhu'o/ /lan gnyis lan gsum du gsungs kyang mi zhu ste/ 'di bdud kyis khebs so snyam du dgongs nas/ kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ 'o skol gnyis 'khrugs por mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ nga ni 'dir 'dug na/ khyod shing gzhan gyi drung du song shig /de nas kun dga' bo shing gzhan zhig gi drung du song*/ bcom ldan 'das shing drung de na nyin bar gyi spyod lam gyis bzhugs pa'i drung du bdud sdig can 'ongs te/ btsun pa khyod sngon sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ bdag gis mya ngan las 'da' bar mdzod cig ces zhus pas/ nga 'khor rnam pa bzhi la tshangs par spyod pa bstan te/ lha mi'i skye bo mang po la rgyas par ma gyur gyi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da'o zhes gsungs na/ da de ltar gyur lags kyi/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus la bab bo/ /bka' stsal pa/ sdig can khyod rtsom pa ma che zhig /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba gsum nas 'da' 'o/ /der bdud de dga' nas mi snang bar gyur to/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sku tshe'i 'du byed ni btang*/ 'tsho ba'i 'du byed ni byin gyis brlabs so/ /de'i tshe sa g.yos/ skar mda' ltung*/ phyogs rnams ni tshig lha'i rnga rdung ngo*/ /der kun dga' bos sa g.yos pa'i rgyu zhus pas/ rlung gi khams 'khrugs pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul can gyis sa chung zhing chu che bar bsgoms pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' lhums su zhugs pa dang*/ bltams pa dang*/ sangs rgyas pa dang*/ chos 'khor bskor ba dang*/ sku tshe'i 'du byed btang ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa ste rgyu brgyad gsungs pas kun dga' bo dogs pa skyes te/

bcom ldan 'das sku tshe'i 'du byed btang bar ma gyur tam zhes zhus pa na/ de bzhin no zhes bka' stsal/ de nas bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag par bzhugs par gsol ba btab pa na/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis nyes te/ ngas lan gsum gyi bar du smras kyang khyod bdud kyis non te cang mi smra'o/ /da ni 'dod pa'i bdag po la khas blangs zin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa gnyis su gsung pa'i gnas med do/ /de nas dge slong thams cad bsdu bar mdzad de/ 'du byas thams cad mi rtag pa yin na/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma la gang phan pa dang bde ba de bzung bar bya ste/ de gang zhe na byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun no/ / brgya bcu bzhi pa rtswa can du bzhud pa ni/ de nas yangs pa can gyi grong khyer la g.yas phyogs nas gzigs te phyi ltas su mdzad nas/ 'di yangs pa can la gzigs pa'i tha ma yin no zhes gsungs shing dge slong rnams la bslab pa gsum gyi gdams pa gsungs so/ /de nas ru ta'i grong dang*/ dum pa'i grong dang*/ a mra'i grong dang*/ dzambu'i grong dang*/ rdzi grong dang*/ shur ba'i grong dang*/ longs spyod kyi grong dang*/ mal la'i grong ste grong khyer brgyad po de dag tu rim can du byon nas/ longs spyod kyi grong gi byang phyogs shing sha pa'i tshal du bzhugs so/ /der yang sa g.yos/ skar mda' ltung*/ phyogs tshig lha rnams rnga rdung bar gyur pa la rgyu zhus pas/ sngar gyi brgyad las dang po gnyis dang phyi ma gsum ste rgyu lnga gsungs nas/ dge slong rnams la mdo sde la 'jug 'dul ba la snang*/ chos nyid dang mi 'gal na chos yin gyi/ de las ldog na ma yin no/ zhes nag por bstan pa dang*/ chen por bstan pa bka' stsal te/ dge slong dag mdo sde'i mtha' la brten gyi/ gang zag la brten par mi bya'o zhes gsungs/ de nas mal la'i grong gi ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs nas/ sa pa'i grong gi dza lu ka'i tshal du bzhugs so/

/yul de'i skye bo rnams ston pa'i drung du 'ongs pa la chos bstan pas dga' bar mdzad de/ skye bo rnams song ba'i 'og tu mgar ba'i bu tsun das nangs par bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa gdugs tshod la phebs par gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ de'i nangs par bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas phebs te gdan bshams pa la bzhugs/ lcags gzhong gi snod nas 'bras chen gsol ba na/ dge slong sdig pa'i chos can zhig gis lcags gzhong brkus te snam phrag tu sbas pa ston pas gzigs te mgar ba'i bu tsun da la yang go bar mdzad do/ /gdugs tshod gsol zin pa na/ tsun das dge slong du mchis zhes zhus pas bka' stsal pa/ dge slong bzhi ste lnga pa med/ lam gyis rgyal dang lam ston dang*/ /lam gyis 'tsho dang lam sun 'byin/ /de nyid shes nas khyod la smras/ /zhes sogs dri lan rgyas par mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das grong khyer rtswa can gyi ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te/ sdig pa can dang chu bo dbyig ldan gyi bar mtshams su phebs nas sku rgyab mi bde ste snam sbyar dbu 'phang du bcug /bla gos bzhi ltab tu gting ba'i steng du sku ngal gso ba'i tshul du gzims nas kun dga' bo la chu longs zhig /btung ba dang lus la gtor bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal/ kun dga' bos chu klung ka ku ta'i 'gram du song ba na/ chu de la shing rta lnga brgya brgal nas song bas shin tu rnyog mar gyur zhing*/ chu dwangs pa gzhan yang ma rnyed nas lhung bzed gang de nyid nas blangs te/ 'dis zhabs bsil ba dang*/ zhal bshal du gsol/ 'di nas mi ring ba na chu bo dbyig ldan mchis te chu des sku la gdab pa dang*/ mgul du gsol bar bgyi'o zhes zhus nas/ chu des zhal bshal zhing zhabs bkrus pas sku bde bar gyur te skyil krung bcas te sku drang por bsrang nas bzhugs so/ /der gyad kyi sna chen po la gtogs pa gyad g.yung po zhes bya ba ring 'phur gyi tshangs par spyod pa la dad pa zhig bcom ldan 'das kyi che ba lhag par thos pas ringa'aphur gyi gtsang sbra'i chos las sangs rgyas kyi chos lhag par go ste/

rab tu dad pas bcom ldan 'das la na bza' ras gsar pa gser gyi kha dog lta bu zung gcig phul te/ bdag gis ston pa dge 'dun dang bcas pa la rim gro bgyi'o zhes khas blangs so/ /ras de'i kha tshar bcad de de ma thag sku la gsol zhing*/ de nyid du bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i kha dog sngar bas gsal zhing rab tu gsal la shin tu snang bar gyur te/ kun dga' bos bdag gis lo nyi shu lhag cig zhabs 'bring du bgyis na/ sku'i kha dog gsal ba 'di lta bu sngar ma mthong ste 'di'i rgyu gang lags zhus pa na/ gang gi nub mo byang chub sems dpa' mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya ba dang*/ gang gi nub mo de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba na gzhan pas kha dog gsal bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ de nas yang gshegs te chu bo dbyig ldan gyi 'gram du sku khrus mdzad/ dbyig ldan brgal nas na bza' chig rkyang gsol te sku skem zhing bzhugs nas kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ mgar ba'i bu tsun da la gzhan dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la bsod snyoms tha ma gsol nas mya ngan las 'das pa ni khyod kyis legs pa ma rnyed de nyes pa rnyed pa'o zhes 'gyod pa bskyed 'dug gi 'di la khyod song la gnas gnyis kyis 'gyod pa bsal dgos te/ gang du bsod snyoms gsol nas sangs rgyas pa dang*/ gang du bsod snyoms gsol nas mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis rnam smin mnyam ste/ tshe dang kha dog dang*/ stobs dang longs spyod dang bde 'gro dang phyug pa dang 'khor dang bcas par 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bsags pa yin no zhes smros shig /ces gsungs pa ltar kun dga' bos kyang de'i 'gyod pa bsal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gyad yul gyi ljongs rgyu zhing rtswa can gyi lam gyi phyed du'ang sku rgyab mi bde ste/ sku ngal gso ba'i don du sngon bzhin gzims par mdzad de/ kun dga' bo la byang chub kyi yan lag smos shig gsungs/ des kyang bshad pa na/

brtson 'grus smras sam gsung pa na/ smras lags zhus pas brtson 'grus kyi che ba brjod par mdzad de skyil krung bcas nas bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe dge slong gzhan zhig gis kyang chos nyan pa'i che ba brjod do/ /brgya bco lnga pa rtswa can du byon pa'i mdzad pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das grong khyer rtswa can du byon nas rtswa can gyi gyad grong dang nye ba shing sā la zung gi tshal du byon nas shing sā la zung gi bar du khri chos la dbu 'phang byang du ston zhig /do nub nam gyi gung thun la mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ kun dga' bos kyang de ltar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa der phebs nas glo g.yas pa phab/ zhabs kyi steng du zhabs bzhag snang ba'i 'du shes dang*/ dran pa dang shes bzhin dang mya ngan las 'da' ba'i 'du shes mdzad do/ /der kun dga' bo shin tu yid mi bde bar gyur pa yang dag par gzengs bstod de/ kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das grong khyer chen po drug spangs nas grong khyer ngan pa tho shu tsam 'dir mya ngan las 'da' ba gang lags zhus pa na/ 'di la grong khyer ngan pa zhes mi bya ste/ rgyal po ku sha can dang*/ rgyal po legs mthong la sogs pa'i gtam rgyud gsungs nas shing sā la zung gi tshal dang*/ gyad kyi dbu rgyan btags pa'i mchod rten gyi bar dpag tshad bcu gnyis khor yug gi gnas 'dir ngas sngar 'khor los sgyur ba'i lus drug blangs shing dor la/ bdun pa ni da ltar gyi 'di yin te/ brgyad pa ni 'dor ba'i gnas med do/ /de'i tshe dge slong dpe can bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun na 'dug go /kyai dge slong nga'i mdun du ma 'dug par songs shig /ces bka' stsal pas phyir song ste/ de yang dge slong de'i gzi brjid kyis lha rnams der 'ong bar mi nus te/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba ni dkon la/ do nub mya ngan las 'da' na/ de spyan sngar yod pas mchod pa'i phyir bdag cag gis 'gro ma thub bo zhes lha rnams kha zer ba bzlog pa'i phyir yin no/

/der dpag tshad bcu gnyis khor yug tu lhas ma khyab pa med de/ 'khar ba gzug pa'i khyon tsam yang stong pa med do/ /de nas kun dga' bos ston pa'i gdung la mchod pa ji ltar bgyi ba'i tshul zhus pas/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i gdung la ji ltar bya ba bzhin byed tshul rnams zhus lan gyi tshul gyis rgyas par gsungs nas/ yang kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ rtswa can gyi gyad rnams nged kyi nye 'khor du ston pa mya ngan las 'das mod kyang*/ nged la sbron mkhan ma byung bas bsnyen bkur ma thub bo zhes phyis 'gyod cing gyod kha rdol bar yong bas/ khyod song la de bzhin gshegs pa do nub kyi gung thun la mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur bas khyed rnams kyis bya ba gang yin pa de sgrubs shig ces sbran par bya'o/ /kun dga' bos kyang de ltar byas pas/ rtswa can gyi gyad rnams rang rang gi bu dang chung ma la sogs pa gnyen 'dun rnams dang bcas te de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal lta ba dang*/ bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir spyan sngar 'ongs/ de rnams rang rang gi bsam pa dang mthun pa'i chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ gyad de dag skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ bslab pa'i gnas lnga len par 'dod pa la kun dga' bo la bka' stsal te/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa 'bogs su 'jug par mdzad pa las/ re re nas sdom pa phog na mi zin par shes nas/ sangs rgyas la zhus pas gnang ba stsal te/ gyad lnga brgya la dus gcig tu dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phog go
